units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|All the other worlds belonging to this species have appeared unwilling to let you land, but here you find a slightly warmer welcome. A cloud of small, highly maneuverable patrol ships takes off from the planet as you approach and herds you onto one particular landing pad where, after a few minutes, several of the aliens approach your ship.|23|0
units.english: All the other worlds belonging to this species have appeared unwilling to let you land, but here you find a slightly warmer welcome. A cloud of small, highly maneuverable patrol ships takes off from the planet as you approach and herds you onto one particular landing pad where, after a few minutes, several of the aliens approach your ship.
units.italian: Tutti gli altri mondi di questa specie sono sembrati riluttanti a lasciarti atterrare, ma qui trovi un'accoglienza leggermente più calorosa. Una nube di piccole navi di pattuglia, molto manovrabili, decolla dal pianeta mentre ti avvicini e ti spinge verso una piazzola di atterraggio precisa, dove dopo qualche minuto diversi alieni si avvicinano alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	This species is birdlike, but with bodies nearly as large as yours, and with wings that tower above you. They come swooping down from the sky, circle your ship to inspect it, and then land near the hatch and wait for you to open it. They do not appear to be armed, but their talons are eight or nine centimeters long.|24|0
units.english: This species is birdlike, but with bodies nearly as large as yours, and with wings that tower above you. They come swooping down from the sky, circle your ship to inspect it, and then land near the hatch and wait for you to open it. They do not appear to be armed, but their talons are eight or nine centimeters long.
units.italian: Questa specie è di aspetto avicolo, ma con corpi quasi grandi quanto il tuo e ali che ti sovrastano. Scendono in picchiata dal cielo, girano intorno alla tua nave per ispezionarla, poi atterrano vicino al portello e aspettano che tu lo apra. Non sembrano armati, ma i loro artigli sono lunghi otto o nove centimetri.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	Hesitantly, you open your hatch and greet them. One of the aliens speaks to you: a chirping, clicking noise. You have no idea what it is saying.|25|0
units.english: Hesitantly, you open your hatch and greet them. One of the aliens speaks to you: a chirping, clicking noise. You have no idea what it is saying.
units.italian: Con esitazione apri il portello e li saluti. Uno degli alieni ti parla: un suono fatto di trilli e schiocchi. Non hai idea di che cosa stia dicendo.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	"Hello. I come in peace."|27|0
units.english: "Hello. I come in peace."
units.italian: "Salve. Vengo in pace."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	"My name is <first>. I am glad to meet you."|28|0
units.english: "My name is <first>. I am glad to meet you."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo <first>. Sono lieto di conoscervi."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	The alien leans forward as you speak, as if trying to decipher your words. "Iyik'ka'ak kareek elik, ek karu karai kavet," it says. You shake your head to indicate that you do not understand, and again try to speak to it in your own language. Again it leans forward as if deeply focused on what you are saying.|29|0
units.english: The alien leans forward as you speak, as if trying to decipher your words. "Iyik'ka'ak kareek elik, ek karu karai kavet," it says. You shake your head to indicate that you do not understand, and again try to speak to it in your own language. Again it leans forward as if deeply focused on what you are saying.
units.italian: L'alieno si sporge in avanti mentre parli, come se cercasse di decifrare le tue parole. "Iyik'ka'ak kareek elik, ek karu karai kavet," dice. Scuoti la testa per far capire che non hai capito, e provi di nuovo a parlargli nella tua lingua. Di nuovo si sporge in avanti come se fosse profondamente concentrato su ciò che dici.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	The other aliens standing beside it are inspecting you with equal curiosity. Finally, one of them says to the leader, "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." The leader gestures in response, turning up open palms, and the second alien steps forward and addresses you in an entirely different language, one that does not sound like birdsong at all. In fact, judging by the difficulty it seems to be having in trying to speak it, you suspect that it is the language of a different species entirely. Unfortunately, it is no more comprehensible to you than the bird's own language.|30|0
units.english: The other aliens standing beside it are inspecting you with equal curiosity. Finally, one of them says to the leader, "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." The leader gestures in response, turning up open palms, and the second alien steps forward and addresses you in an entirely different language, one that does not sound like birdsong at all. In fact, judging by the difficulty it seems to be having in trying to speak it, you suspect that it is the language of a different species entirely. Unfortunately, it is no more comprehensible to you than the bird's own language.
units.italian: Gli altri alieni in piedi accanto a lui ti esaminano con la stessa curiosità. Alla fine uno di loro dice al capo: "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." Il capo risponde con un gesto, aprendo i palmi, e il secondo alieno fa un passo avanti e si rivolge a te in una lingua del tutto diversa, che non somiglia affatto a un canto di uccelli. Anzi, a giudicare dalla difficoltà che sembra avere nel pronunciarla, sospetti che sia la lingua di una specie completamente diversa. Purtroppo per te non è più comprensibile del linguaggio degli uccelli.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer (Before Hai)|	They make some further attempts to communicate with you, but without success. Eventually they give up and all but the leader leaves. The leader makes a sweeping gesture to the rest of the spaceport, apparently inviting you to explore.|31|0
units.english: They make some further attempts to communicate with you, but without success. Eventually they give up and all but the leader leaves. The leader makes a sweeping gesture to the rest of the spaceport, apparently inviting you to explore.
units.italian: Fanno altri tentativi di comunicare con te, ma senza successo. Alla fine rinunciano, e tutti tranne il capo se ne vanno. Il capo fa un gesto ampio verso il resto dello spazioporto, invitandoti apparentemente a esplorare.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|name|38|0
units.english: Hai Interpreter?
units.italian: Un interprete Hai?

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|description|39|0
units.english: The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. If you can find one of the Hai who is willing to interpret, perhaps you can communicate with them.
units.italian: Gli alieni a nord dello spazio Hai sembrano parlare la lingua Hai. Se riesci a trovare un Hai disposto a fare da interprete, forse potrai comunicare con loro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|log|49|0
units.english: Discovered a birdlike alien species to the north of human space. They appear to speak the Hai language in addition to their own, so with the help of a Hai interpreter it might be possible to communicate with them.
units.italian: Scoperta una specie aliena di aspetto avicolo a nord dello spazio umano. Sembrano parlare la lingua Hai oltre alla propria, quindi con l'aiuto di un interprete Hai potrebbe essere possibile comunicare con loro.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|All the other worlds belonging to this species have appeared unwilling to let you land, but here you find a slightly warmer welcome. A cloud of small, highly maneuverable patrol ships takes off from the planet as you approach and herds you onto one particular landing pad where, after a few minutes, several of the aliens approach your ship.|53|0
units.english: All the other worlds belonging to this species have appeared unwilling to let you land, but here you find a slightly warmer welcome. A cloud of small, highly maneuverable patrol ships takes off from the planet as you approach and herds you onto one particular landing pad where, after a few minutes, several of the aliens approach your ship.

Una nube di piccole navi di pattuglia, molto manovrabili, decolla dal pianeta mentre ti avvicini e ti spinge verso una piazzola di atterraggio precisa, dove dopo qualche minuto diversi alieni si avvicinano alla tua nave.

They come swooping down from the sky, circle your ship to inspect it, and then land near the hatch and wait for you to open it. They do not appear to be armed, but their talons are eight or nine centimeters long.
units.italian: Questa specie è di aspetto avicolo, ma con corpi quasi grandi quanto il tuo e ali che ti sovrastano. Scendono in picchiata dal cielo, girano intorno alla tua nave per ispezionarla, poi atterrano vicino al portello e aspettano che tu lo apra. Non sembrano armati, ma i loro artigli sono lunghi otto o nove centimetri.

units.italian: Con esitazione apri il portello e li saluti. Uno degli alieni ti parla: un suono fatto di trilli e schiocchi. Non hai idea di che cosa stia dicendo.

You shake your head to indicate that you do not understand, and again try to speak to it in your own language. Again it leans forward as if deeply focused on what you are saying.|59|0
units.english: The alien leans forward as you speak, as if trying to decipher your words. "Iyik'ka'ak kareek elik, ek karu karai kavet," it says. You shake your head to indicate that you do not understand, and again try to speak to it in your own language. Again it leans forward as if deeply focused on what you are saying.
units.italian: L'alieno si sporge in avanti mentre parli, come se cercasse di decifrare le tue parole. "Iyik'ka'ak kareek elik, ek karu karai kavet," dice. Scuoti la testa per far capire che non hai capito, e provi di nuovo a parlargli nella tua lingua. Di nuovo si sporge in avanti come se fosse profondamente concentrato su ciò che dici.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|As before, you are ushered to the ground by a flock of the small alien ships, and a few of them fly over to your ship and wait for your to come out and try to talk to them. Also as before, you do not recognize their language and they do not understand yours, although their leader seems to be focused intently on trying to understand you.|63|0
units.english: As before, you are ushered to the ground by a flock of the small alien ships, and a few of them fly over to your ship and wait for your to come out and try to talk to them. Also as before, you do not recognize their language and they do not understand yours, although their leader seems to be focused intently on trying to understand you.
units.italian: Come prima, vieni scortato a terra da uno stormo delle piccole navi aliene, e alcune di loro volano fino alla tua nave e aspettano che tu esca per provare a parlare con loro. Come prima, non riconosci la loro lingua e loro non capiscono la tua, anche se il loro capo sembra concentrato intensamente nel tentativo di capirti.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	The other aliens standing beside it are inspecting you with equal curiosity. Finally, one of them says to the leader, "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." The leader gestures in response, turning up open palms, and the second alien steps forward and begins speaking in an entirely different language. After a moment, you are startled to realize that it is speaking the language of the Hai. The difficulty it has producing the sounds lends it a rather coarse accent, but it is almost certainly Hai.|66|0
units.english: The other aliens standing beside it are inspecting you with equal curiosity. Finally, one of them says to the leader, "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." The leader gestures in response, turning up open palms, and the second alien steps forward and begins speaking in an entirely different language. After a moment, you are startled to realize that it is speaking the language of the Hai. The difficulty it has producing the sounds lends it a rather coarse accent, but it is almost certainly Hai.
units.italian: Gli altri alieni in piedi accanto a lui ti esaminano con la stessa curiosità. Alla fine uno di loro dice al capo: "Ek kalek kiro suk i'hai, sek speru siyek ka'hai esek'ru fer'ek." Il capo risponde con un gesto, aprendo i palmi, e il secondo alieno fa un passo avanti e comincia a parlare in una lingua del tutto diversa. Dopo un momento, con sorpresa ti rendi conto che sta parlando la lingua degli Hai. La difficoltà che ha nel produrre i suoni gli dà un accento piuttosto rude, ma è quasi certamente l'Hai.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	"Hai, you speak the Hai language?" you ask. You cup your hands above your ears to mimic the large, rodent-like ears of the Hai.|67|0
units.english: "Hai, you speak the Hai language?" you ask. You cup your hands above your ears to mimic the large, rodent-like ears of the Hai.
units.italian: "Hai, parli la lingua degli Hai?" chiedi. Ti metti le mani a coppa sopra le orecchie per imitare le grandi orecchie da roditore degli Hai.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	"Iy, ka'hai!" says the alien, rustling their wings in what you take as a gesture of excitement, "Speru ek ka'hai?" At the same time, though, one of the other aliens takes a step back and flexes their talons at you. It occurs to you that the Hai may or may not be viewed favorably here.|68|0
units.english: "Iy, ka'hai!" says the alien, rustling their wings in what you take as a gesture of excitement, "Speru ek ka'hai?" At the same time, though, one of the other aliens takes a step back and flexes their talons at you. It occurs to you that the Hai may or may not be viewed favorably here.
units.italian: "Iy, ka'hai!" dice l'alieno, frullando le ali in quello che interpreti come un gesto di entusiasmo, "Speru ek ka'hai?" Allo stesso tempo, però, uno degli altri alieni fa un passo indietro e ti mostra gli artigli. Ti viene in mente che gli Hai forse qui non sono visti di buon occhio.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	"Sorry, I don't speak their language."|70|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't speak their language."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non parlo la loro lingua."

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	"Are there any Hai here?"|71|0
units.english: "Are there any Hai here?"
units.italian: "Ci sono Hai qui?"

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|	The same alien speaks again, pantomiming your ship flying into the sky and then returning, and then points to your airlock and mimics your rodent-ear gesture for the Hai. You think they are telling you to go find one of the Hai who can serve as an interpreter, and bring them back here.|72|0
units.english: The same alien speaks again, pantomiming your ship flying into the sky and then returning, and then points to your airlock and mimics your rodent-ear gesture for the Hai. You think they are telling you to go find one of the Hai who can serve as an interpreter, and bring them back here.
units.italian: Lo stesso alieno parla di nuovo, mimando la tua nave che vola in cielo e poi torna, e poi indica il tuo portello e ripete per gli Hai il gesto delle orecchie da roditore. Credi che ti stia dicendo di andare a cercare uno degli Hai che possa fare da interprete e di portarlo qui.

units.id: mission:First Contact: Wanderer|dialog|75|0
units.english: Your ship is surrounded by the birdlike aliens. When you step onto the planet, one of the aliens seems to recognize you. "Ka'hai?" they seem to ask, once again mimicking the rodent-like ears of the Hai with their feathered limbs. You shake your head, for you have returned without a Hai to act as an interpreter. Maybe it would be wise to actually go to the Hai before returning to see if one will come with you.
units.italian: La tua nave è circondata dagli alieni avicoli. Quando scendi sul pianeta, uno degli alieni sembra riconoscerti. "Ka'hai?" sembrano chiedere, imitando ancora una volta con gli arti piumati le orecchie da roditore degli Hai. Scuoti la testa, perché sei tornato senza un Hai che faccia da interprete. Forse sarebbe saggio andare davvero dagli Hai prima di tornare, per vedere se qualcuno verrà con te.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. Do you want to look for someone here who could serve as an interpreter?|106|0
units.english: The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. Do you want to look for someone here who could serve as an interpreter?
units.italian: Gli alieni a nord dello spazio Hai sembrano parlare la lingua Hai. Vuoi cercare qualcuno qui che possa fare da interprete?

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	(Yes.)|110|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	(Not right now.)|112|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	(Yes.)|116|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	(No; the other Hai south of here are better suited for this.)|117|0
units.english: (No; the other Hai south of here are better suited for this.)
units.italian: (No; gli altri Hai a sud di qui sono più adatti a questo.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	You search around the spaceport for any sign of a local government. Eventually, one of the Hai approaches you. "You are lost, monkey. What is it that you are looking for?"|120|0
units.english: You search around the spaceport for any sign of a local government. Eventually, one of the Hai approaches you. "You are lost, monkey. What is it that you are looking for?"
units.italian: Cerchi per lo spazioporto qualche segno di un governo locale. Alla fine uno degli Hai ti si avvicina. "Sei perduto, scimmia. Che cosa stai cercando?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"Do you know where I can talk to an official?"|122|0
units.english: "Do you know where I can talk to an official?"
units.italian: "Sai dove posso parlare con un funzionario?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"Do you know where I could find an interpreter?"|123|0
units.english: "Do you know where I could find an interpreter?"
units.italian: "Sai dove posso trovare un interprete?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"I'm doing fine, thank you."|125|0
units.english: "I'm doing fine, thank you."
units.italian: "Sto bene, grazie mille."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	The Hai says, "If your reason for talking to our chiefs is worthwhile, then I will take you to them."|127|0
units.english: The Hai says, "If your reason for talking to our chiefs is worthwhile, then I will take you to them."
units.italian: L'Hai dice: "Se il motivo per cui vuoi parlare con i nostri capi è valido, ti ci porterò."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"I'm looking for a Hai interpreter," you say.|128|0
units.english: "I'm looking for a Hai interpreter," you say.
units.italian: "Cerco un interprete Hai," dici.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	She looks back at you quizzically. "What purpose would an interpreter serve? You can understand my words, can you not?"|130|0
units.english: She looks back at you quizzically. "What purpose would an interpreter serve? You can understand my words, can you not?"
units.italian: Ti guarda di traverso, perplessa. "A che servirebbe un interprete? Le mie parole le capisci, no?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"I need one to talk to the aliens up north from here."|132|0
units.english: "I need one to talk to the aliens up north from here."
units.italian: "Me ne serve uno per parlare con gli alieni a nord di qui."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"I think that I'll be better off finding one of the chiefs on my own."|133|0
units.english: "I think that I'll be better off finding one of the chiefs on my own."
units.italian: "Penso che farò meglio a trovare uno dei capi da solo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	The Hai scrunches up her nose. "Foolish monkey. We have already contacted those aliens; we have little use for another emissary."|135|0
units.english: The Hai scrunches up her nose. "Foolish monkey. We have already contacted those aliens; we have little use for another emissary."
units.italian: L'Hai arriccia il naso. "Scimmia sciocca. Abbiamo già contattato quegli alieni; un altro emissario ci serve a poco."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"Can you still provide an interpreter, though?"|137|0
units.english: "Can you still provide an interpreter, though?"
units.italian: "Potete comunque fornirmi un interprete?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"I understand."|138|0
units.english: "I understand."
units.italian: "Ho capito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	"You do not need an interpreter. All you need is to know that those aliens are not worth conversing with."|140|0
units.english: "You do not need an interpreter. All you need is to know that those aliens are not worth conversing with."
units.italian: "Non ti serve un interprete. Ti basta sapere che quegli alieni non valgono la pena di parlarci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	The Hai walks away, leaving you to your own devices in the spaceport.|142|0
units.english: The Hai walks away, leaving you to your own devices in the spaceport.
units.italian: L'Hai se ne va, lasciandoti a cavartela da solo nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomat|	The Hai scoffs at you. "If you do not seek for help, or seek to help, then you have no place on our worlds." She walks away, and you spend another hour searching the spaceport before giving up and heading back to your ship.|145|0
units.english: The Hai scoffs at you. "If you do not seek for help, or seek to help, then you have no place on our worlds." She walks away, and you spend another hour searching the spaceport before giving up and heading back to your ship.
units.italian: L'Hai sbuffa. "Se non cerchi aiuto, né cerchi di aiutare, allora non hai posto sui nostri mondi." Si allontana, e passi un'altra ora a girare per lo spazioporto prima di rinunciare e tornare alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|name|152|0
units.english: Hai Diplomat
units.italian: Diplomatico Hai

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|description|153|0
units.english: Travel to Hai-home to pick up a diplomat who can help you communicate with the Wanderers.
units.italian: Recati su Hai-home a prendere un diplomatico che possa aiutarti a comunicare con i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. Do you want to look for someone here who could serve as an interpreter?|165|0
units.english: The aliens north of Hai space seem to speak the Hai language. Do you want to look for someone here who could serve as an interpreter?
units.italian: Gli alieni a nord dello spazio Hai sembrano parlare la lingua Hai. Vuoi cercare qualcuno qui che possa fare da interprete?

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|	(Yes.)|167|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|	(Not right now.)|168|0
units.english: (Not right now.)
units.italian: (Non adesso.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Hai Diplomat|	You manage to contact the local governor's office, but when you speak with the governor he says, "First contact? Human, this is not a task for just any Hai. You must go to our home world, where an official ambassador can join you. I will contact them and tell them to expect you."|170|0
units.english: You manage to contact the local governor's office, but when you speak with the governor he says, "First contact? Human, this is not a task for just any Hai. You must go to our home world, where an official ambassador can join you. I will contact them and tell them to expect you."
units.italian: Riesci a contattare l'ufficio del governatore locale, ma quando parli con lui ti dice: "Primo contatto? Umano, questo non è un compito per un Hai qualsiasi. Devi andare sul nostro mondo d'origine, dove un ambasciatore ufficiale può unirsi a te. Li contatterò e dirò loro di aspettarti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|name|188|0
units.english: Wanderer Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia Wanderer

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|description|189|0
units.english: Travel to the Wanderer homeworld with a Hai ambassador who can help communicate with them.
units.italian: Recati sul mondo d'origine dei Wanderers con un ambasciatore Hai che possa aiutarti a comunicare con loro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|log|197|0
units.english: Ambassador Sayari, a Hai, served as their envoy to the human government a century ago (although no public records of this exist in human space). She has now been assigned by the Hai to be their diplomat to the Wanderers, and to serve as a translator as well.
units.italian: L'ambasciatrice Sayari, una Hai, un secolo fa è stata loro inviata presso il governo umano (anche se nello spazio umano non esistono documenti pubblici che lo attestino). Ora gli Hai le hanno assegnato l'incarico di diplomatica presso i Wanderers, e anche quello di traduttrice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|As you are approaching Hai-home, you contact the Hai government and ask if they would be willing to provide an ambassador to help you communicate with the aliens to the north, who seem to speak the Hai language. They immediately direct you to a private government hangar, where a diplomat meets you. She holds out a paw to greet you, and says, "My name is Sayari. I was the envoy to the human government, a century ago."|199|0
units.english: As you are approaching Hai-home, you contact the Hai government and ask if they would be willing to provide an ambassador to help you communicate with the aliens to the north, who seem to speak the Hai language. They immediately direct you to a private government hangar, where a diplomat meets you. She holds out a paw to greet you, and says, "My name is Sayari. I was the envoy to the human government, a century ago."
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini a Hai-home, contatti il governo Hai e chiedi se sarebbero disposti a fornire un ambasciatore che ti aiuti a comunicare con gli alieni a nord, che sembrano parlare la lingua Hai. Ti indirizzano subito verso un hangar governativo privato, dove un diplomatico ti viene incontro. Ti porge una zampa in segno di saluto e dice: "Mi chiamo Sayari. Un secolo fa ero l'inviata presso il governo umano."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	To the best of your knowledge, the Republic has never mentioned the Hai or publicly acknowledged receiving an envoy from them.|200|0
units.english: To the best of your knowledge, the Republic has never mentioned the Hai or publicly acknowledged receiving an envoy from them.
units.italian: Per quanto ne sai, la Repubblica non ha mai nominato gli Hai né ha mai ammesso pubblicamente di aver ricevuto un loro inviato.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"Wait, the human Republic knows that the Hai exist? I had heard nothing but vague rumors of your existence before I found the wormhole."|204|0
units.english: "Wait, the human Republic knows that the Hai exist? I had heard nothing but vague rumors of your existence before I found the wormhole."
units.italian: "Aspetta, la Repubblica umana sa che gli Hai esistono? Prima di trovare il cunicolo spaziale avevo sentito solo vaghe voci della vostra esistenza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"Wait, the human Republic knows that the Hai exist?"|207|0
units.english: "Wait, the human Republic knows that the Hai exist?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, la Repubblica umana sa che gli Hai esistono?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"I'm pleased to meet you. Are you willing to travel with me?"|210|0
units.english: "I'm pleased to meet you. Are you willing to travel with me?"
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerti. Sei disposta a viaggiare con me?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	She laughs, in the Hai manner: a rapid chittering sound. "Yes, the humans and the Hai both worried that too many humans would emigrate all at once if they knew of our peaceful lands. So we agreed that the Hai would be a secret, always here for the adventurous to discover, but difficult to find, so that the human immigration would be slow enough for us to gradually adjust to it."|213|0
units.english: She laughs, in the Hai manner: a rapid chittering sound. "Yes, the humans and the Hai both worried that too many humans would emigrate all at once if they knew of our peaceful lands. So we agreed that the Hai would be a secret, always here for the adventurous to discover, but difficult to find, so that the human immigration would be slow enough for us to gradually adjust to it."
units.italian: Ride, alla maniera degli Hai: un rapido suono di cinguettii. "Sì, gli umani e gli Hai temevano entrambi che troppi umani sarebbero emigrati tutti insieme se avessero saputo delle nostre terre tranquille. Così abbiamo convenuto che gli Hai sarebbero rimasti un segreto, sempre qui perché gli avventurosi li scoprissero, ma difficili da trovare, così che l'immigrazione umana fosse abbastanza lenta da permetterci di adattarci poco alla volta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"Are you the translator who will travel with me?" you ask.|214|0
units.english: "Are you the translator who will travel with me?" you ask.
units.italian: "Sei tu la traduttrice che viaggerà con me?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"Yes," she says. "If these aliens will provide a place for me, I mean to live with them permanently, an ambassador between their people and ours. I am old, and in need of a great novelty like this to make my life interesting once more." You note that the fur on her face, especially on the snout, has turned from brown to silvery gray - a sign of age in terrestrial creatures, and perhaps in the Hai as well.|216|0
units.english: "Yes," she says. "If these aliens will provide a place for me, I mean to live with them permanently, an ambassador between their people and ours. I am old, and in need of a great novelty like this to make my life interesting once more." You note that the fur on her face, especially on the snout, has turned from brown to silvery gray - a sign of age in terrestrial creatures, and perhaps in the Hai as well.
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Se questi alieni mi daranno un posto, intendo vivere con loro in modo permanente, ambasciatrice fra il loro popolo e il nostro. Sono vecchia, e ho bisogno di una grande novità come questa per rendere di nuovo interessante la mia vita." Noti che il pelo del suo viso, soprattutto sul muso, è passato dal marrone al grigio argento: un segno dell'età nelle creature terrestri, e forse anche negli Hai.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"I'm glad to have the company of such a distinguished ambassador. Let's go visit these aliens immediately!"|218|0
units.english: "I'm glad to have the company of such a distinguished ambassador. Let's go visit these aliens immediately!"
units.italian: "Sono contento di avere la compagnia di un'ambasciatrice così illustre. Andiamo subito a visitare questi alieni!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	"What if the humans want our own envoy to these aliens?"|220|0
units.english: "What if the humans want our own envoy to these aliens?"
units.italian: "E se gli umani volessero un loro inviato presso questi alieni?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|	She says, "If they prove to be friendly, I will help you to find a way to communicate with them directly, so you need not use me as an intermediary. But our first step must be to speak with them." You help her aboard your ship, and get ready to return to the alien homeworld.|221|0
units.english: She says, "If they prove to be friendly, I will help you to find a way to communicate with them directly, so you need not use me as an intermediary. But our first step must be to speak with them." You help her aboard your ship, and get ready to return to the alien homeworld.
units.italian: Dice: "Se si dimostrano amichevoli, ti aiuterò a trovare il modo di comunicare con loro direttamente, così non dovrai usare me come intermediaria. Ma il primo passo deve essere parlare con loro." La aiuti a salire sulla tua nave e ti prepari a tornare sul mondo d'origine degli alieni.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Diplomacy|dialog|227|0
units.english: Your ship is surrounded by the birdlike aliens. When you step onto the planet, one of the aliens seems to recognize you. "Ka'hai?" they seem to ask, once again mimicking the rodent-like ears of the Hai with their feathered limbs. You attempt to gesture to Sayari, but become embarrassed when you realize that you left her on one of your escorts that hasn't yet entered the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: La tua nave è circondata dagli alieni avicoli. Quando scendi sul pianeta, uno degli alieni sembra riconoscerti. "Ka'hai?" sembrano chiedere, imitando ancora una volta con gli arti piumati le orecchie da roditore degli Hai. Provi a fare un gesto verso Sayari, ma ti imbarazzi quando ti rendi conto di averla lasciata su una delle tue scorte, che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|name|233|0
units.english: Translation Machine
units.italian: Macchina per tradurre

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|description|234|0
units.english: Sayari, the Hai ambassador, suggested that you visit <destination>, where Hai technologists are working on translation machines.
units.italian: Sayari, l'ambasciatrice Hai, ti ha suggerito di visitare <destination>, dove alcuni tecnologi Hai lavorano alle macchine per tradurre.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|log|240|0
units.english: Was able to communicate with the birdlike "Wanderers" with the help of a Hai ambassador. It turns out that they have been under attack by the Unfettered Hai for some time, and have learned the Hai language by taking captives.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a comunicare con i "Wanderers" avicoli con l'aiuto di un'ambasciatrice Hai. Si scopre che sono sotto attacco degli Hai Slegati già da tempo, e che hanno imparato la lingua Hai grazie ai prigionieri.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|log|241|0
units.english: The Wanderers are a bird-like species who inhabit a small region of space adjacent to the Hai. They have been under attack by the "Unfettered" Hai for some time. The Wanderers claim to be peaceful, and most of their ships are not designed for military use.
units.italian: I Wanderers sono una specie avicola che abita una piccola regione di spazio confinante con quello degli Hai. Sono sotto attacco degli Hai "Slegati" già da tempo. I Wanderers si dichiarano pacifici, e la maggior parte delle loro navi non è progettata per uso militare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|Once again, the Wanderers allow you to land, but with a large flock of their light warships surrounding you to herd you into a particular landing zone. A small delegation of Wanderers meets you and Sayari, whom they greet hesitantly in the Hai language. She responds, and a heated exchange follows. You do not understand any of what they are saying.|243|0
units.english: Once again, the Wanderers allow you to land, but with a large flock of their light warships surrounding you to herd you into a particular landing zone. A small delegation of Wanderers meets you and Sayari, whom they greet hesitantly in the Hai language. She responds, and a heated exchange follows. You do not understand any of what they are saying.
units.italian: Ancora una volta i Wanderers ti permettono di atterrare, ma con un grande stormo delle loro navi da guerra leggere che ti circonda per spingerti in una zona di atterraggio precisa. Una piccola delegazione di Wanderers incontra te e Sayari, e saluta lei con esitazione in lingua Hai. Lei risponde, e segue uno scambio acceso. Non capisci nulla di quello che dicono.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	(Ask her what they are talking about.)|245|0
units.english: (Ask her what they are talking about.)
units.italian: (Chiedile di che cosa stanno parlando.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	(Wait for a break in the conversation.)|246|0
units.english: (Wait for a break in the conversation.)
units.italian: (Aspetta una pausa nella conversazione.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	She holds up a paw to you while speaking a few more sentences to them, then says, "They are saying that the Hai are attacking them, and they want to know why. It must be the Unfettered who are raiding them, and I am trying to explain that the Unfettered do not represent the Hai people as a whole."|247|0
units.english: She holds up a paw to you while speaking a few more sentences to them, then says, "They are saying that the Hai are attacking them, and they want to know why. It must be the Unfettered who are raiding them, and I am trying to explain that the Unfettered do not represent the Hai people as a whole."
units.italian: Alza una zampa verso di te mentre dice ancora qualche frase, poi dice: "Dicono che gli Hai li stanno attaccando, e vogliono sapere perché. Devono essere gli Slegati a depredarli, e io sto cercando di spiegare che gli Slegati non rappresentano il popolo Hai nel suo insieme."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	They continue talking for a while, and then the Wanderers ask you a question. Sayari translates, "They want to know what humans want, and why you have come to their territory."|248|0
units.english: They continue talking for a while, and then the Wanderers ask you a question. Sayari translates, "They want to know what humans want, and why you have come to their territory."
units.italian: Continuano a parlare per un po', poi i Wanderers ti rivolgono una domanda. Sayari traduce: "Vogliono sapere che cosa vogliono gli umani, e perché sei venuto nel loro territorio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	"I'm just an individual explorer. I don't represent my species or their governments."|250|0
units.english: "I'm just an individual explorer. I don't represent my species or their governments."
units.italian: "Sono solo un esploratore individuale. Non rappresento la mia specie né i suoi governi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	"My hope is that our species might both benefit from trading goods and technologies with each other."|252|0
units.english: "My hope is that our species might both benefit from trading goods and technologies with each other."
units.italian: "Spero che le nostre specie possano trarre entrambe vantaggio dallo scambio di merci e tecnologie."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	"I believe that different species should communicate with each other rather than remaining in forced isolation."|254|0
units.english: "I believe that different species should communicate with each other rather than remaining in forced isolation."
units.italian: "Credo che specie diverse dovrebbero comunicare fra loro invece di restare in un isolamento forzato."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that like you, they are travelers, and this region of space is not their home, so they will gladly welcome other sojourners here. But they warn you that if you betray their trust, you will not find that trust easy to regain. They also say..." She pauses as the Wanderers speak again, then continues translating. "They say that in their travels, they have met few species truly capable of living in peace, and they hope that yours is one of them, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."|258|0
units.english: They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that like you, they are travelers, and this region of space is not their home, so they will gladly welcome other sojourners here. But they warn you that if you betray their trust, you will not find that trust easy to regain. They also say..." She pauses as the Wanderers speak again, then continues translating. "They say that in their travels, they have met few species truly capable of living in peace, and they hope that yours is one of them, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."
units.italian: Rispondono, e Sayari traduce: "Dicono che, come te, sono viaggiatori, e che questa regione di spazio non è la loro casa, quindi accoglieranno volentieri altri ospiti qui. Ma ti avvertono che se tradisci la loro fiducia, non sarà facile riconquistarla. Dicono anche..." Si ferma mentre i Wanderers parlano di nuovo, poi continua a tradurre. "Dicono che nei loro viaggi hanno incontrato poche specie davvero capaci di vivere in pace, e sperano che la tua sia una di quelle, perché..." Di nuovo si ferma mentre i Wanderers parlano, poi dice: "Perché odiano farsi nuovi amici solo per perderli di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that they would perhaps be willing to trade with you, although to form a broader trade agreement with humans would be a serious decision and one they cannot make lightly." She pauses to listen again, and then continues, "They also say that they will discuss among themselves whether you should be given access to Wanderer technology, but again, that will not be a swiftly made decision." She pauses as the Wanderers speak again, then continues translating. "They say that in their travels, they have met few species truly capable of living in peace, and they hope that yours is one of them, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."|262|0
units.english: They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that they would perhaps be willing to trade with you, although to form a broader trade agreement with humans would be a serious decision and one they cannot make lightly." She pauses to listen again, and then continues, "They also say that they will discuss among themselves whether you should be given access to Wanderer technology, but again, that will not be a swiftly made decision." She pauses as the Wanderers speak again, then continues translating. "They say that in their travels, they have met few species truly capable of living in peace, and they hope that yours is one of them, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."
units.italian: Rispondono, e Sayari traduce: "Dicono che forse sarebbero disposti a commerciare con te, anche se stipulare un accordo commerciale più ampio con gli umani sarebbe una decisione seria, che non possono prendere alla leggera." Si ferma ad ascoltare di nuovo, poi continua: "Dicono anche che discuteranno fra loro se darti accesso alla tecnologia dei Wanderers, ma anche questa non sarà una decisione presa in fretta." Si ferma mentre i Wanderers parlano di nuovo, poi continua a tradurre. "Dicono che nei loro viaggi hanno incontrato poche specie davvero capaci di vivere in pace, e sperano che la tua sia una di quelle, perché..." Di nuovo si ferma mentre i Wanderers parlano, poi dice: "Perché odiano farsi nuovi amici solo per perderli di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that their species has encountered many other species in the past, and always has found those encounters to be valuable. Although..." She pauses to listen as the Wanderers continue speaking. "Although, they say that in their travels, far more often than they encounter living species, they instead only find themselves sifting through the refuse of a species that has destroyed itself through war or carelessness. They hope that you are not such a species, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."|266|0
units.english: They respond, and Sayari translates, "They say that their species has encountered many other species in the past, and always has found those encounters to be valuable. Although..." She pauses to listen as the Wanderers continue speaking. "Although, they say that in their travels, far more often than they encounter living species, they instead only find themselves sifting through the refuse of a species that has destroyed itself through war or carelessness. They hope that you are not such a species, because..." Again she pauses as the Wanderers speak, then says, "Because, they hate to make new friends only to lose them again."
units.italian: Rispondono, e Sayari traduce: "Dicono che la loro specie in passato ha incontrato molte altre specie, e ha sempre trovato quegli incontri preziosi. Anche se..." Si ferma ad ascoltare mentre i Wanderers continuano a parlare. "Anche se, dicono, nei loro viaggi molto più spesso che incontrare specie vive si ritrovano a frugare fra i resti di una specie che si è distrutta con la guerra o per incuria. Sperano che tu non sia una di quelle, perché..." Di nuovo si ferma mentre i Wanderers parlano, poi dice: "Perché odiano farsi nuovi amici solo per perderli di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	Speaking through Sayari, you try to reassure the Wanderers that you have peaceful intentions. They speak with her for a while longer. She tells you, "They say that I will be allowed to stay here as an ambassador, and they will also let you land on most of their worlds. But they will not welcome any other Hai into their territory. I fear that they distrust the Hai because of the actions of the Unfettered, and being associated with me may harm your chances to win their favor. For your sake, we should find a different way for you to communicate with them."|269|0
units.english: Speaking through Sayari, you try to reassure the Wanderers that you have peaceful intentions. They speak with her for a while longer. She tells you, "They say that I will be allowed to stay here as an ambassador, and they will also let you land on most of their worlds. But they will not welcome any other Hai into their territory. I fear that they distrust the Hai because of the actions of the Unfettered, and being associated with me may harm your chances to win their favor. For your sake, we should find a different way for you to communicate with them."
units.italian: Parlando tramite Sayari, cerchi di rassicurare i Wanderers sulle tue intenzioni pacifiche. Parlano ancora un po' con lei. Ti dice: "Dicono che mi sarà permesso restare qui come ambasciatrice, e che ti lasceranno atterrare sulla maggior parte dei loro mondi. Ma non accoglieranno altri Hai nel loro territorio. Temo che diffidino degli Hai per le azioni degli Slegati, e che essere associato a me possa danneggiare le tue possibilità di conquistare il loro favore. Per il tuo bene, dovremmo trovare un altro modo perché tu possa comunicare con loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	"How can we do that?"|271|0
units.english: "How can we do that?"
units.italian: "Come possiamo fare?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Translation Machine|	She says, "There are scientists on the Hai world of <planet> who develop speaking machines, to allow the Hai who do not know the human language to communicate with humans. I will write a letter asking them to give you one of these speaking machines, so that you may talk with the Wanderers without needing me as an intermediary."|272|0
units.english: She says, "There are scientists on the Hai world of <planet> who develop speaking machines, to allow the Hai who do not know the human language to communicate with humans. I will write a letter asking them to give you one of these speaking machines, so that you may talk with the Wanderers without needing me as an intermediary."
units.italian: Dice: "Ci sono scienziati sul mondo Hai di <planet> che sviluppano macchine parlanti, per permettere agli Hai che non conoscono la lingua umana di comunicare con gli umani. Scriverò una lettera chiedendo loro di darti una di queste macchine parlanti, così potrai parlare con i Wanderers senza bisogno di me come intermediaria."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|You land on <origin> and seek out the technologist that Sayari told you to contact: a Hai named Eruk. His eyes light up when you describe what you need from him, and why. "Contact with a new species! How very exciting," he says. "I am glad for Sayari that such an opportunity has been presented to her. But our speaking machines are very valuable. Before I give one to you, will you do a small favor for me?"|282|0
units.english: You land on <origin> and seek out the technologist that Sayari told you to contact: a Hai named Eruk. His eyes light up when you describe what you need from him, and why. "Contact with a new species! How very exciting," he says. "I am glad for Sayari that such an opportunity has been presented to her. But our speaking machines are very valuable. Before I give one to you, will you do a small favor for me?"
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e cerchi il tecnologo che Sayari ti ha detto di contattare: un Hai di nome Eruk. Gli occhi gli si illuminano quando gli descrivi che cosa ti serve da lui, e perché. "Contatto con una nuova specie! Che emozione," dice. "Sono contento per Sayari che le sia stata offerta un'occasione simile. Ma le nostre macchine parlanti sono molto preziose. Prima che te ne dia una, mi faresti un piccolo favore?"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"Of course. What do you need?"|284|0
units.english: "Of course. What do you need?"
units.italian: "Certo. Di che cosa hai bisogno?"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"Can't I just pay you for one?"|286|0
units.english: "Can't I just pay you for one?"
units.italian: "Non posso semplicemente pagarti per averne una?"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	He says, "The human immigrants tell me that in the region of your space they call the Deep is a space station, a library that houses human cultural artifacts and a database of human literature and history. Bring me a copy of that database, and I will give you a speaking machine."|290|0
units.english: He says, "The human immigrants tell me that in the region of your space they call the Deep is a space station, a library that houses human cultural artifacts and a database of human literature and history. Bring me a copy of that database, and I will give you a speaking machine."
units.italian: Dice: "Gli immigrati umani mi raccontano che nella regione del vostro spazio che chiamate il Deep c'è una stazione spaziale, una biblioteca che custodisce manufatti culturali umani e un database della letteratura e della storia umane. Portami una copia di quel database e ti darò una macchina parlante."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"Money?" he says, with a dismissive gesture. "What use is money? No, from you I desire something far more valuable. The human immigrants tell me that in the region of your space they call the Deep is a space station, a library that houses human cultural artifacts and a database of human literature and history. Bring me a copy of that database, and I will give you a speaking machine."|294|0
units.english: "Money?" he says, with a dismissive gesture. "What use is money? No, from you I desire something far more valuable. The human immigrants tell me that in the region of your space they call the Deep is a space station, a library that houses human cultural artifacts and a database of human literature and history. Bring me a copy of that database, and I will give you a speaking machine."
units.italian: "Denaro?" dice, con un gesto di scherno. "A che cosa serve il denaro? No, da te desidero qualcosa di molto più prezioso. Gli immigrati umani mi raccontano che nella regione del vostro spazio che chiamate il Deep c'è una stazione spaziale, una biblioteca che custodisce manufatti culturali umani e un database della letteratura e della storia umane. Portami una copia di quel database e ti darò una macchina parlante."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"No problem, I'll bring you a copy of the database as soon as I can."|301|0
units.english: "No problem, I'll bring you a copy of the database as soon as I can."
units.italian: "Nessun problema, ti porterò una copia del database il prima possibile."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"How will I convince them to give me a copy of their data?"|303|0
units.english: "How will I convince them to give me a copy of their data?"
units.italian: "Come farò a convincerli a darmi una copia dei loro dati?"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	Your question seems to utterly confuse him. "Information," he says. "It is what you call a non-rival good, is it not? When I give information, I do not lose it. Sharing it costs me nothing. The librarians, surely they will understand this. Have no fear."|304|0
units.english: Your question seems to utterly confuse him. "Information," he says. "It is what you call a non-rival good, is it not? When I give information, I do not lose it. Sharing it costs me nothing. The librarians, surely they will understand this. Have no fear."
units.italian: La tua domanda sembra confonderlo del tutto. "L'informazione," dice. "È quello che chiamate un bene non rivale, no? Quando do un'informazione non la perdo. Condividerla non mi costa nulla. I bibliotecari, di certo lo capiranno. Non temere."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"I actually already have a copy of that data."|309|0
units.english: "I actually already have a copy of that data."
units.italian: "In realtà ho già una copia di quei dati."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"You do? Please go get it!" he exclaims.|310|0
units.english: "You do? Please go get it!" he exclaims.
units.italian: "Davvero? Va' a prenderla, ti prego!" esclama.

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	You go to your ship to retrieve the data and give it to him upon returning. His eyes light up with excitement as he makes a copy of the card and returns the original to you.|311|0
units.english: You go to your ship to retrieve the data and give it to him upon returning. His eyes light up with excitement as he makes a copy of the card and returns the original to you.
units.italian: Vai alla tua nave a recuperare i dati e al ritorno glieli dai. Gli occhi gli si illuminano di eccitazione mentre fa una copia della scheda e ti restituisce l'originale.

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|You return to Eruk's workshop and give him the data card. His eyes light up with excitement as he makes a copy of the card and returns the original to you.|315|0
units.english: You return to Eruk's workshop and give him the data card. His eyes light up with excitement as he makes a copy of the card and returns the original to you.
units.italian: Torni all'officina di Eruk e gli dai la scheda dati. Gli occhi gli si illuminano di eccitazione mentre fa una copia della scheda e ti restituisce l'originale.

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"I have spent my whole life studying human culture," he says. "This is a treasure to me. And now, here is your speaking machine." He hands you a small, spherical device, with speakers and microphones mounted on it, as well as what look like camera lenses. "The device is programmed with the human and Hai languages," he says. "It is not always possible to translate perfectly between our two languages, but it will try to give you a sense of the range of meanings in what is being said."|318|0
units.english: "I have spent my whole life studying human culture," he says. "This is a treasure to me. And now, here is your speaking machine." He hands you a small, spherical device, with speakers and microphones mounted on it, as well as what look like camera lenses. "The device is programmed with the human and Hai languages," he says. "It is not always possible to translate perfectly between our two languages, but it will try to give you a sense of the range of meanings in what is being said."
units.italian: "Ho passato tutta la vita a studiare la cultura umana," dice. "Questo per me è un tesoro. E ora, ecco la tua macchina parlante." Ti porge un piccolo dispositivo sferico, con altoparlanti e microfoni montati sopra, e quello che sembra un obiettivo fotografico. "Il dispositivo è programmato con le lingue umana e Hai," dice. "Non è sempre possibile tradurre perfettamente fra le nostre due lingue, ma cercherà di darti un'idea della gamma di significati di ciò che viene detto."

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"Thank you. I'm eager to try it out!"|320|0
units.english: "Thank you. I'm eager to try it out!"
units.italian: "Grazie. Non vedo l'ora di provarla!"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	"Is there anything else I need to know?"|322|0
units.english: "Is there anything else I need to know?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcos'altro che devo sapere?"

units.id: conversation:eruk cultural data|	He humors you by demonstrating how the machine works, holding a conversation with you where he speaks in the Hai language, and the machine automatically translates for you and then translates your responses back into his language. It apparently uses its cameras to track who you are speaking to or listening to. It's an impressive piece of technology, and easy enough to use. You thank him for his help, and return to your ship.|323|0
units.english: He humors you by demonstrating how the machine works, holding a conversation with you where he speaks in the Hai language, and the machine automatically translates for you and then translates your responses back into his language. It apparently uses its cameras to track who you are speaking to or listening to. It's an impressive piece of technology, and easy enough to use. You thank him for his help, and return to your ship.
units.italian: Ti accontenta dimostrandoti come funziona la macchina: tiene una conversazione con te parlando in lingua Hai, e la macchina traduce automaticamente per te, poi traduce le tue risposte nella sua lingua. A quanto pare usa le sue fotocamere per capire con chi stai parlando o chi stai ascoltando. È un pezzo di tecnologia impressionante, e abbastanza facile da usare. Lo ringrazi per l'aiuto e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Human Cultural Archives|description|330|0
units.english: Eruk, the Hai technologist on <origin>, has agreed to give you a translation machine if you can somehow get him a copy of the human cultural data from <destination>.
units.italian: Eruk, il tecnologo Hai di <origin>, ha accettato di darti una macchina per tradurre se riesci a procurargli una copia dei dati culturali umani da <destination>.

units.id: mission:Human Cultural Archives|The station has a small museum gift shop that sells a copy of the entire archive on a data card. It only costs 40 credits, but because you have done a horrible job at managing your finances you do not have even that much cash on hand right now.|340|0
units.english: The station has a small museum gift shop that sells a copy of the entire archive on a data card. It only costs 40 credits, but because you have done a horrible job at managing your finances you do not have even that much cash on hand right now.
units.italian: La stazione ha un piccolo negozio di souvenir del museo che vende una copia dell'intero archivio su una scheda dati. Costa solo 40 crediti, ma dato che hai gestito malissimo le tue finanze non hai nemmeno quella somma a disposizione.

units.id: mission:Human Cultural Archives|	Go earn some money, then return here.|341|0
units.english: Go earn some money, then return here.
units.italian: Vai a guadagnare un po' di denaro, poi torna qui.

units.id: mission:Cultural Data to Greenwater|description|350|0
units.english: Bring a copy of the human cultural archives to <destination> in exchange for a translation machine.
units.italian: Porta una copia degli archivi culturali umani a <destination> in cambio di una macchina per tradurre.

units.id: mission:Cultural Data to Greenwater|You had wondered how you would get a copy of the entire cultural archive, but it turns out to be easier than expected. The station has a small museum gift shop, which sells a copy of the archives on a data card. ("The perfect gift for the budding historian in your family! Hold all of human history in the palm of your hand. On sale now for only 39.99!") Given that a cheap data card costs a fraction of a credit, it's a bit of a rip-off, but you gladly buy one to take back to Eruk.|357|0
units.english: You had wondered how you would get a copy of the entire cultural archive, but it turns out to be easier than expected. The station has a small museum gift shop, which sells a copy of the archives on a data card. ("The perfect gift for the budding historian in your family! Hold all of human history in the palm of your hand. On sale now for only 39.99!") Given that a cheap data card costs a fraction of a credit, it's a bit of a rip-off, but you gladly buy one to take back to Eruk.
units.italian: Ti chiedevi come avresti fatto a procurarti una copia dell'intero archivio culturale, ma si rivela più facile del previsto. La stazione ha un piccolo negozio di souvenir del museo, che vende una copia degli archivi su una scheda dati. ("Il regalo perfetto per lo storico in erba di famiglia! Tutta la storia umana nel palmo della tua mano. In offerta ora a soli 39,99!") Dato che una scheda dati economica costa una frazione di credito, è un po' una truffa, ma la compri volentieri per portarla a Eruk.

units.id: mission:Visit Wanderers Again|description|364|0
units.english: Return to the Wanderer homeworld of <destination> with a device that will allow you to converse with them more freely.
units.italian: Torna sul mondo d'origine dei Wanderers, <destination>, con un dispositivo che ti permetta di conversare con loro più liberamente.

units.id: mission:Visit Wanderers Again|log|374|0
units.english: Received a device, created by a Hai scientist, which can translate between human language and the Hai language. Since the Wanderers speak the Hai language, that should make it possible to communicate with them directly.
units.italian: Hai ricevuto un dispositivo, creato da uno scienziato Hai, che traduce fra la lingua umana e quella Hai. Dato che i Wanderers parlano la lingua Hai, dovrebbe permetterti di comunicare con loro direttamente.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|log|420|0
units.english: Spoke with a Wanderer ambassador named Iktat Rek, using the translation device. Received permission to purchase some of their technology, but not their ships.
units.italian: Hai parlato con un ambasciatore Wanderer di nome Iktat Rek, usando il dispositivo di traduzione. Hai ottenuto il permesso di acquistare parte della loro tecnologia, ma non le loro navi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|log|421|0
units.english: The Wanderers believe that their purpose in the universe is to "repair" planets whose biospheres have been ravaged by other species either through mismanagement or as a result of war. They came to their current territory through a wormhole that they call "the Eye," and they say that once their work here is done the Eye will open and lead them to a new territory and new worlds for them to care for.
units.italian: I Wanderers credono che il loro scopo nell'universo sia "riparare" i pianeti le cui biosfere sono state devastate da altre specie, per cattiva gestione o per effetto della guerra. Sono arrivati nel loro territorio attuale attraverso un cunicolo spaziale che chiamano "l'Occhio", e dicono che quando il loro lavoro qui sarà finito l'Occhio si aprirà e li condurrà a un nuovo territorio e a nuovi mondi di cui prendersi cura.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|It is possible that the worlds they currently inhabit were formerly part of Hai territory. That might explain why the Unfettered believe they have a right to take that territory back.|422|0
units.english: It is possible that the worlds they currently inhabit were formerly part of Hai territory. That might explain why the Unfettered believe they have a right to take that territory back.
units.italian: È possibile che i mondi che abitano ora facessero parte del territorio degli Hai. Questo spiegherebbe perché gli Slegati credono di avere il diritto di riprendersi quel territorio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|log|423|0
units.english: Rek is a Wanderer ambassador, a new and unusual profession among a species that until recently has had no contact with aliens except for the occasional Unfettered Hai raid. His job is to help the Wanderers develop a deeper relationship with humans.
units.italian: Rek è un ambasciatore Wanderer, una professione nuova e inconsueta per una specie che fino a poco tempo fa non aveva contatti con alieni, salvo qualche occasionale incursione degli Hai Slegati. Il suo compito è aiutare i Wanderers a sviluppare un rapporto più profondo con gli umani.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|With the help of your new translation device, you are able to contact the Wanderer government. They welcome you back and tell you that a Wanderer named "Iktat Rek" has been appointed as the official envoy to deal with human visitors, and he should be arriving at your landing pad shortly.|426|0
units.english: With the help of your new translation device, you are able to contact the Wanderer government. They welcome you back and tell you that a Wanderer named "Iktat Rek" has been appointed as the official envoy to deal with human visitors, and he should be arriving at your landing pad shortly.
units.italian: Con l'aiuto del tuo nuovo dispositivo di traduzione riesci a contattare il governo dei Wanderers. Ti danno di nuovo il benvenuto e ti dicono che un Wanderer di nome "Iktat Rek" è stato nominato inviato ufficiale per trattare con i visitatori umani, e che arriverà presto alla tua piazzola di atterraggio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	Rek is slightly larger than most of the Wanderers you have seen, with muted white and brown plumage and a calm, dignified bearing. "It is very [rare, exceptional] in our history that we have to [deal with, cope with] other species," he says, "and now we find ourselves dealing with two at once." He is speaking the Hai language, and the translation device does its best to render his words in your own language.|427|0
units.english: Rek is slightly larger than most of the Wanderers you have seen, with muted white and brown plumage and a calm, dignified bearing. "It is very [rare, exceptional] in our history that we have to [deal with, cope with] other species," he says, "and now we find ourselves dealing with two at once." He is speaking the Hai language, and the translation device does its best to render his words in your own language.
units.italian: Rek è leggermente più grande della maggior parte dei Wanderers che hai visto, con un piumaggio bianco e bruno dai toni smorzati e un portamento calmo e dignitoso. "È molto [raro, eccezionale] nella nostra storia dover [trattare con, convivere con] altre specie," dice, "e ora ci troviamo a trattare con due contemporaneamente." Parla la lingua Hai, e il dispositivo di traduzione fa del suo meglio per rendere le sue parole nella tua lingua.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"How did you learn the Hai language?"|429|0
units.english: "How did you learn the Hai language?"
units.italian: "Come avete imparato la lingua Hai?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"How long have you been fighting the Unfettered Hai?"|431|0
units.english: "How long have you been fighting the Unfettered Hai?"
units.italian: "Da quanto tempo combattete contro gli Hai Slegati?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"It has been nearly twenty [years, cycles] now," he says. "At first only a single Hai ship [visited, invaded] us, but back then we had no defenses in place to stop it. For years the ship only [harvested, stole] food from our frontier worlds, and avoided combat. In our culture it is an [obligation, duty] to share our food with one who [asks for, demands] it, so we did not oppose the Hai ship. But then more Hai ships came, attacked one of our worlds and took it for themselves, and killed many of our people. We built warships and drove them back, and yet their [raids, attacks] still continue."|433|0
units.english: "It has been nearly twenty [years, cycles] now," he says. "At first only a single Hai ship [visited, invaded] us, but back then we had no defenses in place to stop it. For years the ship only [harvested, stole] food from our frontier worlds, and avoided combat. In our culture it is an [obligation, duty] to share our food with one who [asks for, demands] it, so we did not oppose the Hai ship. But then more Hai ships came, attacked one of our worlds and took it for themselves, and killed many of our people. We built warships and drove them back, and yet their [raids, attacks] still continue."
units.italian: "Sono passati quasi venti [anni, cicli] ormai," dice. "All'inizio ci [ha visitato, ci ha invaso] una sola nave Hai, ma allora non avevamo difese in grado di fermarla. Per anni quella nave si è limitata a [raccogliere, rubare] cibo dai nostri mondi di frontiera, ed evitava il combattimento. Nella nostra cultura è un [obbligo, dovere] condividere il cibo con chi [lo chiede, lo pretende], quindi non ci siamo opposti alla nave Hai. Ma poi sono arrivate altre navi, hanno attaccato uno dei nostri mondi e se ne sono impadronite, uccidendo molti della nostra gente. Abbiamo costruito navi da guerra e li abbiamo respinti, eppure le loro [incursioni, attacchi] continuano."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"Recently we managed to [take, capture] some of them as prisoners," he says. "They have been [raiding, visiting] us for twenty [years, cycles]. At first they only stole unguarded stores of food, and fled if we approached. We allowed them to take it, because in our culture it is a [duty, obligation] to share our food with those who [ask for, demand] it. But recently they have become far more [aggressive, desperate]. They captured one of our worlds and killed many Wanderers, and we built warships and drove them back. Some of them tried to hide on the planet, and we made them our [prisoners, guests] and slowly learned their language."|437|0
units.english: "Recently we managed to [take, capture] some of them as prisoners," he says. "They have been [raiding, visiting] us for twenty [years, cycles]. At first they only stole unguarded stores of food, and fled if we approached. We allowed them to take it, because in our culture it is a [duty, obligation] to share our food with those who [ask for, demand] it. But recently they have become far more [aggressive, desperate]. They captured one of our worlds and killed many Wanderers, and we built warships and drove them back. Some of them tried to hide on the planet, and we made them our [prisoners, guests] and slowly learned their language."
units.italian: "Di recente siamo riusciti a [prendere, catturare] alcuni di loro come prigionieri," dice. "Ci [predano, visitano] da venti [anni, cicli]. All'inizio rubavano solo scorte di cibo incustodite, e fuggivano se ci avvicinavamo. Abbiamo lasciato che lo prendessero, perché nella nostra cultura è un [dovere, obbligo] condividere il cibo con chi [chiede, pretende]. Ma di recente sono diventati molto più [aggressivi, disperati]. Hanno conquistato uno dei nostri mondi e ucciso molti Wanderers, e noi abbiamo costruito navi da guerra e li abbiamo respinti. Alcuni hanno cercato di nascondersi sul pianeta, e li abbiamo resi nostri [prigionieri, ospiti] e poco alla volta abbiamo imparato la loro lingua."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"Do you know what the Unfettered want?" you ask.|439|0
units.english: "Do you know what the Unfettered want?" you ask.
units.italian: "Sapete che cosa vogliono gli Slegati?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"They want food, and [land, elbowroom]," says Rek. "This we guessed when they first raided us, and the Hai named Sayari has confirmed this to me, that the Unfettered have [squandered, consumed] their own worlds and now make war to gain others."|440|0
units.english: "They want food, and [land, elbowroom]," says Rek. "This we guessed when they first raided us, and the Hai named Sayari has confirmed this to me, that the Unfettered have [squandered, consumed] their own worlds and now make war to gain others."
units.italian: "Vogliono cibo, e [terra, spazio]," dice Rek. "Lo abbiamo intuito quando ci hanno fatto la prima incursione, e l'Hai di nome Sayari me lo ha confermato: gli Slegati hanno [dissipato, consumato] i propri mondi e ora fanno la guerra per averne altri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"What is the history of your species?"|442|0
units.english: "What is the history of your species?"
units.italian: "Qual è la storia della vostra specie?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"How long have the Wanderers been in this region of space?"|444|0
units.english: "How long have the Wanderers been in this region of space?"
units.italian: "Da quanto tempo i Wanderers sono in questa regione di spazio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"It is now nearly ten thousand [years, cycles] since we passed through the Eye and entered this [region, territory]," he says.|445|0
units.english: "It is now nearly ten thousand [years, cycles] since we passed through the Eye and entered this [region, territory]," he says.
units.italian: "Sono passati ormai quasi diecimila [anni, cicli] da quando abbiamo attraversato l'Occhio ed è entrati in questa [regione, territorio]," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"We are an ancient people," he says. "This [region, territory] is not our homeland. We came here through the Eye nearly ten thousand [years, cycles] ago."|448|0
units.english: "We are an ancient people," he says. "This [region, territory] is not our homeland. We came here through the Eye nearly ten thousand [years, cycles] ago."
units.italian: "Siamo un popolo antico," dice. "Questa [regione, territorio] non è la nostra terra d'origine. Siamo arrivati qui attraverso l'Occhio quasi diecimila [anni, cicli] fa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"The Eye?" you ask.|450|0
units.english: "The Eye?" you ask.
units.italian: "L'Occhio?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"A wormhole," he says. "Once in an [eon, era] the Eye opens, and the Wanderers journey through it to a new home. Since the time of our oldest [history, legends] it has been so. A hundred times, maybe a thousand, we have left one home and journeyed to another. Each new home the Eye brings us to is full of [devastation, destruction], and it takes many lifetimes to set things right. Then the Eye beckons again, and we move on. And each time we pass through the Eye we become something new."|451|0
units.english: "A wormhole," he says. "Once in an [eon, era] the Eye opens, and the Wanderers journey through it to a new home. Since the time of our oldest [history, legends] it has been so. A hundred times, maybe a thousand, we have left one home and journeyed to another. Each new home the Eye brings us to is full of [devastation, destruction], and it takes many lifetimes to set things right. Then the Eye beckons again, and we move on. And each time we pass through the Eye we become something new."
units.italian: "Un cunicolo spaziale," dice. "Una volta ogni [eone, era] l'Occhio si apre, e i Wanderers lo attraversano verso una nuova casa. Così è fin dai tempi della nostra più antica [storia, leggenda]. Cento volte, forse mille, abbiamo lasciato una casa e viaggiati verso un'altra. Ogni nuova casa in cui l'Occhio ci conduce è piena di [devastazione, distruzione], e servono molte vite per rimettere le cose a posto. Poi l'Occhio ci chiama di nuovo, e ripartiamo. E ogni volta che attraversiamo l'Occhio diventiamo qualcosa di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"Why would you travel through the wormhole, if you are leaving fruitful worlds you have worked hard to develop, and only ruined worlds await you on the other side?"|453|0
units.english: "Why would you travel through the wormhole, if you are leaving fruitful worlds you have worked hard to develop, and only ruined worlds await you on the other side?"
units.italian: "Perché attraversare il cunicolo, se lasciate mondi fertili che avete faticato a sviluppare e dall'altra parte vi aspettano solo mondi in rovina?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"What do you mean, you become something new?"|455|0
units.english: "What do you mean, you become something new?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete dire con 'diventate qualcosa di nuovo'?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"The first generation of Wanderers that passes through the wormhole [receive, undergo] the Molt," says Iktat Rek. "They are altered in their [being, essence] and become [giants, people of renown]. Those who stay behind in the safety of the old worlds remain only themselves, and slowly diminish. So all Wanderers who have [courage, ambition] yearn for the Eye to open so our species may once again [grow, evolve]."|456|0
units.english: "The first generation of Wanderers that passes through the wormhole [receive, undergo] the Molt," says Iktat Rek. "They are altered in their [being, essence] and become [giants, people of renown]. Those who stay behind in the safety of the old worlds remain only themselves, and slowly diminish. So all Wanderers who have [courage, ambition] yearn for the Eye to open so our species may once again [grow, evolve]."
units.italian: "La prima generazione di Wanderers che attraversa il cunicolo [riceve, subisce] la Muta," dice Iktat Rek. "Sono alterati nel loro [essere, essenza] e diventano [giganti, gente di fama]. Chi resta indietro nella sicurezza dei vecchi mondi resta solo se stesso, e piano piano si spegne. Perciò tutti i Wanderers che hanno [coraggio, ambizione] desiderano che l'Occhio si apra, così che la nostra specie possa di nuovo [crescere, evolvere]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"The reason we travel through the Eye is that those who [remain behind, settle] in the easy life on the worlds that need no further [healing, repair] are diminished. But those that pass through the Eye and face the challenge of new worlds undergo the Molt. They are altered in their [being, essence] and become [giants, people of renown]. So all Wanderers who have [courage, ambition] yearn for the Eye to open so our species may once again [grow, evolve]."|459|0
units.english: "The reason we travel through the Eye is that those who [remain behind, settle] in the easy life on the worlds that need no further [healing, repair] are diminished. But those that pass through the Eye and face the challenge of new worlds undergo the Molt. They are altered in their [being, essence] and become [giants, people of renown].
