So all Wanderers who have [courage, ambition] yearn for the Eye to open so our species may once again [grow, evolve]."
units.italian: "Il motivo per cui attraversiamo l'Occhio è che coloro che [restano indietro, si stabiliscono] nella vita facile dei mondi che non hanno più bisogno di [guarigione, riparazione] si riducono. Ma chi attraversa l'Occhio e affronta la sfida di nuovi mondi subisce la Muta. Sono alterati nel loro [essere, essenza] e diventano [giganti, gente di fama]. Perciò tutti i Wanderers che hanno [coraggio, ambizione] desiderano che l'Occhio si apra, così che la nostra specie possa di nuovo [crescere, evolvere]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"What makes the wormhole open? Who or what controls it?"|462|0
units.english: "What makes the wormhole open? Who or what controls it?"
units.italian: "Che cosa fa aprire il cunicolo? Chi o che cosa lo controlla?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"Why does the Molt happen? How does it work?"|463|0
units.english: "Why does the Molt happen? How does it work?"
units.italian: "Perché avviene la Muta? Come funziona?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	"Those are questions that we do not ask," he says. "It is a [taboo? religion? mystery?] for us."|464|0
units.english: "Those are questions that we do not ask," he says. "It is a [taboo? religion? mystery?] for us."
units.italian: "Sono domande che non ci poniamo," dice. "Per noi è un [tabù? religione? mistero?]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Conversation|	You ask a few other questions, but do not gain much more information. He does mention that the other Wanderer worlds have agreed to sell you some of their technology, and that you will be allowed to "[view, admire, envy]" their ships, but not to purchase them. You thank him for his time and his willingness to trust a member of an entirely unknown species, and return to your ship.|465|0
units.english: You ask a few other questions, but do not gain much more information. He does mention that the other Wanderer worlds have agreed to sell you some of their technology, and that you will be allowed to "[view, admire, envy]" their ships, but not to purchase them. You thank him for his time and his willingness to trust a member of an entirely unknown species, and return to your ship.
units.italian: Fai qualche altra domanda, ma non ottieni molte altre informazioni. Ti dice però che gli altri mondi Wanderer hanno accettato di venderti parte della loro tecnologia, e che ti sarà permesso di "[guardare, ammirare, invidiare]" le loro navi, ma non di comprarle. Lo ringrazi per il tempo che ti ha dedicato e per la disponibilità a fidarsi di un membro di una specie del tutto sconosciuta, e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|log|514|0
units.english: There is a Pug world close to Wanderer space. Given their ability to control wormholes, it is likely that they are the ones who have been controlling where the Wanderers go and when. But, the Wanderers are not particularly disturbed by this information.
units.italian: C'è un mondo dei Pug vicino allo spazio dei Wanderers. Dato che sono in grado di controllare i cunicoli spaziali, è probabile che siano loro a decidere dove e quando vanno i Wanderers. I Wanderers, però, non sembrano particolarmente turbati da questa informazione.

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|You have discovered that there is a Pug outpost north of Wanderer space. Since the Pug are known to be able to control wormholes, it is likely that they are the ones that control where and when the Wanderers travel to new worlds. Do you want to tell Iktat Rek about this?|516|0
units.english: You have discovered that there is a Pug outpost north of Wanderer space. Since the Pug are known to be able to control wormholes, it is likely that they are the ones that control where and when the Wanderers travel to new worlds. Do you want to tell Iktat Rek about this?
units.italian: Hai scoperto che c'è un avamposto dei Pug a nord dello spazio dei Wanderers. Dato che i Pug sono noti per la capacità di controllare i cunicoli spaziali, è probabile che siano loro a decidere dove e quando i Wanderers si spostano verso nuovi mondi. Vuoi dirlo a Iktat Rek?

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	(Yes.)|518|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	(No.)|519|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	You meet with Rek and explain that the Pug are a species known for interfering in the affairs of others, and that you suspect that they are the ones who open the wormhole that causes the whole Wanderer species to migrate. Rek seems unfazed by this information. "I hope you will do nothing to [anger, offend] them," he says.|521|0
units.english: You meet with Rek and explain that the Pug are a species known for interfering in the affairs of others, and that you suspect that they are the ones who open the wormhole that causes the whole Wanderer species to migrate. Rek seems unfazed by this information. "I hope you will do nothing to [anger, offend] them," he says.
units.italian: Incontri Rek e gli spieghi che i Pug sono una specie nota per intromettersi negli affari altrui, e che sospetti che siano loro ad aprire il cunicolo che spinge l'intera specie dei Wanderers a migrare. Rek sembra imperturbabile. "Spero che non farete nulla per [farli arrabbiare, offenderli]," dice.

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"Of course, but doesn't it bother you that they are controlling your species?"|523|0
units.english: "Of course, but doesn't it bother you that they are controlling your species?"
units.italian: "Certo, ma non vi disturba che stiano controllando la vostra specie?"

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"They are manipulating your whole species, using you as a planetary cleanup crew. Don't you want to be free from their control?"|524|0
units.english: "They are manipulating your whole species, using you as a planetary cleanup crew. Don't you want to be free from their control?"
units.italian: "Stanno manipolando tutta la vostra specie, usandovi come squadra di pulizia planetaria. Non volete essere liberi dal loro controllo?"

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	His feathers ruffle up a bit in response to your comment, but all he says is, "It is a great [gift, blessing] to our species that the Eye leads us to new lands and new challenges whenever we become [complacent, bored]. If another species gains some [advantage, benefit] from our work as well, should that not make us more [glad, eager] to do that work, rather than less?"|525|0
units.english: His feathers ruffle up a bit in response to your comment, but all he says is, "It is a great [gift, blessing] to our species that the Eye leads us to new lands and new challenges whenever we become [complacent, bored]. If another species gains some [advantage, benefit] from our work as well, should that not make us more [glad, eager] to do that work, rather than less?"
units.italian: Le sue piume si arruffano un po' in risposta al tuo commento, ma dice solo: "È un grande [dono, benedizione] per la nostra specie che l'Occhio ci conduca verso nuove terre e nuove sfide ogni volta che diventiamo [compiaciuti, annoiati]. Se un'altra specie ricava qualche [vantaggio, beneficio] dal nostro lavoro, non dovrebbe forse renderci più [contenti, desiderosi] di farlo, invece che meno?"

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"But wouldn't you rather be free from their control, free to remain on these worlds you have worked so hard to restore?"|527|0
units.english: "But wouldn't you rather be free from their control, free to remain on these worlds you have worked so hard to restore?"
units.italian: "Ma non preferireste essere liberi dal loro controllo, liberi di restare su questi mondi che avete faticato tanto a restaurare?"

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"If your species is being secretly controlled by another, doesn't that bother you?"|528|0
units.english: "If your species is being secretly controlled by another, doesn't that bother you?"
units.italian: "Se la vostra specie è controllata di nascosto da un'altra, non vi disturba?"

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"Alright. I understand. It's just that I would be concerned if my species were being controlled in this way."|529|0
units.english: "Alright. I understand. It's just that I would be concerned if my species were being controlled in this way."
units.italian: "Va bene. Ho capito. È solo che mi preoccuperei se la mia specie fosse controllata in questo modo."

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	"Are we being controlled," he says, "or is it a partnership? We have gifts for making [ruined, corrupted] worlds bloom with new life. They give us worlds where our gifts can be [put to use, valuable]. We need new challenges to drive our species to greater [transformation, perfection]. They open new galaxies to us."|530|0
units.english: "Are we being controlled," he says, "or is it a partnership? We have gifts for making [ruined, corrupted] worlds bloom with new life. They give us worlds where our gifts can be [put to use, valuable]. We need new challenges to drive our species to greater [transformation, perfection]. They open new galaxies to us."
units.italian: "Siamo controllati," dice, "o è una collaborazione? Noi abbiamo il dono di far rifiorire di nuova vita i mondi [in rovina, corrotti]. Loro ci danno mondi dove i nostri doni possono essere [messi a frutto, preziosi]. Noi abbiamo bisogno di nuove sfide per spingere la nostra specie verso una maggiore [trasformazione, perfezione]. Loro ci aprono nuove galassie."

units.id: mission:Tell Wanderers about the Pug|	He pauses, and then says, "Of course we know that how the Eye works is too [convenient, tailor-made] to be a random phenomenon. But it is a [gift, blessing] to us, and you must do nothing to drive them away, or we will be [trapped, stranded] on these few worlds and will stagnate and decline."|531|0
units.english: He pauses, and then says, "Of course we know that how the Eye works is too [convenient, tailor-made] to be a random phenomenon. But it is a [gift, blessing] to us, and you must do nothing to drive them away, or we will be [trapped, stranded] on these few worlds and will stagnate and decline."
units.italian: Si ferma, poi dice: "Certo sappiamo che il modo in cui funziona l'Occhio è troppo [favorevole, su misura] per essere un fenomeno casuale. Ma è un [dono, benedizione] per noi, e non dovete fare nulla per allontanarli, altrimenti resteremo [intrappolati, bloccati] su questi pochi mondi e ristagneremo e decadremo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|name|536|0
units.english: Wanderer supplies to <planet>
units.italian: Rifornimenti Wanderer per <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|description|537|0
units.english: Transport <cargo> to <destination>, where repairs are needed from Unfettered attacks.
units.italian: Trasporta <cargo> a <destination>, dove servono riparazioni dopo gli attacchi degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|Walking around the spaceport, you are approached by two Wanderers. One of them begins speaking in the Hai language, which your translator picks up. "Greetings, [stranger, curiosity]. We heard you are capable of [providing, gifting] help. Is this correct?"|549|0
units.english: Walking around the spaceport, you are approached by two Wanderers. One of them begins speaking in the Hai language, which your translator picks up. "Greetings, [stranger, curiosity]. We heard you are capable of [providing, gifting] help. Is this correct?"
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, due Wanderers ti si avvicinano. Uno di loro comincia a parlare in lingua Hai, che il tuo traduttore capta. "Salute, [forestiero, curioso]. Abbiamo saputo che sei capace di [offrire, donare] aiuto. È corretto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Yes it is. What do you need?"|551|0
units.english: "Yes it is. What do you need?"
units.italian: "Sì, è così. Di che cosa avete bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Depends on how much you are willing to pay."|553|0
units.english: "Depends on how much you are willing to pay."
units.italian: "Dipende da quanto siete disposti a pagare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"What do you mean?"|555|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa volete dire?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Ambassador Sayari mentioned humans do many [jobs, hobbies] in their space. Or are we mistaken?"|560|0
units.english: "Ambassador Sayari mentioned humans do many [jobs, hobbies] in their space. Or are we mistaken?"
units.italian: "L'ambasciatrice Sayari ha detto che gli umani fanno molti [lavori, passatempi] nel loro spazio. O sbagliamo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Indeed we do."|562|0
units.english: "Indeed we do."
units.italian: "In effetti è così."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"We only do those jobs to get paid."|564|0
units.english: "We only do those jobs to get paid."
units.italian: "Facciamo quei lavori solo per essere pagati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Ambassador Sayari mentioned you are great [hero, explorer] in human space, and solved many [issues, disasters]. Or are we mistaken?"|567|0
units.english: "Ambassador Sayari mentioned you are great [hero, explorer] in human space, and solved many [issues, disasters]. Or are we mistaken?"
units.italian: "L'ambasciatrice Sayari ha detto che sei un grande [eroe, esploratore] nello spazio umano, e che hai risolto molti [problemi, disastri]. O sbagliamo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Ambassador Sayari mentioned you are great [hero, explorer], even in Hai space, and solved many [issues, disasters]. Or are we mistaken?"|570|0
units.english: "Ambassador Sayari mentioned you are great [hero, explorer], even in Hai space, and solved many [issues, disasters]. Or are we mistaken?"
units.italian: "L'ambasciatrice Sayari ha detto che sei un grande [eroe, esploratore], anche nello spazio Hai, e che hai risolto molti [problemi, disastri]. O sbagliamo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"I guess I could be considered a hero."|574|0
units.english: "I guess I could be considered a hero."
units.italian: "Suppongo che si possa dire che sono un eroe."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Calling me a 'great' hero would be an understatement."|576|0
units.english: "Calling me a 'great' hero would be an understatement."
units.italian: "Definirmi un 'grande' eroe sarebbe riduttivo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"That's me, but I would prefer some payment as well."|578|0
units.english: "That's me, but I would prefer some payment as well."
units.italian: "Sono io, ma preferirei anche un po' di pagamento."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	The speaking Wanderer looks at you with a blank expression, and simply says, "There can be [compensation, arrangements] of <payment> for the work.|581|0
units.english: The speaking Wanderer looks at you with a blank expression, and simply says, "There can be [compensation, arrangements] of <payment> for the work.
units.italian: Il Wanderer che parla ti guarda con un'espressione vuota e dice semplicemente: "Ci può essere [compenso, un accordo] di <payment> per il lavoro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"At the [body, planet] named Vara Ke'sok, there are [raids, conquests] by Unfettered that take place. During these, various structures get [damaged, hurt]. We wish you to help [fix, mend] these by carrying <tons> of [supplies, materials]."|583|0
units.english: "At the [body, planet] named Vara Ke'sok, there are [raids, conquests] by Unfettered that take place. During these, various structures get [damaged, hurt]. We wish you to help [fix, mend] these by carrying <tons> of [supplies, materials]."
units.italian: "Sul [corpo celeste, pianeta] chiamato Vara Ke'sok ci sono [incursioni, conquiste] degli Slegati. Durante queste, varie strutture vengono [danneggiate, rovinate]. Vorremmo che ci aiutassi a [ripararle, sistemarle] trasportando <tons> di [provviste, materiali]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"I'd be happy to do that."|585|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to do that."
units.italian: "Lo farò volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	"Sorry, but I have more important matters to attend to."|586|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I have more important matters to attend to."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma ho cose più importanti a cui pensare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok Hint|	When the Wanderer hears your translated response, they chatter in the Wanderer language to their friend, who nods and runs off towards a nearby warehouse. "We will load the cargo into the ship soon. I will [join, accompany] you to <planet> to direct the [healing, repairs]."|588|0
units.english: When the Wanderer hears your translated response, they chatter in the Wanderer language to their friend, who nods and runs off towards a nearby warehouse. "We will load the cargo into the ship soon. I will [join, accompany] you to <planet> to direct the [healing, repairs]."
units.italian: Quando il Wanderer sente la tua risposta tradotta, cinguetta nella lingua dei Wanderers con il suo compagno, che annuisce e corre verso un magazzino vicino. "Caricheremo il carico sulla nave presto. Ti [accompagnerò, seguirò] fino a <planet> per dirigere [la guarigione, le riparazioni]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|name|598|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|description|599|0
units.english: Defend <planet> from an Unfettered attack by driving off or destroying the Hai ships.
units.italian: Difendi <planet> da un attacco degli Slegati respingendo o distruggendo le navi Hai.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|Soon after you land in the spaceport, there is a flurry of activity as many of the Wanderers fly to their ships, which begin to take off from the planet. In the sky, you see bright flashes that may be distant weapons fire or explosions.|611|0
units.english: Soon after you land in the spaceport, there is a flurry of activity as many of the Wanderers fly to their ships, which begin to take off from the planet. In the sky, you see bright flashes that may be distant weapons fire or explosions.
units.italian: Poco dopo che atterri nello spazioporto c'è un gran trambusto: molti Wanderers corrono alle loro navi, che cominciano a decollare dal pianeta. In cielo vedi lampi luminosi che potrebbero essere colpi di arma o esplosioni lontane.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	You are buffeted by wind as one of the Wanderers lands next to your ship and says, in the Hai language, "Unfettered [raider, pirate] fleet comes. We have put food on freighter, hope they take [offering, gift] and leave. If not [appeased, satisfied] you help convince them to leave. Yes?"|612|0
units.english: You are buffeted by wind as one of the Wanderers lands next to your ship and says, in the Hai language, "Unfettered [raider, pirate] fleet comes. We have put food on freighter, hope they take [offering, gift] and leave. If not [appeased, satisfied] you help convince them to leave. Yes?"
units.italian: Sei investito dal vento quando uno dei Wanderers atterra accanto alla tua nave e dice, in lingua Hai: "Una flotta di [predoni, pirati] Slegati sta arrivando. Abbiamo messo del cibo su un mercantile, speriamo che prendano [l'offerta, il dono] e se ne vadano. Se non sono [placidati, soddisfatti], tu aiuti a convincerli ad andarsene. Sì?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|Touching down onto the planet, several Wanderers gather around your ship and prepare to carry the cargo out of your ship. Before the Wanderer you transported to <planet> can say a word, a shrill bird cry fills the air.|615|0
units.english: Touching down onto the planet, several Wanderers gather around your ship and prepare to carry the cargo out of your ship. Before the Wanderer you transported to <planet> can say a word, a shrill bird cry fills the air.
units.italian: Toccato il suolo, diversi Wanderers si radunano intorno alla tua nave e si preparano a portare fuori il carico. Prima che il Wanderer che hai trasportato fino a <planet> possa dire una parola, un grido d'uccello acuto riempie l'aria.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	Looking around, you suddenly see a flurry of activity as many of the Wanderers fly to their ships, which begin to take off from the planet. In the sky, you see bright flashes that may be distant weapons fire or explosions.|616|0
units.english: Looking around, you suddenly see a flurry of activity as many of the Wanderers fly to their ships, which begin to take off from the planet. In the sky, you see bright flashes that may be distant weapons fire or explosions.
units.italian: Guardandoti intorno, vedi improvvisamente un gran trambusto: molti Wanderers corrono alle loro navi, che cominciano a decollare dal pianeta. In cielo vedi lampi luminosi che potrebbero essere colpi di arma o esplosioni lontane.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	The Wanderer that tasked you to carry the construction materials speaks up. "Unfettered [raider, pirate] fleet comes. We will put food on freighter, hope they take [offering, gift] and leave. If not [appeased, satisfied] you help convince them to leave. [Understand, empathize]?"|617|0
units.english: The Wanderer that tasked you to carry the construction materials speaks up. "Unfettered [raider, pirate] fleet comes. We will put food on freighter, hope they take [offering, gift] and leave. If not [appeased, satisfied] you help convince them to leave. [Understand, empathize]?"
units.italian: Il Wanderer che ti aveva affidato il trasporto dei materiali da costruzione prende la parola. "Una flotta di [predoni, pirati] Slegati sta arrivando. Metteremo del cibo su un mercantile, speriamo che prendano [l'offerta, il dono] e se ne vadano. Se non sono [placidati, soddisfatti], tu aiuti a convincerli ad andarsene. [Capisci, comprendi]?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	"I will help drive the Unfettered away."|619|0
units.english: "I will help drive the Unfettered away."
units.italian: "Aiuterò a scacciare gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	"Why do I need to help? I only accepted a transport mission."|621|0
units.english: "Why do I need to help? I only accepted a transport mission."
units.italian: "Perché devo aiutare? Ho accettato solo una missione di trasporto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	The Wanderer seems slightly taken aback by your response. "Imminent [danger, aggression]. The Unfettered bring [devastation, destruction]. Many [losses, crop failures] if you do not help. Will you aid us now?"|622|0
units.english: The Wanderer seems slightly taken aback by your response. "Imminent [danger, aggression]. The Unfettered bring [devastation, destruction]. Many [losses, crop failures] if you do not help. Will you aid us now?"
units.italian: Il Wanderer sembra un po' colto di sorpresa dalla tua risposta. "[Pericolo, Aggressione] imminente. Gli Slegati portano [devastazione, distruzione]. Molte [perdite, perdite di raccolti] se non ci aiuti. Ci aiuterai ora?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	"Yes, I will help drive the Unfettered away."|625|0
units.english: "Yes, I will help drive the Unfettered away."
units.italian: "Sì, aiuterò a scacciare gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	"No, I will not help you fight them."|627|0
units.english: "No, I will not help you fight them."
units.italian: "No, non vi aiuterò a combatterli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	The Wanderer flies off to join the defense effort. A few hours later, the flashes in the sky end; the Unfettered have either been destroyed, or have gotten what they wanted and left.|628|0
units.english: The Wanderer flies off to join the defense effort. A few hours later, the flashes in the sky end; the Unfettered have either been destroyed, or have gotten what they wanted and left.
units.italian: Il Wanderer vola via per unirsi alla difesa. Qualche ora dopo i lampi in cielo finiscono: gli Slegati sono stati distrutti, oppure hanno ottenuto ciò che volevano e se ne sono andati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|	The Wanderer leaves to join one of the ships that is taking off, and you quickly ready your own ship to follow...|631|0
units.english: The Wanderer leaves to join one of the ships that is taking off, and you quickly ready your own ship to follow...
units.italian: Il Wanderer se ne va per unirsi a una delle navi che stanno decollando, e tu prepari in fretta la tua nave a seguirlo...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defend Vara Ke'sok|dialog|637|0
units.english: There are still Unfettered warships overhead. You should take off again and assist in the fight.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi da guerra degli Slegati là sopra. Dovresti decollare di nuovo e dare una mano nello scontro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok|name|685|0
units.english: Report to <planet>
units.italian: Presentati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok|description|686|0
units.english: Report to the Wanderer elders on <destination> that the Unfettered attacks are intensifying and moving farther in from the front.
units.italian: Presentati agli anziani dei Wanderers su <destination> per riferire che gli attacchi degli Slegati si stanno intensificando e avanzano sempre più in profondità rispetto al fronte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok|log|693|0
units.english: Helped to defend a Wanderer world against a raid by Unfettered Hai ships.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a difendere un mondo dei Wanderers da un'incursione delle navi degli Hai Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Defended Vara Ke'sok|One of the Wanderers thanks you for your assistance. "These foes become more [dangerous, aggressive]," it says. "You will report to [leaders, elders] on <planet>. They must decide our [action, response]."|695|0
units.english: One of the Wanderers thanks you for your assistance. "These foes become more [dangerous, aggressive]," it says. "You will report to [leaders, elders] on <planet>. They must decide our [action, response]."
units.italian: Uno dei Wanderers ti ringrazia per l'aiuto. "Questi nemici diventano più [pericolosi, aggressivi]," dice. "Ti presenterai ai [capi, anziani] su <planet>. Devono decidere la nostra [azione, risposta]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|name|701|0
units.english: Unfettered Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con gli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|description|702|0
units.english: Pick up a shipment of food on the Wanderer planet <destination>, to be delivered to the Unfettered as a peace offering.
units.italian: Prendi un carico di cibo sul pianeta dei Wanderers <destination>, da consegnare agli Slegati come offerta di pace.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|On <origin>, you meet up with Iktat Rek and the Hai ambassador Sayari, and tell them that you just helped to drive off an Unfettered raid on the Wanderer water world of Vara Ke'sok. "The situation is not [sustainable, livable]," says Rek. "Perhaps the Unfettered are the ones [chosen, intended] to [inherit, receive] the fruit of our labors here, but until the Eye beckons us to a new [home, place] we have nowhere else to go."|711|0
units.english: On <origin>, you meet up with Iktat Rek and the Hai ambassador Sayari, and tell them that you just helped to drive off an Unfettered raid on the Wanderer water world of Vara Ke'sok. "The situation is not [sustainable, livable]," says Rek. "Perhaps the Unfettered are the ones [chosen, intended] to [inherit, receive] the fruit of our labors here, but until the Eye beckons us to a new [home, place] we have nowhere else to go."
units.italian: Su <origin> incontri Iktat Rek e l'ambasciatrice Hai Sayari, e racconti loro di aver appena contribuito a respingere un'incursione degli Slegati sul mondo acquatico dei Wanderers, Vara Ke'sok. "La situazione non è [sostenibile, vivibile]," dice Rek. "Forse gli Slegati sono quelli [scelti, destinati] a [ereditare, ricevere] il frutto del nostro lavoro qui, ma finché l'Occhio non ci chiama a una nuova [casa, dimora] non abbiamo altro posto dove andare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"You're saying that after working so hard to restore these worlds, you would give them to someone as destructive as the Unfettered?"|713|0
units.english: "You're saying that after working so hard to restore these worlds, you would give them to someone as destructive as the Unfettered?"
units.italian: "Stai dicendo che, dopo aver faticato tanto a restaurare questi mondi, li dareste a qualcuno distruttivo come gli Slegati?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"That can't be right. The Unfettered wrecked their own worlds. They would wreck yours as well."|714|0
units.english: "That can't be right. The Unfettered wrecked their own worlds. They would wreck yours as well."
units.italian: "Non può essere giusto. Gli Slegati hanno devastato i propri mondi. Devasterebbero anche i vostri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"That is the [way, calling] of the Wanderers," says Rek. "We [restore, repair] worlds and leave them to others, knowing that their new [caretakers, overseers] will squander their wealth."|715|0
units.english: "That is the [way, calling] of the Wanderers," says Rek. "We [restore, repair] worlds and leave them to others, knowing that their new [caretakers, overseers] will squander their wealth."
units.italian: "Questo è il [modo, la vocazione] dei Wanderers," dice Rek. "Noi [restauriamo, ripariamo] i mondi e li lasciamo ad altri, sapendo che i loro nuovi [custodi, sorveglianti] sperpereranno quella ricchezza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"But why?" you ask. "Why do so much work for the sake of others who will waste what you have made?"|716|0
units.english: "But why?" you ask. "Why do so much work for the sake of others who will waste what you have made?"
units.italian: "Ma perché?" chiedi. "Perché fare tanto lavoro per altri che sprecheranno ciò che avete costruito?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"Because we have tended the graveyards of a hundred failed species," says Rek, "who [spent, burned] all their resources before learning [wisdom, balance]. Put any creature in too small a cage, and it will [befoul, soil, defile] its own home and die. Give it more [space, opportunity] and it may flourish." He says to Sayari, "Ambassador, are we [foolish, simple] to have this hope?"|717|0
units.english: "Because we have tended the graveyards of a hundred failed species," says Rek, "who [spent, burned] all their resources before learning [wisdom, balance]. Put any creature in too small a cage, and it will [befoul, soil, defile] its own home and die. Give it more [space, opportunity] and it may flourish." He says to Sayari, "Ambassador, are we [foolish, simple] to have this hope?"
units.italian: "Perché abbiamo curato i cimiteri di cento specie fallite," dice Rek, "che hanno [speso, bruciato] tutte le loro risorse prima di imparare [la saggezza, l'equilibrio]. Metti una creatura in una gabbia troppo piccola e [imbratterà, sporcherà, profanerà] la propria casa e morirà. Dalle più [spazio, opportunità] e potrà fiorire." Dice a Sayari: "Ambasciatrice, siamo [sciocchi, semplici] a nutrire questa speranza?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	Sayari says, "The Unfettered did not make war with you or with us until recently, when their three worlds began to die. Give them a new frontier, and we may have peace again."|718|0
units.english: Sayari says, "The Unfettered did not make war with you or with us until recently, when their three worlds began to die. Give them a new frontier, and we may have peace again."
units.italian: Sayari dice: "Gli Slegati non ci hanno fatto guerra, né a voi né a noi, fino a poco tempo fa, quando i loro tre mondi hanno cominciato a morire. Date loro una nuova frontiera e potremo avere di nuovo la pace."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"But what can we do about their attacks?"|720|0
units.english: "But what can we do about their attacks?"
units.italian: "Ma che cosa possiamo fare per i loro attacchi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"Rather than helping to expand and clean up those 'cages,' why not do something about the ones who built those cages in the first place?"|722|0
units.english: "Rather than helping to expand and clean up those 'cages,' why not do something about the ones who built those cages in the first place?"
units.italian: "Invece di aiutarli a espandersi e a ripulire quelle 'gabbie', perché non fare qualcosa contro chi quelle gabbie le ha costruite?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	Sayari says, "Set every species loose to make war on each other? That would be foolishness. War favors the strong, not the wise."|723|0
units.english: Sayari says, "Set every species loose to make war on each other? That would be foolishness. War favors the strong, not the wise."
units.italian: Sayari dice: "Lasciare ogni specie libera di farsi guerra a vicenda? Sarebbe una follia. La guerra favorisce i forti, non i saggi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	Iktat Rek nods in agreement. "Life is too [prolific, creative]," he says. "New species are born too often, and new planets, too seldom, if each species were to take all that it [demands, covets]. So, there must be [limits, divisions]."|724|0
units.english: Iktat Rek nods in agreement. "Life is too [prolific, creative]," he says. "New species are born too often, and new planets, too seldom, if each species were to take all that it [demands, covets]. So, there must be [limits, divisions]."
units.italian: Iktat Rek annuisce d'accordo. "La vita è troppo [prolifica, creativa]," dice. "Nuove specie nascono troppo spesso, e nuovi pianeti troppo di rado, perché ognuna possa prendere tutto ciò che [esige, brama]. Quindi devono esserci [limiti, divisioni]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"Then what can we do about the Unfettered?" you ask, "Won't they eventually desire even more?"|725|0
units.english: "Then what can we do about the Unfettered?" you ask, "Won't they eventually desire even more?"
units.italian: "Allora che cosa possiamo fare con gli Slegati?" chiedi. "Non finiranno prima o poi per volerne ancora di più?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	Sayari says, "To buy time, you can offer them food in exchange for peace. Call it 'tribute,' not charity, or you will offend their pride."|727|0
units.english: Sayari says, "To buy time, you can offer them food in exchange for peace. Call it 'tribute,' not charity, or you will offend their pride."
units.italian: Sayari dice: "Per guadagnare tempo puoi offrire loro cibo in cambio della pace. Chiamalo 'tributo', non carità, altrimenti offenderai il loro orgoglio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	Rek says, "This is the best [plan, option] I have heard. <last>, will you carry me to <planet> to arrange for a shipment of food?"|728|0
units.english: Rek says, "This is the best [plan, option] I have heard. <last>, will you carry me to <planet> to arrange for a shipment of food?"
units.italian: Rek dice: "Questo è il miglior [piano, opzione] che abbia sentito. <last>, mi porterai su <planet> a organizzare un carico di cibo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"Sure, I can do that."|730|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|	"Sorry, I don't want to assist the Wanderers any more."|732|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to assist the Wanderers any more."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non voglio più dare una mano ai Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|log|735|0
units.english: Volunteered to help bring a shipment of food to the Unfettered, as "tribute" from the Wanderers, in the hope that it will placate the Unfettered into making peace.
units.italian: Ti sei offerto di portare un carico di cibo agli Slegati, come "tributo" dei Wanderers, nella speranza che questo li plachi e li spinga a fare la pace.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1|dialog|737|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, you ask one of the Wanderers where the food shipment is. They only tilt their head and respond to you in the Wanderer language. You look around for Iktat Rek to translate, but you realize that you left him on one of your escorts that hasn't yet entered the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, chiedi a uno dei Wanderers dove sia il carico di cibo. Lui inclina solo la testa e ti risponde nella lingua dei Wanderers. Ti guardi intorno in cerca di Iktat Rek perché traduca, ma ti rendi conto di averlo lasciato su una delle tue scorte, che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|name|751|0
units.english: Unfettered Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con gli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|description|752|0
units.english: Escort a freighter carrying "tribute" to the Unfettered world of <destination>. You may need to bribe the Unfettered to keep them from attacking you.
units.italian: Scorta un mercantile che porta il "tributo" al mondo degli Slegati <destination>. Potrebbe essere necessario corrompere gli Slegati per evitare che ti attacchino.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|Once you arrive on <origin>, Iktat Rek explains, "We have [captured, salvaged] a few jump drives from the Unfettered, and installed one in a freighter. To avoid [provoking, threatening] the Unfettered, the freighter is unarmed. It would be a bad start to our [diplomacy, peacemaking] to strike the Unfettered with Wanderer weapons."|762|0
units.english: Once you arrive on <origin>, Iktat Rek explains, "We have [captured, salvaged] a few jump drives from the Unfettered, and installed one in a freighter. To avoid [provoking, threatening] the Unfettered, the freighter is unarmed. It would be a bad start to our [diplomacy, peacemaking] to strike the Unfettered with Wanderer weapons."
units.italian: Una volta arrivato su <origin>, Iktat Rek spiega: "Abbiamo [catturato, recuperato] alcuni motori di salto dagli Slegati, e ne abbiamo installato uno su un mercantile. Per evitare di [provocare, minacciare] gli Slegati, il mercantile è disarmato. Sarebbe un cattivo inizio per la nostra [diplomazia, opera di pace] colpire gli Slegati con armi dei Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|	"Does that mean I should not fire on them either?"|764|0
units.english: "Does that mean I should not fire on them either?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che non devo sparare nemmeno io?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|	"What should we do if they attack us, then?"|765|0
units.english: "What should we do if they attack us, then?"
units.italian: "Che cosa dobbiamo fare, allora, se ci attaccano?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|	"I would prefer that you avoid combat," he says. "The Unfettered are said to be [greedy, eager] for bribes, if you are willing to spend money to buy peace. Or simply avoid returning fire; the freighter is well shielded."|766|0
units.english: "I would prefer that you avoid combat," he says. "The Unfettered are said to be [greedy, eager] for bribes, if you are willing to spend money to buy peace. Or simply avoid returning fire; the freighter is well shielded."
units.italian: "Preferirei che evitassi il combattimento," dice. "Si dice che gli Slegati siano [avidi, desiderosi] di tangenti, se sei disposto a spendere denaro per comprare la pace. Oppure limitati a non rispondere al fuoco: il mercantile ha scudi validi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|	It takes several hours for the massive Wanderer freighter to be loaded. Rek explains that they have kept track of which kinds of food the Unfettered prefer to steal, so they know what will be edible for them. He says, "Our destination is called <planet>. Sayari tells me that all Hai share a [custom, taboo] concerning guests, so once we land on their planet we will be able to [speak, parley] with them in safety."|767|0
units.english: It takes several hours for the massive Wanderer freighter to be loaded. Rek explains that they have kept track of which kinds of food the Unfettered prefer to steal, so they know what will be edible for them. He says, "Our destination is called <planet>. Sayari tells me that all Hai share a [custom, taboo] concerning guests, so once we land on their planet we will be able to [speak, parley] with them in safety."
units.italian: Servono diverse ore per caricare l'enorme mercantile dei Wanderers. Rek spiega che hanno tenuto traccia di quali tipi di cibo gli Slegati preferiscono rubare, quindi sanno che cosa sarà commestibile per loro. Dice: "La nostra destinazione si chiama <planet>. Sayari mi dice che tutti gli Hai condividono una [usanza, tabù] riguardo agli ospiti, quindi una volta atterrati sul loro pianeta potremo [parlare, negoziare] con loro in sicurezza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1A|dialog|770|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you're missing something! Either the <npc> hasn't entered the system yet, or Iktat Rek is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O il <npc> non è ancora entrato nel sistema, oppure Iktat Rek è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|name|782|0
units.english: Unfettered Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con gli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|description|783|0
units.english: Escort this Wanderer freighter safely back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta questo mercantile dei Wanderers sano e salvo fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|The Unfettered make no attempt to attack you once you have landed on their planet. The Wanderer crew begins unloading the crates of food onto the landing pad, and eventually a small delegation of Unfettered leaders approaches. Iktat Rek explains that the food is a peace offering.|792|0
units.english: The Unfettered make no attempt to attack you once you have landed on their planet. The Wanderer crew begins unloading the crates of food onto the landing pad, and eventually a small delegation of Unfettered leaders approaches. Iktat Rek explains that the food is a peace offering.
units.italian: Gli Slegati non tentano di attaccarti una volta atterrato sul loro pianeta. L'equipaggio del Wanderer comincia a scaricare le casse di cibo sulla piazzola, e alla fine si avvicina una piccola delegazione di capi degli Slegati. Iktat Rek spiega che il cibo è un'offerta di pace.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	"It is far too little," says the Unfettered leader, "too little to pay us back for the ships you have destroyed and the worlds you have stolen. Until you give us back our worlds, we cannot have peace."|793|0
units.english: "It is far too little," says the Unfettered leader, "too little to pay us back for the ships you have destroyed and the worlds you have stolen. Until you give us back our worlds, we cannot have peace."
units.italian: "È fin troppo poco," dice il capo degli Slegati, "troppo poco per ripagarci delle navi che avete distrutto e dei mondi che avete rubato. Finché non ci restituirete i nostri mondi, non potremo avere la pace."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	(Let Iktat Rek do the talking.)|795|0
units.english: (Let Iktat Rek do the talking.)
units.italian: (Lascia che sia Iktat Rek a parlare.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	"You mean the ships that were destroyed while they were pillaging the Wanderers? You expect them to pay you back for those?"|797|0
units.english: "You mean the ships that were destroyed while they were pillaging the Wanderers? You expect them to pay you back for those?"
units.italian: "Intendi le navi distrutte mentre saccheggiavano i Wanderers? Vorresti che ti risarcissero anche per quelle?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	"Peace, human," says Iktat Rek. "We are not here to decide who is right." He gestures to you to step back and allow him to speak with the Hai alone.|798|0
units.english: "Peace, human," says Iktat Rek. "We are not here to decide who is right." He gestures to you to step back and allow him to speak with the Hai alone.
units.italian: "Pace, umano," dice Iktat Rek. "Non siamo qui per decidere chi ha ragione." Ti fa cenno di farti da parte e di lasciarlo parlare con gli Hai da solo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	"This is indeed only a [token, foretaste]," says Iktat Rek. "We have plenty more to offer, and surely you see that for us to fight each other is wasteful."|800|0
units.english: "This is indeed only a [token, foretaste]," says Iktat Rek. "We have plenty more to offer, and surely you see that for us to fight each other is wasteful."
units.italian: "Questo è davvero solo un [pegno, assaggio]," dice Iktat Rek. "Abbiamo molto altro da offrire, e di certo vedete anche voi che per noi combatterci a vicenda è uno spreco."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	They talk for a while longer. Eventually the Hai leader settles on a deal: "We will send you freighters. Whenever the freighter comes, you will fill it with food. If not, it is war. If you attack the freighter, it is war. And you must let us reclaim one of our worlds."|801|0
units.english: They talk for a while longer. Eventually the Hai leader settles on a deal: "We will send you freighters. Whenever the freighter comes, you will fill it with food. If not, it is war. If you attack the freighter, it is war. And you must let us reclaim one of our worlds."
units.italian: Parlano ancora un po'. Alla fine il capo degli Hai si ferma su un accordo: "Vi manderemo i nostri mercantili. Ogni volta che il mercantile arriva, lo riempirete di cibo. Se no, è guerra. Se attaccate il mercantile, è guerra. E dovete lasciarci riprendere uno dei nostri mondi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|	Iktat Rek says, "We will give you food, but I am not [authorized, permitted] to give you a world. I must speak to our [government, elders]." The Hai agree to that, and you get ready to return the freighter to <planet>.|802|0
units.english: Iktat Rek says, "We will give you food, but I am not [authorized, permitted] to give you a world. I must speak to our [government, elders]." The Hai agree to that, and you get ready to return the freighter to <planet>.
units.italian: Iktat Rek dice: "Vi daremo il cibo, ma non sono [autorizzato, permesso] a darvi un mondo. Devo parlare con il nostro [governo, consiglio degli anziani]." Gli Hai accettano, e tu ti prepari a riportare il mercantile su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1B|dialog|807|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you're missing something! Either the <npc> hasn't entered the system yet, or Iktat Rek is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O il <npc> non è ancora entrato nel sistema, oppure Iktat Rek è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|name|836|0
units.english: Unfettered Diplomacy
units.italian: Diplomazia con gli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|description|837|0
units.english: Return Iktat Rek to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Iktat Rek su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|You drop the freighter off safely on <origin>. Iktat Rek says, "Now I must return to our home, to [discuss, plan] with our elders. We cannot trust the Unfettered with a world in our space; they would build a [garrison, war fleet] there and attack us. But perhaps this [agreement, settlement] will give us peace for long enough to find a better solution."|846|0
units.english: You drop the freighter off safely on <origin>. Iktat Rek says, "Now I must return to our home, to [discuss, plan] with our elders. We cannot trust the Unfettered with a world in our space; they would build a [garrison, war fleet] there and attack us. But perhaps this [agreement, settlement] will give us peace for long enough to find a better solution."
units.italian: Lasci il mercantile al sicuro su <origin>. Iktat Rek dice: "Ora devo tornare alla nostra casa, per [discutere, pianificare] con i nostri anziani. Non possiamo fidarci di dare agli Slegati un mondo nel nostro spazio: ci costruirebbero una [guarnigione, flotta da guerra] e ci attaccherebbero. Ma forse questo [accordo, patto] ci darà pace abbastanza a lungo da trovare una soluzione migliore."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|dialog|849|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, you're approached by Sayari and a few of the Wanderer elders. "Where is Iktat Rek?" Sayari asks. You realize that you left him on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, ti vengono incontro Sayari e alcuni anziani dei Wanderers. "Dov'è Iktat Rek?" chiede Sayari. Ti rendi conto di averlo lasciato su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|log|853|0
units.english: Managed to broker a temporary ceasefire between the Unfettered Hai and the Wanderers. Was granted access to purchase the non-military Wanderer ships, as a reward.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a mediare un cessate il fuoco temporaneo fra gli Hai Slegati e i Wanderers. Come ricompensa ti è stato concesso l'accesso all'acquisto delle navi non militari dei Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|When you return to <planet>, Iktat Rek meets with Ambassador Sayari and a few of the Wanderer elders. The elders thank you for the role that you played in negotiating a temporary peace, and Rek says, "We will [reward, honor] you by allowing you to purchase our current [civilian, peacekeeping] ships. And, we [request, insist] that you do not [attack, assault] the ships sent to collect [tribute], as long as they remain [peaceful, cooperative]."|855|0
units.english: When you return to <planet>, Iktat Rek meets with Ambassador Sayari and a few of the Wanderer elders. The elders thank you for the role that you played in negotiating a temporary peace, and Rek says, "We will [reward, honor] you by allowing you to purchase our current [civilian, peacekeeping] ships. And, we [request, insist] that you do not [attack, assault] the ships sent to collect [tribute], as long as they remain [peaceful, cooperative]."
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, Iktat Rek si incontra con l'ambasciatrice Sayari e alcuni anziani dei Wanderers. Gli anziani ti ringraziano per il ruolo che hai avuto nel negoziare una pace temporanea, e Rek dice: "Ti [ricompenseremo, onoreremo] permettendoti di acquistare le nostre attuali navi [civili, di mantenimento della pace]. E ti [chiediamo, ingiungiamo] di non [attaccare, assalire] le navi inviate a riscuotere il [tributo], finché restano [pacifiche, collaborative]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|	The elders seem to agree that this is only a temporary solution. The Unfettered cannot be granted a base in Wanderer territory: they would use their few jump drives to move a few warships at a time to that base until they had a fleet too strong for the Wanderers to defeat. Sooner or later, the Unfettered will grow tired of demanding such a base and will return to open warfare.|856|0
units.english: The elders seem to agree that this is only a temporary solution. The Unfettered cannot be granted a base in Wanderer territory: they would use their few jump drives to move a few warships at a time to that base until they had a fleet too strong for the Wanderers to defeat. Sooner or later, the Unfettered will grow tired of demanding such a base and will return to open warfare.
units.italian: Gli anziani sembrano concordare che questa è solo una soluzione temporanea. Agli Slegati non si può concedere una base nel territorio dei Wanderers: userebbero i pochi motori di salto per spostare qualche nave da guerra alla volta fino a quella base, finché non avessero una flotta troppo forte perché i Wanderers possano sconfiggerla. Prima o poi gli Slegati si stancheranno di chiedere una simile base e torneranno alla guerra aperta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Unfettered Diplomacy 1C|	In the meantime, the only way to defuse the situation would be to get all the jump drives out of the hands of the Unfettered - and that means discovering and stopping whoever is supplying those drives to them.|857|0
units.english: In the meantime, the only way to defuse the situation would be to get all the jump drives out of the hands of the Unfettered - and that means discovering and stopping whoever is supplying those drives to them.
units.italian: Nel frattempo l'unico modo per disinnescare la situazione sarebbe togliere di mano agli Slegati tutti i motori di salto, e questo significa scoprire e fermare chi glieli fornisce.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Truce Check|name|875|0
units.english: Check with Iktat Rek?
units.italian: Contattare Iktat Rek?

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Truce Check|description|876|0
units.english: Meet up with Iktat Rek on <planet> to see if there is anything more you can do to help the Wanderers now that they have established a ceasefire with the Unfettered.
units.italian: Incontra Iktat Rek su <planet> per vedere se c'è altro che puoi fare per aiutare i Wanderers, ora che hanno stabilito un cessate il fuoco con gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Truce Check|It has been a while since you negotiated the ceasefire between the Wanderers and the Unfettered, and so far the truce seems to be holding. Now that the immediate crisis is under control, maybe it's time to meet up with Iktat Rek to talk about finding a more permanent response to the Unfettered incursion.|887|0
units.english: It has been a while since you negotiated the ceasefire between the Wanderers and the Unfettered, and so far the truce seems to be holding. Now that the immediate crisis is under control, maybe it's time to meet up with Iktat Rek to talk about finding a more permanent response to the Unfettered incursion.
units.italian: È passato un po' di tempo da quando hai negoziato il cessate il fuoco fra i Wanderers e gli Slegati, e finora la tregua sembra reggere. Ora che la crisi immediata è sotto controllo, forse è il momento di incontrare Iktat Rek per parlare di una risposta più duratura all'incursione degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|name|894|0
units.english: Jump drive source?
units.italian: La fonte dei motori di salto?

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|description|895|0
units.english: Iktat Rek asked you to acquire a spare jump drive and sell it to the Unfettered in exchange for information on where they are getting jump drives from. Then, return to <destination>.
units.italian: Iktat Rek ti ha chiesto di procurarti un motore di salto di riserva e di venderlo agli Slegati in cambio di informazioni su dove si procurano i motori di salto. Poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|When you arrive on <origin>, Iktat Rek greets you warmly. "Human," he says, "it is a [relief, delight] to have [peace, safety] within our territory. But the Unfettered will not be [placated, satisfied] forever. I have spoken with ambassador Sayari about this and we are agreed that we must know what [allies, accomplices] the Unfettered have, what their [strength, capability] is, and how they have acquired jump drives."|903|0
units.english: When you arrive on <origin>, Iktat Rek greets you warmly. "Human," he says, "it is a [relief, delight] to have [peace, safety] within our territory. But the Unfettered will not be [placated, satisfied] forever. I have spoken with ambassador Sayari about this and we are agreed that we must know what [allies, accomplices] the Unfettered have, what their [strength, capability] is, and how they have acquired jump drives."
units.italian: Quando arrivi su <origin>, Iktat Rek ti accoglie con calore. "Umano," dice, "è un [sollievo, piacere] avere [pace, sicurezza] nel nostro territorio. Ma gli Slegati non saranno [placidati, soddisfatti] per sempre. Ne ho parlato con l'ambasciatrice Sayari e siamo d'accordo che dobbiamo sapere quali [alleati, complici] abbiano gli Slegati, quale sia la loro [forza, capacità], e come si siano procurati i motori di salto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	"Agreed. How can I help you?"|907|0
units.english: "Agreed. How can I help you?"
units.italian: "D'accordo. Come posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	"Agreed. How can I help you?"|911|0
units.english: "Agreed. How can I help you?"
units.italian: "D'accordo. Come posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	"Umm... they may actually have gotten some of those jump drives from me."|913|0
units.english: "Umm... they may actually have gotten some of those jump drives from me."
units.italian: "Ehm... in realtà alcuni di quei motori di salto potrebbero averli avuti da me."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	Rek seems startled, but finally says, "I see. It is [understandable, forgivable] that you would want to placate them. So I will not [fault, censure] you for that. In fact it may help us that you have done so. What we [ask, desire] of you is to sell them another drive, but this time find a [pretense, excuse] to ask who else supplies them with jump drives. Since you have [helped, abetted] them, they may trust you with that information."|914|0
units.english: Rek seems startled, but finally says, "I see. It is [understandable, forgivable] that you would want to placate them. So I will not [fault, censure] you for that. In fact it may help us that you have done so. What we [ask, desire] of you is to sell them another drive, but this time find a [pretense, excuse] to ask who else supplies them with jump drives. Since you have [helped, abetted] them, they may trust you with that information."
units.italian: Rek sembra sorpreso, ma alla fine dice: "Capisco. È [comprensibile, perdonabile] che tu volessi placarli. Quindi non te ne [farò una colpa, biasimerò]. Anzi, potrebbe esserci utile che tu l'abbia fatto. Quello che ti [chiediamo, desideriamo] è vendere loro un altro motore di salto, ma questa volta trovare un [pretesto, scusa] per chiedere chi altri li rifornisce di motori di salto. Dato che li hai [aiutati, assecondati], potrebbero fidarsi di te e dirtelo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	Rek says, "What we [ask, desire] of you is to acquire a jump drive and sell it to them, to [earn, curry] more favor with them. Then find a [pretense, excuse] to ask who else supplies them with jump drives. Because you [brokered, negotiated] the ceasefire, they may trust you with that information."|917|0
units.english: Rek says, "What we [ask, desire] of you is to acquire a jump drive and sell it to them, to [earn, curry] more favor with them. Then find a [pretense, excuse] to ask who else supplies them with jump drives. Because you [brokered, negotiated] the ceasefire, they may trust you with that information."
units.italian: Rek dice: "Quello che ti [chiediamo, desideriamo] è procurarti un motore di salto e venderlo a loro, per [guadagnare, accattivarti] maggior favore. Poi trova un [pretesto, scusa] per chiedere chi altri li rifornisce di motori di salto. Poiché sei stato tu a [mediare, negoziare] il cessate il fuoco, potrebbero fidarsi di te e dirtelo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	"Sure, I can do that."|920|0
units.english: "Sure, I can do that."
units.italian: "Certo, posso farlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	"But, won't it hurt you in the long run for the Unfettered to have another jump drive?"|922|0
units.english: "But, won't it hurt you in the long run for the Unfettered to have another jump drive?"
units.italian: "Ma non vi danneggerà, alla lunga, che gli Slegati abbiano un altro motore di salto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	Rek says, "Over a hundred of their ships have [raided, violated] our space in the past few years. Someone is [equipping, supplying] them with many jump drives, and one more will make little difference. We must [cut off, eliminate] the source."|923|0
units.english: Rek says, "Over a hundred of their ships have [raided, violated] our space in the past few years. Someone is [equipping, supplying] them with many jump drives, and one more will make little difference. We must [cut off, eliminate] the source."
units.italian: Rek dice: "Oltre cento delle loro navi hanno [fatto incursioni, violato] il nostro spazio negli ultimi anni. Qualcuno li sta [dotando, rifornendo] di molti motori di salto, e uno in più farà poca differenza. Dobbiamo [tagliare fuori, eliminare] la fonte."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|	You promise to do your best to cajole information from the Unfettered, and he wishes you luck in doing so.|924|0
units.english: You promise to do your best to cajole information from the Unfettered, and he wishes you luck in doing so.
units.italian: Prometti di fare del tuo meglio per carpire informazioni agli Slegati, e lui ti augura buona fortuna.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|log|927|0
units.english: Agreed to try to sell a jump drive to the Unfettered Hai, as a way to get more information from them about who else is providing them with jump drives and enabling their attacks on the Wanderers.
units.italian: Hai accettato di provare a vendere un motore di salto agli Hai Slegati, come modo per ottenere da loro più informazioni su chi altro li rifornisce di motori di salto e rende possibili i loro attacchi ai Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|dialog|932|0
units.english: You have not yet tried to sell the Unfettered Hai a jump drive. Return here after doing so.
units.italian: Non hai ancora provato a vendere un motore di salto agli Hai Slegati. Torna qui dopo averlo fatto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Jump Drive Source|You report to Iktat Rek. "Most [intriguing, disturbing]," he says. "If what you say of these Alpha humans is [correct, unbiased], they are a dangerous foe. And in exchange for so many jump drives, no doubt the Unfettered have [supplied, furnished] them with many weapons." He pauses to think for a minute, then says, "You must track them. There is a Wanderer [device, technology] that can help you. But I must ask our [elders, government] for permission before giving you access to it. I will meet you back in the spaceport soon."|935|0
units.english: You report to Iktat Rek. "Most [intriguing, disturbing]," he says. "If what you say of these Alpha humans is [correct, unbiased], they are a dangerous foe. And in exchange for so many jump drives, no doubt the Unfettered have [supplied, furnished] them with many weapons." He pauses to think for a minute, then says, "You must track them. There is a Wanderer [device, technology] that can help you. But I must ask our [elders, government] for permission before giving you access to it. I will meet you back in the spaceport soon."
units.italian: Riferisci a Iktat Rek. "Molto [interessante, inquietante]," dice. "Se ciò che racconti di questi umani Alphas è [corretto, imparziale], sono un nemico pericoloso. E in cambio di tanti motori di salto, senza dubbio gli Slegati li hanno [riforniti, forniti] di molte armi." Si ferma a riflettere per un minuto, poi dice: "Devi rintracciarli. C'è un [dispositivo, tecnologia] dei Wanderers che può aiutarti. Ma devo chiedere il permesso ai nostri [anziani, governo] prima di darti accesso. Ti incontrerò di nuovo allo spazioporto presto."

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|Following Iktat Rek's suggestion, would you like to sell a jump drive to the Hai and see what information you can get in return?|948|0
units.english: Following Iktat Rek's suggestion, would you like to sell a jump drive to the Hai and see what information you can get in return?
units.italian: Seguendo il suggerimento di Iktat Rek, vuoi vendere un motore di salto agli Hai e vedere quali informazioni riesci a ottenere in cambio?

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	(Yes.)|950|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	(Not now.)|951|0
units.english: (Not now.)
units.italian: (Non ora.)

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	You eventually find one of the Unfettered who speaks your language. She directs you to the office of the "governor" (or perhaps warlord) in charge of the spaceport. The governor says, "I offer you same terms as to the other humans. One million credits, and we give you hyperdrive in place of jump drive. Is this acceptable?"|953|0
units.english: You eventually find one of the Unfettered who speaks your language. She directs you to the office of the "governor" (or perhaps warlord) in charge of the spaceport. The governor says, "I offer you same terms as to the other humans. One million credits, and we give you hyperdrive in place of jump drive. Is this acceptable?"
units.italian: Alla fine trovi uno degli Slegati che parla la tua lingua. Ti indirizza all'ufficio del "governatore" (o forse signore della guerra) che sovrintende allo spazioporto. Il governatore dice: "Ti offro le stesse condizioni degli altri umani. Un milione di crediti, e ti diamo un iperpropulsore al posto del motore di salto. È accettabile?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"Yes."|955|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"Sorry, let me come back when I have a jump drive to spare."|956|0
units.english: "Sorry, let me come back when I have a jump drive to spare."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, torni quando avrò un motore di salto da cedervi."

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	Carefully, almost reverently, the Unfettered technicians remove the jump drive from your ship. The governor pays you and then stands by to watch them work. Perhaps you can get more information from him.|958|0
units.english: Carefully, almost reverently, the Unfettered technicians remove the jump drive from your ship. The governor pays you and then stands by to watch them work. Perhaps you can get more information from him.
units.italian: Con cautela, quasi con reverenza, i tecnici degli Slegati rimuovono il motore di salto dalla tua nave. Il governatore ti paga e poi resta lì a guardarli lavorare. Forse puoi ottenere altre informazioni da lui.

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"If I want to find more jump drives to give you, where should I look?"|960|0
units.english: "If I want to find more jump drives to give you, where should I look?"
units.italian: "Se volessi trovare altri motori di salto da darvi, dove dovrei cercare?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"You said that 'other humans' have been selling you jump drives as well?"|961|0
units.english: "You said that 'other humans' have been selling you jump drives as well?"
units.italian: "Hai detto che anche altri umani vi vendono motori di salto?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	He says, "The unfettered humans will not tell us their source, but we suspect they steal from our old foe, the Korathi invaders. The unfettered human leader told a story I did not understand, that Prometheus was punished for stealing from the gods, but no one is punished for stealing from Prometheus. Was Prometheus a human hero?"|963|0
units.english: He says, "The unfettered humans will not tell us their source, but we suspect they steal from our old foe, the Korathi invaders. The unfettered human leader told a story I did not understand, that Prometheus was punished for stealing from the gods, but no one is punished for stealing from Prometheus. Was Prometheus a human hero?"
units.italian: Dice: "Gli umani senza freni non ci diranno la loro fonte, ma sospettiamo che rubino al nostro vecchio nemico, gli invasori Korath. Il capo degli umani senza freni mi ha raccontato una storia che non ho capito: che Prometeo fu punito per aver rubato agli dèi, ma nessuno viene punito per aver rubato a Prometeo. Prometeo era un eroe umano?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"Yes," he says, "the unfettered humans. They sell us many jump drives. They say it is their calling to help us. The unfettered human leader told a story I did not understand, that Prometheus was punished for stealing from the gods, but no one is punished for stealing from Prometheus. Was Prometheus a human hero?"|966|0
units.english: "Yes," he says, "the unfettered humans. They sell us many jump drives. They say it is their calling to help us. The unfettered human leader told a story I did not understand, that Prometheus was punished for stealing from the gods, but no one is punished for stealing from Prometheus. Was Prometheus a human hero?"
units.italian: "Sì," dice, "gli umani senza freni. Ci vendono molti motori di salto. Dicono che è la loro vocazione aiutarci. Il capo degli umani senza freni mi ha raccontato una storia che non ho capito: che Prometeo fu punito per aver rubato agli dèi, ma nessuno viene punito per aver rubato a Prometeo. Prometeo era un eroe umano?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	You explain the myth to him as best you can, then ask, "What do you mean, 'unfettered humans'?"|968|0
units.english: You explain the myth to him as best you can, then ask, "What do you mean, 'unfettered humans'?"
units.italian: Gli spieghi il mito come meglio puoi, poi chiedi: "Che cosa vuoi dire con 'umani senza freni'?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	He seems surprised that you do not know what he is talking about. "The green ones," he says.|969|0
units.english: He seems surprised that you do not know what he is talking about. "The green ones," he says.
units.italian: Sembra sorpreso che tu non sappia di che cosa parla. "Quelli verdi," dice.

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"Alphas? You shouldn't trade with the Alphas! They're dangerous, uncontrollable criminals!"|971|0
units.english: "Alphas? You shouldn't trade with the Alphas! They're dangerous, uncontrollable criminals!"
units.italian: "Gli Alphas? Non dovete commerciare con gli Alphas! Sono criminali pericolosi e incontrollabili!"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"Oh, of course. The green humans are held in as high esteem as Prometheus himself. Can you tell me where to find them, so I can give them the honor they deserve?"|972|0
units.english: "Oh, of course. The green humans are held in as high esteem as Prometheus himself. Can you tell me where to find them, so I can give them the honor they deserve?"
units.italian: "Oh, certo. Gli umani verdi sono tenuti in così alta stima quanto Prometeo stesso. Puoi dirmi dove trovarli, così posso dar loro l'onore che meritano?"

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	"That is what the altered Hai say about we the Unfettered," he says. "They say that because they are weak and afraid. Perhaps you are weak and afraid also, and I was wrong to deal with you."|974|0
units.english: "That is what the altered Hai say about we the Unfettered," he says. "They say that because they are weak and afraid. Perhaps you are weak and afraid also, and I was wrong to deal with you."
units.italian: "Questo è quello che dicono di noi Slegati gli Hai alterati," dice. "Lo dicono perché sono deboli e spaventati. Forse anche tu sei debole e spaventato, e ho sbagliato a trattare con te."

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	He is silent and looks at you with a wary, calculating expression. "They did not say where they come from," he says, "and they said others would come seeking to ensnare them. Perhaps I was wrong to trust you."|977|0
units.english: He is silent and looks at you with a wary, calculating expression. "They did not say where they come from," he says, "and they said others would come seeking to ensnare them. Perhaps I was wrong to trust you."
units.italian: Resta in silenzio e ti guarda con un'espressione circospetta e calcolatrice. "Non hanno detto da dove vengono," dice, "e hanno detto che altri sarebbero venuti a cercare di intrappolarli. Forse ho sbagliato a fidarmi di te."

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|	You are able to get no further information from him, but what you already know is quite valuable. You should report back to Iktat Rek and see what he says.|979|0
units.english: You are able to get no further information from him, but what you already know is quite valuable. You should report back to Iktat Rek and see what he says.
units.italian: Non riesci a ottenere altre informazioni da lui, ma quello che già sai è piuttosto prezioso. Dovresti riferirlo a Iktat Rek e sentire che cosa dice.

units.id: mission:Unfettered: Jump Drive Source|log|982|0
units.english: Learned from the Unfettered Hai that they have been purchasing jump drives from the Alphas (whom they refer to as "unfettered humans").
units.italian: Hai saputo dagli Hai Slegati che stanno acquistando motori di salto dagli Alphas (che loro chiamano "umani senza freni").

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|name|992|0
units.english: Alpha Surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza degli Alphas

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|description|993|0
units.english: Drop off surveillance micro-satellites in the three Unfettered home systems, then stop by <destination> to see if the Hai government knows anything about an Alpha enclave nearby.
units.italian: Rilascia micro-satelliti di sorveglianza nei tre sistemi d'origine degli Slegati, poi passa da <destination> per vedere se il governo Hai sa qualcosa di un insediamento Alpha lì vicino.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|dialog|1003|0
units.english: You cycle the airlock and dump a handful of the tiny Wanderer surveillance cubes into space. By the time they've drifted a few meters away, your ship's sensors are unable to detect them.
units.italian: Apri il portello e getti nello spazio una manciata dei minuscoli cubi di sorveglianza dei Wanderers. Quando si sono allontanati di qualche metro, i sensori della tua nave non riescono più a rilevarli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|dialog|1006|0
units.english: You cycle the airlock and dump a handful of the tiny Wanderer surveillance cubes into space. By the time they've drifted a few meters away, your ship's sensors are unable to detect them.
units.italian: Apri il portello e getti nello spazio una manciata dei minuscoli cubi di sorveglianza dei Wanderers. Quando si sono allontanati di qualche metro, i sensori della tua nave non riescono più a rilevarli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|dialog|1009|0
units.english: You cycle the airlock and dump a handful of the tiny Wanderer surveillance cubes into space. By the time they've drifted a few meters away, your ship's sensors are unable to detect them.
units.italian: Apri il portello e getti nello spazio una manciata dei minuscoli cubi di sorveglianza dei Wanderers. Quando si sono allontanati di qualche metro, i sensori della tua nave non riescono più a rilevarli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|When you meet Iktat Rek, he hands you a small box containing several small, charcoal black cubes, about two centimeters wide. "These are the [eyes, sensors] of our [communications? surveillance? information?] network," he says. "Until they receive the [request, query] command they generate no [signal, electromagnetic radiation] and almost no heat. But they watch, and [record, remember]. [Sow, scatter, deploy] several of these in each Unfettered system. Then you should visit the Hai [center, homeworld] and see if they know anything of the [activities, presence] of the Alphas."|1013|0
units.english: When you meet Iktat Rek, he hands you a small box containing several small, charcoal black cubes, about two centimeters wide. "These are the [eyes, sensors] of our [communications? surveillance? information?] network," he says. "Until they receive the [request, query] command they generate no [signal, electromagnetic radiation] and almost no heat. But they watch, and [record, remember]. [Sow, scatter, deploy] several of these in each Unfettered system. Then you should visit the Hai [center, homeworld] and see if they know anything of the [activities, presence] of the Alphas."
units.italian: Quando incontri Iktat Rek, ti porge una scatola che contiene diversi piccoli cubi nero carbone, larghi circa due centimetri. "Questi sono gli [occhi, sensori] della nostra rete di [comunicazioni? sorveglianza? informazioni?]," dice. "Finché non ricevono il comando di [richiesta, interrogazione] non generano alcun [segnale, emissione elettromagnetica] e quasi nessun calore. Ma osservano, e [registrano, ricordano]. [Semina, spargi, schiera] diversi di questi in ciascun sistema degli Slegati. Poi dovresti visitare il [centro, mondo d'origine] degli Hai e vedere se sanno qualcosa delle [attività, presenza] degli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	You bring the surveillance devices back to your ship. It looks like Rek gave you extra, presumably so that you can deploy enough in each system to have redundancy if some of them fail. It probably wouldn't make a difference to the success of the mission if you kept one for yourself, and based on what Rek said this technology might be very valuable.|1014|0
units.english: You bring the surveillance devices back to your ship. It looks like Rek gave you extra, presumably so that you can deploy enough in each system to have redundancy if some of them fail. It probably wouldn't make a difference to the success of the mission if you kept one for yourself, and based on what Rek said this technology might be very valuable.
units.italian: Porti i dispositivi di sorveglianza sulla tua nave. Sembra che Rek te ne abbia dati in più, presumibilmente perché tu ne possa schierare abbastanza in ogni sistema da avere ridondanza se alcuni si guastano. Probabilmente non cambierebbe nulla al successo della missione se ne tenessi uno per te, e da quello che ha detto Rek questa tecnologia potrebbe valere molto.
