units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	(Use all of them for the mission, as instructed.)|1016|0
units.english: (Use all of them for the mission, as instructed.)
units.italian: (Usali tutti per la missione, come richiesto.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	(Steal one of the devices to keep for myself.)|1017|0
units.english: (Steal one of the devices to keep for myself.)
units.italian: (Ruba uno dei dispositivi e tienilo per me.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	You split the devices up into three groups to launch out your airlock in each of the three Unfettered systems. Hopefully the Unfettered will not notice what you are doing.|1019|0
units.english: You split the devices up into three groups to launch out your airlock in each of the three Unfettered systems. Hopefully the Unfettered will not notice what you are doing.
units.italian: Dividi i dispositivi in tre gruppi da lanciare dal portello in ciascuno dei tre sistemi degli Slegati. Speriamo che gli Slegati non si accorgano di quello che stai facendo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	You split the devices up into three piles, one for each of the Unfettered systems, and keep one of them for yourself, well hidden in a safe place on your ship.|1024|0
units.english: You split the devices up into three piles, one for each of the Unfettered systems, and keep one of them for yourself, well hidden in a safe place on your ship.
units.italian: Dividi i dispositivi in tre mucchi, uno per ciascun sistema degli Slegati, e ne tieni uno per te, ben nascosto in un posto sicuro sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|log|1030|0
units.english: Planted some surveillance devices, designed by the Wanderers, in Unfettered Hai space. A month from now, they will be done collecting data on ship movements in the area, and may provide a hint of where the Alphas who are selling jump drives to the Unfettered are coming from.
units.italian: Hai piazzato alcuni dispositivi di sorveglianza, progettati dai Wanderers, nello spazio degli Hai Slegati. Fra un mese avranno finito di raccogliere dati sui movimenti delle navi nella zona, e potrebbero dare un indizio su da dove arrivino gli Alphas che vendono motori di salto agli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|The surveillance cubes have all been deployed. While you wait for them to collect their recordings of the ship traffic in the Unfettered systems, you stop by the Hai center of government and ask for the human ambassador. When they realize that you are the one who made contact with the Wanderers, they quickly give you an appointment.|1033|0
units.english: The surveillance cubes have all been deployed. While you wait for them to collect their recordings of the ship traffic in the Unfettered systems, you stop by the Hai center of government and ask for the human ambassador. When they realize that you are the one who made contact with the Wanderers, they quickly give you an appointment.
units.italian: I cubi di sorveglianza sono stati tutti schierati. Mentre aspetti che raccolgano le registrazioni del traffico di navi nei sistemi degli Slegati, passi dal centro di governo degli Hai e chiedi dell'ambasciatore umano. Quando capiscono che sei tu quello che ha contattato i Wanderers, ti danno subito un appuntamento.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	The ambassador is an old, male Hai named Hiyamaharu. "Honored human," he says, "it is a pleasure to meet you. If I may assist you in any way, I shall do so."|1034|0
units.english: The ambassador is an old, male Hai named Hiyamaharu. "Honored human," he says, "it is a pleasure to meet you. If I may assist you in any way, I shall do so."
units.italian: L'ambasciatore è un Hai anziano di nome Hiyamaharu. "Onorato umano," dice, "è un piacere conoscerti. Se posso esserti utile in qualunque modo, lo sarò."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"Thank you." (Explain about the Alphas.)|1036|0
units.english: "Thank you." (Explain about the Alphas.)
units.italian: "Grazie." (Spiega degli Alphas.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	He says, "We know of them. Indeed, our first contact with the humans, two centuries ago, was with these green people. They sought to cheat us and dominate us. They are not merely misfits like the Unfettered; these Alpha humans are cruel and self-interested. They thought we were simple because we are peaceful, but we were too shrewd and too strong for them, and they are now banned from our territory. But then the peaceful humans came, and we learned that you are not all like the Alphas."|1037|0
units.english: He says, "We know of them. Indeed, our first contact with the humans, two centuries ago, was with these green people. They sought to cheat us and dominate us. They are not merely misfits like the Unfettered; these Alpha humans are cruel and self-interested. They thought we were simple because we are peaceful, but we were too shrewd and too strong for them, and they are now banned from our territory. But then the peaceful humans came, and we learned that you are not all like the Alphas."
units.italian: Dice: "Li conosciamo. Anzi, il nostro primo contatto con gli umani, due secoli fa, è stato proprio con questi verdi. Cercarono di ingannarci e di dominarci. Non sono semplicemente degli emarginati come gli Slegati: questi umani Alphas sono crudeli e interessati solo a se stessi. Ci credevano semplici perché siamo pacifici, ma siamo stati troppo astuti e troppo forti per loro, e ora sono banditi dal nostro territorio. Poi però sono arrivati gli umani pacifici, e abbiamo imparato che non siete tutti come gli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"Is it possible that they have a hidden base on one of your worlds?"|1039|0
units.english: "Is it possible that they have a hidden base on one of your worlds?"
units.italian: "È possibile che abbiano una base nascosta su uno dei vostri mondi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"Do you know where they went when you banned them from your space?"|1040|0
units.english: "Do you know where they went when you banned them from your space?"
units.italian: "Sapete dove sono andati quando li avete banditi dal vostro spazio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"No," he says, "It has been two hundred years, and our worlds are populous and overseen with great diligence. Unless they have taken refuge with the Unfettered, they are not in our space."|1042|0
units.english: "No," he says, "It has been two hundred years, and our worlds are populous and overseen with great diligence. Unless they have taken refuge with the Unfettered, they are not in our space."
units.italian: "No," dice, "sono passati duecento anni, e i nostri mondi sono popolosi e sorvegliati con grande diligenza. A meno che non abbiano trovato rifugio presso gli Slegati, non sono nel nostro spazio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"Then where could they have gone?" you ask.|1043|0
units.english: "Then where could they have gone?" you ask.
units.italian: "E allora dove possono essere andati?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	"We do not know," he says. "It is not our business to track the doings of other species, outside our territory. And during the time of the Korath raids, we would not have had the capacity to track them, anyway."|1045|0
units.english: "We do not know," he says. "It is not our business to track the doings of other species, outside our territory. And during the time of the Korath raids, we would not have had the capacity to track them, anyway."
units.italian: "Non lo sappiamo," dice. "Non è nostro compito seguire le faccende delle altre specie, fuori dal nostro territorio. E al tempo delle incursioni dei Korath non avremmo comunque avuto la capacità di rintracciarli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance A|	You thank him for his time. Now you just have to wait long enough for the surveillance cubes to collect their data, and hope they record something useful.|1046|0
units.english: You thank him for his time. Now you just have to wait long enough for the surveillance cubes to collect their data, and hope they record something useful.
units.italian: Lo ringrazi per il tempo che ti ha dedicato. Ora devi solo aspettare abbastanza a lungo che i cubi di sorveglianza raccolgano i loro dati, e sperare che registrino qualcosa di utile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|name|1054|0
units.english: Alpha Surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza degli Alphas

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|description|1055|0
units.english: Travel through the three Unfettered systems to retrieve the surveillance recordings, then report back to Iktat Rek on <destination>.
units.italian: Attraversa i tre sistemi degli Slegati per recuperare le registrazioni di sorveglianza, poi riferisci a Iktat Rek su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|dialog|1062|0
units.english: Using the transmitter that came with the surveillance cubes, you send out the signal and receive back the encrypted fleet activity recordings.
units.italian: Usando il trasmettitore fornito con i cubi di sorveglianza, invii il segnale e ricevi indietro le registrazioni criptate dell'attività della flotta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|dialog|1066|0
units.english: Using the transmitter that came with the surveillance cubes, you send out the signal and receive back the encrypted fleet activity recordings.
units.italian: Usando il trasmettitore fornito con i cubi di sorveglianza, invii il segnale e ricevi indietro le registrazioni criptate dell'attività della flotta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|dialog|1070|0
units.english: Using the transmitter that came with the surveillance cubes, you send out the signal and receive back the encrypted fleet activity recordings.
units.italian: Usando il trasmettitore fornito con i cubi di sorveglianza, invii il segnale e ricevi indietro le registrazioni criptate dell'attività della flotta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|It has been a month since you deployed the surveillance devices in the Unfettered home systems. It's time for you to go back and retrieve whatever recordings they made. You'll then be able to bring the recordings back to Iktat Rek on <planet> to decrypt and analyze them.|1075|0
units.english: It has been a month since you deployed the surveillance devices in the Unfettered home systems. It's time for you to go back and retrieve whatever recordings they made. You'll then be able to bring the recordings back to Iktat Rek on <planet> to decrypt and analyze them.
units.italian: È passato un mese da quando hai schierato i dispositivi di sorveglianza nei sistemi d'origine degli Slegati. È ora di tornare a recuperare le registrazioni che hanno fatto. Poi potrai portarle a Iktat Rek su <planet> per decriptarle e analizzarle.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|	Hopefully you will be able to collect the data without the Unfettered intercepting the transmissions and realizing they have been spied on.|1076|0
units.english: Hopefully you will be able to collect the data without the Unfettered intercepting the transmissions and realizing they have been spied on.
units.italian: Speriamo che tu riesca a raccogliere i dati senza che gli Slegati intercettino le trasmissioni e capiscano di essere stati spiati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|When you arrive at the spaceport, you contact Iktat Rek and send him a copy of the encrypted recordings. You also mention to him that the Unfettered attacked you after you sent out the data retrieval signal. "That is [unfortunate, regrettable]," says Rek. "I hope they will [cool off, calm down] in time. I suspect you could buy their [friendship, favor] back with another jump drive, or just ignore their [attacks, antagonism] for now."|1083|0
units.english: When you arrive at the spaceport, you contact Iktat Rek and send him a copy of the encrypted recordings. You also mention to him that the Unfettered attacked you after you sent out the data retrieval signal. "That is [unfortunate, regrettable]," says Rek. "I hope they will [cool off, calm down] in time. I suspect you could buy their [friendship, favor] back with another jump drive, or just ignore their [attacks, antagonism] for now."
units.italian: Quando arrivi allo spazioporto, contatti Iktat Rek e gli invii una copia delle registrazioni criptate. Gli racconti anche che gli Slegati ti hanno attaccato dopo che hai inviato il segnale di recupero dei dati. "Questo è [spiacevole, deplorevole]," dice Rek. "Spero che si [calmino, raffreddino] col tempo. Sospetto che potresti ricomprare la loro [amicizia, benevolenza] con un altro motore di salto, oppure ignorare per ora i loro [attacchi, antagonismo]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance B|	You ask what you should do next, and Rek says, "We need some time to [analyze, inspect] the sensor logs. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour."|1084|0
units.english: You ask what you should do next, and Rek says, "We need some time to [analyze, inspect] the sensor logs. Meet me in the spaceport in an hour."
units.italian: Chiedi che cosa devi fare adesso, e Rek dice: "Ci serve un po' di tempo per [analizzare, esaminare] i registri dei sensori. Incontrami allo spazioporto fra un'ora."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|name|1089|0
units.english: Alpha Surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza degli Alphas

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|description|1090|0
units.english: The Wanderers have no technology for tracking a ship that is using a jump drive, but Iktat Rek thinks the Quarg might be able to and suggested visiting them on <destination>.
units.italian: I Wanderers non hanno tecnologia per rintracciare una nave che usa un motore di salto, ma Iktat Rek pensa che i Quarg potrebbero riuscirci, e ti ha suggerito di andare da loro su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|When you meet up with Iktat Rek, he shows you a picture of a Navy Carrier. "The sensors [observed, detected] this ship entering the Hi Yahr system via jump drive," he says. You tell him that it is a human military vessel. "Do you think your military could be [assisting, abetting] the Unfettered?" he asks.|1099|0
units.english: When you meet up with Iktat Rek, he shows you a picture of a Navy Carrier. "The sensors [observed, detected] this ship entering the Hi Yahr system via jump drive," he says. You tell him that it is a human military vessel. "Do you think your military could be [assisting, abetting] the Unfettered?" he asks.
units.italian: Quando incontri Iktat Rek, ti mostra l'immagine di un Carrier della Marina. "I sensori [hanno osservato, hanno rilevato] questa nave entrare nel sistema Hi Yahr con un motore di salto," dice. Gli dici che è un vascello militare umano. "Pensi che il tuo esercito possa [stare assistendo, stare favorendo] gli Slegati?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"It's possible, but it could also be a stolen ship. I wouldn't expect the Navy to side with the Unfettered."|1101|0
units.english: "It's possible, but it could also be a stolen ship. I wouldn't expect the Navy to side with the Unfettered."
units.italian: "È possibile, ma potrebbe anche essere una nave rubata. Non mi aspetterei che la Marina si schieri con gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"I wouldn't put it past them. It could be some sort of hidden program to gain access to alien technology."|1103|0
units.english: "I wouldn't put it past them. It could be some sort of hidden program to gain access to alien technology."
units.italian: "Non lo escluderei. Potrebbe essere una specie di programma segreto per accedere a tecnologia aliena."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	Iktat Rek says, "I see. So either your [leadership, government] knows about this secret, or it is a [private, separate] military conspiracy. Either way, that worries me."|1104|0
units.english: Iktat Rek says, "I see. So either your [leadership, government] knows about this secret, or it is a [private, separate] military conspiracy. Either way, that worries me."
units.italian: Iktat Rek dice: "Capisco. Quindi o la tua [dirigenza, classe dirigente] è al corrente di questo segreto, oppure si tratta di un complotto militare [privato, separato]. In entrambi i casi, la cosa mi preoccupa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"What should we do about it?" you ask.|1105|0
units.english: "What should we do about it?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa dovremmo fare?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"I hope you are right," says Rek. "I do not wish our [conflict, tension] with the Unfettered to place us at war with humans. We must [investigate, explore] this matter further."|1108|0
units.english: "I hope you are right," says Rek. "I do not wish our [conflict, tension] with the Unfettered to place us at war with humans. We must [investigate, explore] this matter further."
units.italian: "Spero che tu abbia ragione," dice Rek. "Non desidero che il nostro [conflitto, scontro] con gli Slegati ci porti a una guerra con gli umani. Dobbiamo [indagare, esplorare] più a fondo questa faccenda."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"How can we do that?" you ask.|1109|0
units.english: "How can we do that?" you ask.
units.italian: "Come possiamo farlo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	"You must track this ship," says Rek. "A jump drive creates a temporary [portal? identity? oneness?] between two [locations, regions] in space. A species that [creates, manufactures] jump drives may be able to [track, detect] the residue of those links. Sayari tells me that such a species [lives in, borders on] Hai space. Perhaps they will aid you."|1111|0
units.english: "You must track this ship," says Rek. "A jump drive creates a temporary [portal? identity? oneness?] between two [locations, regions] in space. A species that [creates, manufactures] jump drives may be able to [track, detect] the residue of those links. Sayari tells me that such a species [lives in, borders on] Hai space. Perhaps they will aid you."
units.italian: "Devi rintracciare questa nave," dice Rek. "Un motore di salto crea un temporaneo [portale? identità? unità?] fra due [luoghi, regioni] dello spazio. Una specie che [crea, produce] motori di salto potrebbe essere in grado di [rintracciare, rilevare] il residuo di quei collegamenti. Sayari mi dice che una specie così [abita nello, confina con lo] spazio Hai. Forse ti aiuteranno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|	You agree to make a visit to the Quarg ringworld in Hai space, and he wishes you luck on your journey.|1112|0
units.english: You agree to make a visit to the Quarg ringworld in Hai space, and he wishes you luck on your journey.
units.italian: Accetti di fare visita al mondo ad anello dei Quarg nello spazio Hai, e lui ti augura buona fortuna per il viaggio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C|As always, it is impossible to tell which of the Quarg is in charge here or might be able to help you. The first few you ask seem none too eager to give any technology related to the jump drive to a human, but finally one of them listens to your story and says, "I know of the Alphas. And of the Unfettered. There is one who may be willing to assist you." After a brief conversation in the Quarg language via a communication device, the Quarg says, "Return to the spaceport in an hour and one will meet you to hear your petition."|1117|0
units.english: As always, it is impossible to tell which of the Quarg is in charge here or might be able to help you. The first few you ask seem none too eager to give any technology related to the jump drive to a human, but finally one of them listens to your story and says, "I know of the Alphas. And of the Unfettered. There is one who may be willing to assist you." After a brief conversation in the Quarg language via a communication device, the Quarg says, "Return to the spaceport in an hour and one will meet you to hear your petition."
units.italian: Come sempre, è impossibile capire quale dei Quarg sia al comando qui o possa aiutarti. I primi a cui chiedi non sembrano affatto desiderosi di dare a un umano una tecnologia legata ai motori di salto, ma alla fine uno di loro ascolta la tua storia e dice: "Conosco gli Alphas. E gli Slegati. C'è uno che potrebbe essere disposto ad aiutarti." Dopo una breve conversazione in lingua Quarg tramite un dispositivo di comunicazione, il Quarg dice: "Torna allo spazioporto fra un'ora e uno ti incontrerà per ascoltare la tua petizione."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|name|1122|0
units.english: Alpha Surveillance
units.italian: Sorveglianza degli Alphas

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|description|1123|0
units.english: The Wanderers have no technology for tracking a ship that is using a jump drive, but Iktat Rek thinks the Quarg might be able to and suggested visiting them on <destination>.
units.italian: I Wanderers non hanno tecnologia per rintracciare una nave che usa un motore di salto, ma Iktat Rek pensa che i Quarg potrebbero riuscirci, e ti ha suggerito di andare da loro su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|Iktat Rek arrives carrying a handheld device with two long antennas. "You must [pardon, forgive] me," he says. "It appears you have [dropped, misplaced] one of the tracking devices. Fortunately I have the [means, capability] to determine where on your ship it is [located, concealed]. Shall I assist you in finding it?"|1132|0
units.english: Iktat Rek arrives carrying a handheld device with two long antennas. "You must [pardon, forgive] me," he says. "It appears you have [dropped, misplaced] one of the tracking devices. Fortunately I have the [means, capability] to determine where on your ship it is [located, concealed]. Shall I assist you in finding it?"
units.italian: Iktat Rek arriva portando un dispositivo a mano con due lunghe antenne. "Devi [scusarmi, perdonarmi]," dice. "Pare che tu abbia [lasciato cadere, smarrito] uno dei dispositivi di tracciamento. Per fortuna ho i [mezzi, la capacità] per determinare dove sulla tua nave si [trovi, nasconda]. Ti aiuto a cercarlo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"No, umm... I bet it just fell out of the box in my cargo hold. I'll look around and see if I can find it."|1134|0
units.english: "No, umm... I bet it just fell out of the box in my cargo hold. I'll look around and see if I can find it."
units.italian: "No, ehm... scommetto che è solo caduto dalla scatola nella mia stiva. Mi guardo intorno e vedo se lo trovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"I'm sorry, I kept one of them to try to figure out how it works. I'll go get it and give it back to you."|1135|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I kept one of them to try to figure out how it works. I'll go get it and give it back to you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ne ho tenuto uno per cercare di capire come funziona. Vado a prenderlo e te lo restituisco."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	(Get back in my ship and flee.)|1137|0
units.english: (Get back in my ship and flee.)
units.italian: (Torna sulla mia nave e fuggi.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"I see," says Rek. You wish you were able to read Wanderer facial expressions; you are not sure if he believes you. You go into your ship, wait long enough to make it appear that you needed to search, then return and give the device back to him.|1139|0
units.english: "I see," says Rek. You wish you were able to read Wanderer facial expressions; you are not sure if he believes you. You go into your ship, wait long enough to make it appear that you needed to search, then return and give the device back to him.
units.italian: "Capisco," dice Rek. Vorresti saper leggere le espressioni dei Wanderers; non sei sicuro che ti creda. Entri nella nave, aspetti quanto basta perché sembri che tu abbia dovuto cercare, poi torni e gli restituisci il dispositivo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"I am glad you [admitted, confessed] that," says Rek. "Please be more [honest, obedient] in the future." You retrieve the hidden surveillance device and return it to him.|1144|0
units.english: "I am glad you [admitted, confessed] that," says Rek. "Please be more [honest, obedient] in the future." You retrieve the hidden surveillance device and return it to him.
units.italian: "Sono contento che tu l'abbia [ammesso, confessato]," dice Rek. "In futuro, ti prego di essere più [onesto, obbediente]." Recuperi il dispositivo di sorveglianza nascosto e glielo restituisci.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"Thank you," says Rek. "Now, here is what we discovered." He shows you a picture of a Navy Carrier. "The sensors [observed, detected] this ship entering the Hi Yahr system via jump drive," he says. You tell him that it is a human military vessel. "Do you think your military could be [assisting, abetting] the Unfettered?" he asks.|1146|0
units.english: "Thank you," says Rek. "Now, here is what we discovered." He shows you a picture of a Navy Carrier. "The sensors [observed, detected] this ship entering the Hi Yahr system via jump drive," he says. You tell him that it is a human military vessel. "Do you think your military could be [assisting, abetting] the Unfettered?" he asks.
units.italian: "Grazie," dice Rek. "Ora, ecco che cosa abbiamo scoperto." Ti mostra l'immagine di un Carrier della Marina. "I sensori [hanno osservato, hanno rilevato] questa nave entrare nel sistema Hi Yahr con un motore di salto," dice. Gli dici che è un vascello militare umano. "Pensi che il tuo esercito possa [stare assistendo, stare favorendo] gli Slegati?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"It's possible, but it could also be a stolen ship. I wouldn't expect the Navy to side with the Unfettered."|1148|0
units.english: "It's possible, but it could also be a stolen ship. I wouldn't expect the Navy to side with the Unfettered."
units.italian: "È possibile, ma potrebbe anche essere una nave rubata. Non mi aspetterei che la Marina si schieri con gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"I wouldn't put it past them. It could be some sort of hidden program to gain access to alien technology."|1150|0
units.english: "I wouldn't put it past them. It could be some sort of hidden program to gain access to alien technology."
units.italian: "Non lo escluderei. Potrebbe essere una specie di programma segreto per accedere a tecnologia aliena."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	Iktat Rek says, "I see. So either your [leadership, government] knows about this secret, or it is a [private, separate] military conspiracy. Either way, that worries me."|1151|0
units.english: Iktat Rek says, "I see. So either your [leadership, government] knows about this secret, or it is a [private, separate] military conspiracy. Either way, that worries me."
units.italian: Iktat Rek dice: "Capisco. Quindi o la tua [dirigenza, classe dirigente] è al corrente di questo segreto, oppure si tratta di un complotto militare [privato, separato]. In entrambi i casi, la cosa mi preoccupa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"What should we do about it?" you ask.|1152|0
units.english: "What should we do about it?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa dovremmo fare?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"I hope you are right," says Rek. "I do not wish our [conflict, tension] with the Unfettered to place us at war with humans. We must [investigate, explore] this matter further."|1155|0
units.english: "I hope you are right," says Rek. "I do not wish our [conflict, tension] with the Unfettered to place us at war with humans. We must [investigate, explore] this matter further."
units.italian: "Spero che tu abbia ragione," dice Rek. "Non desidero che il nostro [conflitto, scontro] con gli Slegati ci porti a una guerra con gli umani. Dobbiamo [indagare, esplorare] più a fondo questa faccenda."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"How can we do that?" you ask.|1156|0
units.english: "How can we do that?" you ask.
units.italian: "Come possiamo farlo?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	"You must track this ship," says Rek. "A jump drive creates a temporary [portal? identity? oneness?] between two [locations, regions] in space. A species that [creates, manufactures] jump drives may be able to [track, detect] the residue of those links. Sayari tells me that such a species [lives in, borders on] Hai space. Perhaps they will aid you."|1158|0
units.english: "You must track this ship," says Rek. "A jump drive creates a temporary [portal? identity? oneness?] between two [locations, regions] in space. A species that [creates, manufactures] jump drives may be able to [track, detect] the residue of those links. Sayari tells me that such a species [lives in, borders on] Hai space. Perhaps they will aid you."
units.italian: "Devi rintracciare questa nave," dice Rek. "Un motore di salto crea un temporaneo [portale? identità? unità?] fra due [luoghi, regioni] dello spazio. Una specie che [crea, produce] motori di salto potrebbe essere in grado di [rintracciare, rilevare] il residuo di quei collegamenti. Sayari mi dice che una specie così [abita nello, confina con lo] spazio Hai. Forse ti aiuteranno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	You agree to make a visit to the Quarg ringworld in Hai space, and he wishes you luck on your journey.|1159|0
units.english: You agree to make a visit to the Quarg ringworld in Hai space, and he wishes you luck on your journey.
units.italian: Accetti di fare visita al mondo ad anello dei Quarg nello spazio Hai, e lui ti augura buona fortuna per il viaggio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|	As your ship is leaving the atmosphere, the surveillance cube suddenly glows red hot and collapses in on itself, melting down into a tiny pile of slag. Not only have you betrayed the Wanderers, but you are left with nothing to show for it.|1162|0
units.english: As your ship is leaving the atmosphere, the surveillance cube suddenly glows red hot and collapses in on itself, melting down into a tiny pile of slag. Not only have you betrayed the Wanderers, but you are left with nothing to show for it.
units.italian: Mentre la tua nave lascia l'atmosfera, il cubo di sorveglianza si accende di un rosso incandescente e collassa su se stesso, fondendosi in un mucchietto di scorie. Non solo hai tradito i Wanderers, ma non ti resta nulla da mostrare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Naughty)|As always, it is impossible to tell which of the Quarg is in charge here or might be able to help you. The first few you ask seem none too eager to give any technology related to the jump drive to a human, but finally one of them listens to your story and says, "I know of the Alphas. And of the Unfettered. There is one who may be willing to assist you." After a brief conversation in the Quarg language via a communication device, the Quarg says, "Go to the spaceport, and one will meet you to hear your petition."|1169|0
units.english: As always, it is impossible to tell which of the Quarg is in charge here or might be able to help you. The first few you ask seem none too eager to give any technology related to the jump drive to a human, but finally one of them listens to your story and says, "I know of the Alphas. And of the Unfettered. There is one who may be willing to assist you." After a brief conversation in the Quarg language via a communication device, the Quarg says, "Go to the spaceport, and one will meet you to hear your petition."
units.italian: Come sempre, è impossibile capire quale dei Quarg sia al comando qui o possa aiutarti. I primi a cui chiedi non sembrano affatto desiderosi di dare a un umano una tecnologia legata ai motori di salto, ma alla fine uno di loro ascolta la tua storia e dice: "Conosco gli Alphas. E gli Slegati. C'è uno che potrebbe essere disposto ad aiutarti." Dopo una breve conversazione in lingua Quarg tramite un dispositivo di comunicazione, il Quarg dice: "Va' allo spazioporto, e uno ti incontrerà per ascoltare la tua petizione."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|log|1186|0
units.english: The Pug in Wanderer space are not interested in helping the Wanderers to fight the Alphas. They say that interfering in Hai and human affairs is beyond their "jurisdiction."
units.italian: I Pug nello spazio dei Wanderers non sono interessati ad aiutare i Wanderers a combattere gli Alphas. Dicono che interferire negli affari degli Hai e degli umani è fuori dalla loro "giurisdizione".

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|You recall hearing hints that the Pug assisted the humans of the Deep in battle against the Alphas, so the Pug might be natural allies in your current mission. Would you like to see if any of them here will help you?|1188|0
units.english: You recall hearing hints that the Pug assisted the humans of the Deep in battle against the Alphas, so the Pug might be natural allies in your current mission. Would you like to see if any of them here will help you?
units.italian: Ricordi di aver sentito accenni al fatto che i Pug hanno aiutato gli umani del Deep in battaglia contro gli Alphas, quindi i Pug potrebbero essere alleati naturali nella tua missione attuale. Vuoi vedere se qualcuno di loro qui ti aiuterà?

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	(Yes.)|1190|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	(No.)|1191|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	You try to get several of the Pug to talk to you, but most of them pointedly ignore you. Eventually, probably because you've made it clear that you are not going away, one of them approaches you carrying a small black box. It speaks to the box in its language, and the box says, "Hello you are a human you are from planet Earth are you not." It seems that the box is a rudimentary translation device, speaking in a monotone voice and without pausing between sentences. It is somewhat jarring to listen to, but you understand what is being said.|1193|0
units.english: You try to get several of the Pug to talk to you, but most of them pointedly ignore you. Eventually, probably because you've made it clear that you are not going away, one of them approaches you carrying a small black box. It speaks to the box in its language, and the box says, "Hello you are a human you are from planet Earth are you not." It seems that the box is a rudimentary translation device, speaking in a monotone voice and without pausing between sentences. It is somewhat jarring to listen to, but you understand what is being said.
units.italian: Cerchi di far parlare diversi Pug, ma la maggior parte ti ignora deliberatamente. Alla fine, probabilmente perché hai chiarito che non te ne andrai, uno di loro ti si avvicina portando una piccola scatola nera. Parla alla scatola nella sua lingua, e la scatola dice: "Ciao tu sei un umano tu vieni dal pianeta Terra non è vero." Sembra che la scatola sia un traduttore rudimentale, che parla con voce monotona e senza pause fra le frasi. Ascoltarlo è un po' stridente, ma capisci quello che viene detto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	You say, "Yes, that's correct."|1194|0
units.english: You say, "Yes, that's correct."
units.italian: Dici: "Sì, è corretto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	The box appears to translate your words, and the Pug responds to it. The box says, "Humans are not our responsibility why have you come to our planet."|1195|0
units.english: The box appears to translate your words, and the Pug responds to it. The box says, "Humans are not our responsibility why have you come to our planet."
units.italian: La scatola sembra tradurre le tue parole, e il Pug le risponde. La scatola dice: "Gli umani non sono nostra responsabilità perché sei venuto sul nostro pianeta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	"The Alphas are causing trouble again, and I've heard that you helped us fight them in the past."|1197|0
units.english: "The Alphas are causing trouble again, and I've heard that you helped us fight them in the past."
units.italian: "Gli Alphas stanno di nuovo creando problemi, e ho sentito che in passato ci avete aiutato a combatterli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	"The Alphas have sided with the ones who are invading the Wanderers. Can you help us track them down?"|1198|0
units.english: "The Alphas have sided with the ones who are invading the Wanderers. Can you help us track them down?"
units.italian: "Gli Alphas si sono schierati con quelli che stanno invadendo i Wanderers. Potete aiutarci a rintracciarli?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	The Pug speaks again. "Who are the Alphas that name is not known to us."|1199|0
units.english: The Pug speaks again. "Who are the Alphas that name is not known to us."
units.italian: Il Pug parla di nuovo. "Chi sono gli Alphas quel nome non ci è noto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	You do your best to explain. Perhaps the humans of the Deep were wrong that the Pug knew about the Alphas. The Pug responds, "We can defend the Wanderers but the Hai and humans are beyond our jurisdiction we will not enter their space."|1200|0
units.english: You do your best to explain. Perhaps the humans of the Deep were wrong that the Pug knew about the Alphas. The Pug responds, "We can defend the Wanderers but the Hai and humans are beyond our jurisdiction we will not enter their space."
units.italian: Cerchi di spiegare come meglio puoi. Forse gli umani del Deep sbagliavano a credere che i Pug conoscessero gli Alphas. Il Pug risponde: "Possiamo difendere i Wanderers ma gli Hai e gli umani sono fuori dalla nostra giurisdizione non entreremo nel loro spazio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	(Give up and leave.)|1202|0
units.english: (Give up and leave.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	(Try to convince them to help.)|1204|0
units.english: (Try to convince them to help.)
units.italian: (Prova a convincerli ad aiutarvi.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance C (Pug)|	You do your best, but the Pug here are clearly not interested in helping you. Eventually you give up and return to your ship.|1205|0
units.english: You do your best, but the Pug here are clearly not interested in helping you. Eventually you give up and return to your ship.
units.italian: Fai del tuo meglio, ma i Pug qui non sono chiaramente interessati ad aiutarti. Alla fine rinunci e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: ship:Carrier|display name|1211|0
units.english: Modified Carrier
units.italian: Carrier modificata

units.id: ship:Carrier|"Bondir" Atomic Thruster|1231|0
units.english: "Bondir" Atomic Thruster
units.italian: "Bondir" Atomic Thruster

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|name|1267|0
units.english: Find the Alphas
units.italian: Trova gli Alphas

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|description|1268|0
units.english: With the help of Elias Hanover and his tracker device, locate the Alpha Base and then return to the Quarg ringworld of <planet>.
units.italian: Con l'aiuto di Elias Hanover e del suo dispositivo di tracciamento, individua la base degli Alphas e poi torna sul mondo ad anello dei Quarg, <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|blocked|1276|0
units.english: You need a bunk free in order to take on this mission.
units.italian: Ti serve una cuccetta libera per accettare questa missione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|log|1279|0
units.english: Met a human named Elias Hanover who is friends with the Quarg and who has been given permission to use Quarg technology to track the Alpha ship that is selling jump drives to the Unfettered.
units.italian: Hai incontrato un umano di nome Elias Hanover, amico dei Quarg, a cui è stato concesso di usare la tecnologia Quarg per rintracciare la nave Alpha che vende motori di salto agli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|log|1280|0
units.english: Elias has been living with the Quarg in Hai space for a long time, and they trust him enough to give him access to some of their restricted technology.
units.italian: Elias vive con i Quarg nello spazio Hai da molto tempo, e loro si fidano di lui abbastanza da dargli accesso a parte della loro tecnologia riservata.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|You are met in the spaceport by a bearded, middle-aged human man and a Quarg with exceptionally wrinkly skin. The Quarg says, "I hear that you need help against the Alphas. My friend Elias here has lived among us for a long time, and has told me much about the Alphas, their wars and their depredations."|1283|0
units.english: You are met in the spaceport by a bearded, middle-aged human man and a Quarg with exceptionally wrinkly skin. The Quarg says, "I hear that you need help against the Alphas. My friend Elias here has lived among us for a long time, and has told me much about the Alphas, their wars and their depredations."
units.italian: Allo spazioporto ti vengono incontro un umano di mezza età con la barba e un Quarg dalla pelle eccezionalmente rugosa. Il Quarg dice: "Sento che ti serve aiuto contro gli Alphas. Il mio amico Elias qui vive fra noi da molto tempo, e mi ha raccontato molto degli Alphas, delle loro guerre e delle loro depredazioni."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	The human shakes hands with you and introduces himself as Elias Hanover. He says, "The Quarg are very hesitant to take sides in what they view as an internal human conflict. And they are equally hesitant to entrust their technology to a stranger like you. But if the Alphas are gathering strength and amassing alien technology, they must be stopped."|1284|0
units.english: The human shakes hands with you and introduces himself as Elias Hanover. He says, "The Quarg are very hesitant to take sides in what they view as an internal human conflict. And they are equally hesitant to entrust their technology to a stranger like you. But if the Alphas are gathering strength and amassing alien technology, they must be stopped."
units.italian: L'umano ti stringe la mano e si presenta come Elias Hanover. Dice: "I Quarg sono molto restii a schierarsi in quello che considerano un conflitto interno agli umani. E sono altrettanto restii ad affidare la loro tecnologia a uno sconosciuto come te. Ma se gli Alphas stanno raccogliendo forze e accumulando tecnologia aliena, vanno fermati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	The Quarg says, "Elias is a trusted friend of ours. We have given him a device for tracking a ship traveling by jump drive, and programmed it with the parameters of a human Carrier. Do not try to take the device from him. He will lead you to find your quarry, and then you must return the device to us immediately."|1285|0
units.english: The Quarg says, "Elias is a trusted friend of ours. We have given him a device for tracking a ship traveling by jump drive, and programmed it with the parameters of a human Carrier. Do not try to take the device from him. He will lead you to find your quarry, and then you must return the device to us immediately."
units.italian: Il Quarg dice: "Elias è un nostro amico fidato. Gli abbiamo dato un dispositivo per rintracciare una nave che viaggia con un motore di salto, e l'abbiamo programmato con i parametri di un Carrier umano. Non provare a prendere il dispositivo da lui. Sarà lui a condurti alla tua preda, e poi dovrai restituirci il dispositivo immediatamente."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	Elias asks, "If we find them, are you prepared to take on a Carrier by yourself?"|1286|0
units.english: Elias asks, "If we find them, are you prepared to take on a Carrier by yourself?"
units.italian: Elias chiede: "Se li troviamo, sei pronto ad affrontare un Carrier da solo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	"Yes, my ship is stronger than anything in human space."|1288|0
units.english: "Yes, my ship is stronger than anything in human space."
units.italian: "Sì, la mia nave è più forte di qualsiasi cosa ci sia nello spazio umano."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	"I don't think so. Are you sure that will be necessary?"|1290|0
units.english: "I don't think so. Are you sure that will be necessary?"
units.italian: "Non credo. Sei sicuro che sarà necessario?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	"You think the Alphas are likely to surrender without a fight?" he asks. "Maybe you should invest in a Hai warship before we begin chasing them down."|1291|0
units.english: "You think the Alphas are likely to surrender without a fight?" he asks. "Maybe you should invest in a Hai warship before we begin chasing them down."
units.italian: "Pensi che sia probabile che gli Alphas si arrendano senza combattere?" chiede. "Forse dovresti investire in una nave da guerra Hai prima di metterci a inseguirli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|	You thank the Quarg for being willing to help you, and you and Elias return to your ship.|1293|0
units.english: You thank the Quarg for being willing to help you, and you and Elias return to your ship.
units.italian: Ringrazi il Quarg per la disponibilità ad aiutarti, e tu ed Elias tornate alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1298|0
units.english: As you enter the system, Elias checks his tracker device. "Yup, I'm picking up signs of a jump-enabled Carrier," he says. "The path goes east, beyond the edge of Hai space."
units.italian: Mentre entri nel sistema, Elias controlla il suo dispositivo di tracciamento. "Sì, sto captando i segni di un Carrier dotato di motore di salto," dice. "La traccia va a est, oltre il confine dello spazio Hai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1302|0
units.english: Elias checks the tracker again. "Southeast, from here," he says. Meanwhile, your ship's warning sirens begin going off; there are alien ships here, and they don't seem friendly.
units.italian: Elias controlla di nuovo il tracciante. "Da qui, verso sud-est," dice. Intanto le sirene d'allarme della tua nave cominciano a suonare: ci sono navi aliene qui, e non sembrano amichevoli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1306|0
units.english: Elias checks the tracker. "Still due southeast," he says. "And I hope those Korath ships aren't on the same side as the Alphas."
units.italian: Elias controlla il tracciante. "Sempre verso sud-est," dice. "E spero che quelle navi Korath non stiano dalla stessa parte degli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1311|0
units.english: Elias fiddles with his tracking device for a while, and then gives up. "Sorry, I'm not reading any signals here. Maybe they jumped right over this system?"
units.italian: Elias armeggia con il suo dispositivo di tracciamento per un po', poi rinuncia. "Mi dispiace, qui non leggo alcun segnale. Forse hanno saltato direttamente oltre questo sistema?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1314|0
units.english: Elias says, "Found their trail. They've turned and headed east again, and maybe a little bit north."
units.italian: Elias dice: "Ho trovato la loro traccia. Hanno girato e sono andati di nuovo a est, e forse un po' a nord."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1319|0
units.english: Elias frowns as he looks at the tracker's readout. "I think we've taken a wrong turn. No sign of jump drives being used in this system," he says.
units.italian: Elias aggrotta la fronte guardando il display del tracciante. "Credo che abbiamo sbagliato strada. In questo sistema non c'è segno di motori di salto usati," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1321|0
units.english: When you enter this system, your sensors pick up a Navy Carrier in orbit around an Earth-like planet. It appears that you have found the Alpha base. "That's them," says Hanover. "I hope you're strong enough to destroy them." The Carrier starts to launch fighters: Korath ones, not human ships. This might be a difficult fight...
units.italian: Quando entri in questo sistema, i sensori rilevano un Carrier della Marina in orbita intorno a un pianeta simile alla Terra. Sembra che tu abbia trovato la base degli Alphas. "Sono loro," dice Hanover. "Spero che tu sia abbastanza forte da distruggerli." Il Carrier comincia a lanciare caccia: Korath, non navi umane. Potrebbe essere uno scontro difficile...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1340|0
units.english: The Alpha Carrier has been destroyed. You can now return to the Quarg ringworld and plan your next steps.
units.italian: Il Carrier degli Alphas è stato distrutto. Ora puoi tornare sul mondo ad anello dei Quarg e pianificare i prossimi passi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|dialog|1358|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you have a feeling that your job isn't done. Either find where the Alphas are hiding, or return to where they are hiding and finish what you started.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma hai la sensazione che il tuo lavoro non sia finito. O scopri dove si nascondono gli Alphas, oppure torna dove si nascondono e finisci quello che hai cominciato.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|log|1360|0
units.english: Defeated a Navy Carrier, presumably being operated by the Alphas, that was equipped with Korath fighters and drones. Presumably there is an Alpha base hidden somewhere on the earth-like planet that the Carrier was guarding.
units.italian: Hai sconfitto un Carrier della Marina, presumibilmente condotto dagli Alphas, equipaggiato con caccia e droni Korath. Presumibilmente c'è una base Alpha nascosta da qualche parte sul pianeta simile alla Terra che il Carrier sorvegliava.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D|When you land back on <planet>, Elias says that he should go and immediately return the tracking device to his Quarg friend. "After that," he says, "we'll need to figure out who can help us to locate and bust open the Alpha base. Meet me in the spaceport when you're ready."|1362|0
units.english: When you land back on <planet>, Elias says that he should go and immediately return the tracking device to his Quarg friend. "After that," he says, "we'll need to figure out who can help us to locate and bust open the Alpha base. Meet me in the spaceport when you're ready."
units.italian: Quando atterri di nuovo su <planet>, Elias dice che deve andare a restituire subito il dispositivo di tracciamento al suo amico Quarg. "Dopo di che," dice, "dovremo capire chi può aiutarci a individuare e aprire la base degli Alphas. Incontrami allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance D (Avalon)|You park your ship high up on a mountain where you will be able to see if any of the giant reptiles approach. This is almost certainly where the Alphas have their base, but your sensors are not able to locate it, and even if you could you do not have a military ground force with you. To take care of the threat once and for all, you will need to return with an invasion force.|1373|0
units.english: You park your ship high up on a mountain where you will be able to see if any of the giant reptiles approach. This is almost certainly where the Alphas have their base, but your sensors are not able to locate it, and even if you could you do not have a military ground force with you. To take care of the threat once and for all, you will need to return with an invasion force.
units.italian: Parcheggi la nave in alto su una montagna, da dove potrai vedere se qualche gigantesco rettile si avvicina. Quasi certamente è qui che gli Alphas hanno la loro base, ma i tuoi sensori non riescono a individuarla, e anche se ci riuscissero non hai con te una forza militare di terra. Per eliminare la minaccia una volta per tutte, dovrai tornare con una forza d'invasione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|name|1379|0
units.english: Visit Danforth
units.italian: Visita Danforth

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|description|1380|0
units.english: Visit Admiral Danforth on <planet> and see if he is able to supply you with an attack force to locate and destroy the Alpha base.
units.italian: Visita l'ammiraglio Danforth su <planet> e vedi se può fornirti una forza d'attacco per individuare e distruggere la base degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|When you meet up with Elias Hanover in the spaceport, he says, "I can't think of any other way to go about it: we need to involve the Navy in this. No one else has the capability to launch a ground attack."|1389|0
units.english: When you meet up with Elias Hanover in the spaceport, he says, "I can't think of any other way to go about it: we need to involve the Navy in this. No one else has the capability to launch a ground attack."
units.italian: Quando incontri Elias Hanover allo spazioporto, dice: "Non vedo altro modo di procedere: dobbiamo coinvolgere la Marina. Nessun altro ha la capacità di lanciare un attacco di terra."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	"Are you sure we can trust them? The Alphas were in a Navy ship, after all."|1391|0
units.english: "Are you sure we can trust them? The Alphas were in a Navy ship, after all."
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che possiamo fidarci? Dopo tutto, gli Alphas erano su una nave della Marina."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	"We could go to Admiral Danforth. He's a Navy officer who I trust to be on the right side."|1392|0
units.english: "We could go to Admiral Danforth. He's a Navy officer who I trust to be on the right side."
units.italian: "Potremmo andare dall'ammiraglio Danforth. È un ufficiale della Marina di cui mi fido, sta dalla parte giusta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	"Can you think of any other option?" he says.|1394|0
units.english: "Can you think of any other option?" he says.
units.italian: "Ti viene in mente qualche altra opzione?" dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	"There's a branch of the Navy called the 'Oathkeepers,'" you tell him, "led by Admiral Danforth. If there is anyone in the Navy whom we can trust, it's them."|1395|0
units.english: "There's a branch of the Navy called the 'Oathkeepers,'" you tell him, "led by Admiral Danforth. If there is anyone in the Navy whom we can trust, it's them."
units.italian: "C'è una branca della Marina chiamata 'Oathkeepers'," gli dici, "guidata dall'ammiraglio Danforth. Se c'è qualcuno della Marina di cui possiamo fidarci, sono loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	"Danforth?" says Elias. "William Danforth? The Hero of Hope? He's still in the service?" You nod. "Well then yes, let's go to him," says Elias.|1397|0
units.english: "Danforth?" says Elias. "William Danforth? The Hero of Hope? He's still in the service?" You nod. "Well then yes, let's go to him," says Elias.
units.italian: "Danforth?" dice Elias. "William Danforth? L'Eroe di Hope? È ancora in servizio?" Annuisci. "Beh, allora sì, andiamo da lui," dice Elias.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|	He comes back aboard your ship, and you prepare to travel to Danforth's base on <destination>.|1398|0
units.english: He comes back aboard your ship, and you prepare to travel to Danforth's base on <destination>.
units.italian: Risale sulla tua nave, e tu ti prepari a viaggiare verso la base di Danforth su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|dialog|1402|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you realize that Elias is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive before meeting with Admiral Danforth.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Elias è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi prima di incontrare l'ammiraglio Danforth.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance E|Admiral Danforth is very pleased to see you, but his expression turns grim when you explain why you have come. When you mention the Alphas, he hushes you. "Let's not speak of that, out here in the open," he says. "Not that I do not trust my people, but it is best to be safe. I will gather troops who I know are able to operate discreetly and have them be ready to join us on an expedition. Meet me in my private office at the spaceport when you're ready."|1405|0
units.english: Admiral Danforth is very pleased to see you, but his expression turns grim when you explain why you have come. When you mention the Alphas, he hushes you. "Let's not speak of that, out here in the open," he says. "Not that I do not trust my people, but it is best to be safe. I will gather troops who I know are able to operate discreetly and have them be ready to join us on an expedition. Meet me in my private office at the spaceport when you're ready."
units.italian: L'ammiraglio Danforth è molto contento di vederti, ma la sua espressione si fa cupa quando gli spieghi perché sei venuto. Quando nomini gli Alphas, ti zittisce. "Non parliamone, qui all'aperto," dice. "Non che non mi fidi dei miei uomini, ma è meglio andare sul sicuro. Radunerò truppe che so capaci di agire con discrezione e le terrò pronte a unirsi a noi in spedizione. Incontrami nel mio ufficio privato allo spazioporto quando sei pronto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|name|1410|0
units.english: Invade Avalon
units.italian: Invadi Avalon

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|description|1411|0
units.english: Escort Admiral Danforth's Navy <npc model> to <destination> and land on the planet with them. They will attempt to locate and eliminate the Alpha base.
units.italian: Scorta il <npc model> della Marina dell'ammiraglio Danforth fino a <destination> e atterra sul pianeta con loro. Tenteranno di individuare ed eliminare la base degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|log|1420|0
units.english: Admiral Danforth agreed to bring his Cruiser to the planet in Korath space where the Alphas seem to be hiding, with enough troops and equipment to launch an assault on the base.
units.italian: L'ammiraglio Danforth ha accettato di portare il suo incrociatore sul pianeta nello spazio Korath dove sembrano nascondersi gli Alphas, con truppe ed equipaggiamento sufficienti a lanciare un assalto alla base.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|log|1421|0
units.english: However, the true reason that the powerful Oathkeeper fleet is positioned in the North is not just to keep the pirates at bay, but also to stand as a last defense in case the Hai decide to invade human space. Apparently the Navy has known about the Hai and the wormhole linking their space to human space for some time, but chooses not to make that knowledge public.
units.italian: Il vero motivo per cui la potente flotta degli Oathkeepers è schierata nel Nord, però, non è solo tenere a bada i pirati, ma anche costituire l'ultima difesa nel caso gli Hai decidano di invadere lo spazio umano. A quanto pare la Marina sa degli Hai e del cunicolo che collega il loro spazio a quello umano da tempo, ma sceglie di non rendere pubblica questa informazione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|Danforth welcomes you into his private office and uses a device to sweep the room for bugs. "Please forgive my caution," he says when he is done. "Now, show me where this planet is."|1423|0
units.english: Danforth welcomes you into his private office and uses a device to sweep the room for bugs. "Please forgive my caution," he says when he is done. "Now, show me where this planet is."
units.italian: Danforth ti accoglie nel suo ufficio privato e usa un dispositivo per scansionare la stanza in cerca di microspie. "Perdonami la cautela," dice quando ha finito. "Ora, mostrami dove si trova questo pianeta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	You show him the planet on your map. "That's a long way out from human space," says Danforth. "All the way on the other side of Hai territory. Are the Hai rebels still occupying these systems?" He points to the three systems where the Unfettered live.|1424|0
units.english: You show him the planet on your map. "That's a long way out from human space," says Danforth. "All the way on the other side of Hai territory. Are the Hai rebels still occupying these systems?" He points to the three systems where the Unfettered live.
units.italian: Gli mostri il pianeta sulla tua mappa. "È molto lontano dallo spazio umano," dice Danforth. "Addirittura dall'altra parte del territorio Hai. I ribelli Hai occupano ancora questi sistemi?" Indica i tre sistemi dove vivono gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"Yes."|1426|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"Wait, you know about the Hai?"|1428|0
units.english: "Wait, you know about the Hai?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, sai degli Hai?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	Danforth looks bemused. "Living on their doorstep? Of course I do. Why do you think the Navy maintains such a large base on Farpoint in the first place? It's not like the human anarchists up north pose that much of a threat."|1429|0
units.english: Danforth looks bemused. "Living on their doorstep? Of course I do. Why do you think the Navy maintains such a large base on Farpoint in the first place? It's not like the human anarchists up north pose that much of a threat."
units.italian: Danforth ha un'aria divertita. "Vivo sulla loro soglia di casa? Certo che lo so. Perché pensi che la Marina mantenga una base così grande su Farpoint? Non è che gli anarchici umani del nord rappresentino una minaccia così seria."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"It's not just the distance," says Elias. "The only way to get there is by jump drive. Fortunately Captain <last> has one."|1431|0
units.english: "It's not just the distance," says Elias. "The only way to get there is by jump drive. Fortunately Captain <last> has one."
units.italian: "Non è solo la distanza," dice Elias. "L'unico modo per arrivarci è con un motore di salto. Per fortuna il Capitano <last> ne ha uno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"As do I," says Danforth, a bit smugly. When he sees your surprised expressions he elaborates. "Recovered it from the Pug. Accidentally forgot to file the paperwork reporting it. You know how it is. Old men like me can be absent-minded." He smiles. "My engineers are installing it in my flagship even as we speak."|1432|0
units.english: "As do I," says Danforth, a bit smugly. When he sees your surprised expressions he elaborates. "Recovered it from the Pug. Accidentally forgot to file the paperwork reporting it. You know how it is. Old men like me can be absent-minded." He smiles. "My engineers are installing it in my flagship even as we speak."
units.italian: "Anch'io," dice Danforth, con una certa soddisfazione. Quando vede le vostre espressioni sorprese, spiega. "Recuperato dai Pug. Dimenticato per sbaglio di presentare le carte che lo segnalavano. Sapete come va. I vecchi come me possono essere distratti." Sorride. "I miei ingegneri lo stanno installando sulla mia ammiraglia proprio ora."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"So you're willing to come with us?"|1434|0
units.english: "So you're willing to come with us?"
units.italian: "Quindi sei disposto a venire con noi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"Are you sure you want to take the risk of traveling with us?"|1435|0
units.english: "Are you sure you want to take the risk of traveling with us?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro di voler correre il rischio di viaggiare con noi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|	"Wouldn't miss it for the world," he says. "With a mission like this, if I want it done right, I need to be there in person. Now, let's get going before the rumors start to fly. It's hard for three squadrons to prep for a secret mission without anyone else noticing."|1436|0
units.english: "Wouldn't miss it for the world," he says. "With a mission like this, if I want it done right, I need to be there in person. Now, let's get going before the rumors start to fly. It's hard for three squadrons to prep for a secret mission without anyone else noticing."
units.italian: "Non me lo perderei per nulla al mondo," dice. "Con una missione così, se voglio che sia fatta bene, devo esserci di persona. Ora, muoviamoci prima che comincino a circolare le voci. Non è facile per tre squadroni prepararsi a una missione segreta senza che nessun altro se ne accorga."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance F|dialog|1440|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Danforth's ship behind. Wait for him to arrive (or go back and refuel him, if necessary) and then return here.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Danforth. Aspetta che arrivi (o torna indietro a rifornirla, se necessario) e poi torna qui.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|name|1452|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|description|1453|0
units.english: Escort Admiral Danforth's ship safely back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta la nave dell'ammiraglio Danforth sana e salva fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|log|1461|0
units.english: The Alphas have fled from the base on Avalon. The Oathkeepers destroyed what is left of the base, which will hopefully set the Alphas back quite a bit.
units.italian: Gli Alphas sono fuggiti dalla base su Avalon. Gli Oathkeepers hanno distrutto ciò che resta della base, il che si spera li farà arretrare parecchio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|It does not take long for Danforth's team to locate the Alpha base, buried deep underground in a network of limestone caves. You and Danforth hover your ships above the site to catch anyone who tries to take off and escape. Danforth keeps you updated on the progress of the troops. "Breached the perimeter. Dealing with some booby traps. Explosives, poison gas. Nasty stuff. No sign of inhabitants, but they were here recently. Place looks cleaned out. Extensive base. Hangars, labs, supply rooms. Probably took them a century to build."|1463|0
units.english: It does not take long for Danforth's team to locate the Alpha base, buried deep underground in a network of limestone caves. You and Danforth hover your ships above the site to catch anyone who tries to take off and escape. Danforth keeps you updated on the progress of the troops. "Breached the perimeter. Dealing with some booby traps. Explosives, poison gas. Nasty stuff. No sign of inhabitants, but they were here recently. Place looks cleaned out. Extensive base. Hangars, labs, supply rooms. Probably took them a century to build."
units.italian: Alla squadra di Danforth non serve molto per individuare la base degli Alphas, sepolta in profondità in una rete di grotte calcaree. Tu e Danforth tenete le navi sospese sopra il sito per intercettare chiunque tenti di decollare e fuggire. Danforth ti aggiorna sui progressi delle truppe. "Superato il perimetro. Alle prese con alcune trappole esplosive. Esplosivi, gas velenoso. Roba brutta. Nessun segno di abitanti, ma erano qui di recente. Il posto sembra svuotato. Base estesa. Hangar, laboratori, magazzini. Probabilmente ci hanno messo un secolo a costruirla."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	His troops spend a while exploring the base and eventually conclude that the Alphas packed up and left soon after you destroyed the Carrier. Once the place has been thoroughly explored and they are sure there are no more clues to be found, Danforth tells them, "Okay, blow the place. No sense in leaving them a base to return to."|1464|0
units.english: His troops spend a while exploring the base and eventually conclude that the Alphas packed up and left soon after you destroyed the Carrier. Once the place has been thoroughly explored and they are sure there are no more clues to be found, Danforth tells them, "Okay, blow the place. No sense in leaving them a base to return to."
units.italian: Le sue truppe passano un po' di tempo a esplorare la base e alla fine concludono che gli Alphas hanno fatto i bagagli e se ne sono andati poco dopo che hai distrutto il Carrier. Una volta che il posto è stato esplorato a fondo e sono sicuri che non ci siano altri indizi da trovare, Danforth dice loro: "Bene, fatela saltare. Non ha senso lasciargli una base a cui tornare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"So this was all for nothing?"|1466|0
units.english: "So this was all for nothing?"
units.italian: "Quindi è stato tutto inutile?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"I wish we had been able to catch them."|1467|0
units.english: "I wish we had been able to catch them."
units.italian: "Vorrei che fossimo riusciti a prenderli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"Don't feel so bad," says Danforth. "At least you took out their Carrier. If you had come for me without engaging them, chances are they would still have figured their cover was blown and fled. And now they're on the run, which is going to limit their ability to make mischief."|1468|0
units.english: "Don't feel so bad," says Danforth. "At least you took out their Carrier. If you had come for me without engaging them, chances are they would still have figured their cover was blown and fled. And now they're on the run, which is going to limit their ability to make mischief."
units.italian: "Non prendertela troppo," dice Danforth. "Almeno hai eliminato il loro Carrier. Se fossi venuto da me senza affrontarli, probabilmente avrebbero comunque capito che la copertura era saltata e sarebbero fuggiti. E adesso sono in fuga, il che limiterà la loro capacità di combinare guai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	Danforth's ship collects his troops and takes off. A few seconds later he hails you. "Captain, we have incoming ships from the far side of the planet," he says. "My ship is no match for them. Let's get out of here." It looks like this world is not completely uninhabited, after all...|1469|0
units.english: Danforth's ship collects his troops and takes off. A few seconds later he hails you. "Captain, we have incoming ships from the far side of the planet," he says. "My ship is no match for them. Let's get out of here." It looks like this world is not completely uninhabited, after all...
units.italian: La nave di Danforth raccoglie le sue truppe e decolla. Pochi secondi dopo ti chiama. "Capitano, abbiamo navi in arrivo dall'altra parte del pianeta," dice. "La mia nave non è all'altezza. Andiamocene di qui." Sembra che questo mondo non sia del tutto disabitato, dopo tutto...

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|dialog|1488|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you left Danforth's ship behind. Wait for him to arrive (or go back and refuel him, if necessary) and then return here.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma hai lasciato indietro la nave di Danforth. Aspetta che arrivi (o torna indietro a rifornirla, se necessario) e poi torna qui.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|You and Elias return to Danforth's private office to debrief, but a few minutes after you arrive there is a knock on the door. Danforth pulls up a video monitor to check who it is, swears, takes a brief glance around the room as if to check that he hasn't left anything incriminating out in plain sight, then opens the door. An officer in an unmarked uniform walks in along with several armed guards. "Admiral Danforth," says the officer, "I trust your expedition went well?"|1492|0
units.english: You and Elias return to Danforth's private office to debrief, but a few minutes after you arrive there is a knock on the door. Danforth pulls up a video monitor to check who it is, swears, takes a brief glance around the room as if to check that he hasn't left anything incriminating out in plain sight, then opens the door. An officer in an unmarked uniform walks in along with several armed guards. "Admiral Danforth," says the officer, "I trust your expedition went well?"
units.italian: Tu ed Elias tornate nell'ufficio privato di Danforth per il debriefing, ma pochi minuti dopo il vostro arrivo qualcuno bussa alla porta. Danforth accende un monitor video per controllare chi è, impreca, dà una rapida occhiata alla stanza come per verificare di non aver lasciato nulla di compromettente in vista, poi apre la porta. Entra un ufficiale in uniforme senza insegne, insieme a diverse guardie armate. "Ammiraglio Danforth," dice l'ufficiale, "spero che la sua spedizione sia andata bene?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	Danforth mumbles something in reply. "And you, Captain <last>," says the officer, "Always in the thick of things, eh?"|1493|0
units.english: Danforth mumbles something in reply. "And you, Captain <last>," says the officer, "Always in the thick of things, eh?"
units.italian: Danforth borbotta qualcosa in risposta. "E lei, Capitano <last>," dice l'ufficiale, "sempre nel bel mezzo delle cose, eh?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"I suppose so."|1495|0
units.english: "I suppose so."
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"Only when the galaxy needs saving."|1496|0
units.english: "Only when the galaxy needs saving."
units.italian: "Solo quando la galassia ha bisogno di essere salvata."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"Just trying to do what's right."|1497|0
units.english: "Just trying to do what's right."
units.italian: "Cerco solo di fare la cosa giusta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	The officer turns to Elias. "And Mister Hanover," he says, "I want to thank you personally for assisting us in the fight against the Alphas, once again."|1498|0
units.english: The officer turns to Elias. "And Mister Hanover," he says, "I want to thank you personally for assisting us in the fight against the Alphas, once again."
units.italian: L'ufficiale si volta verso Elias. "E signor Hanover," dice, "voglio ringraziarla personalmente per averci assistito nella lotta contro gli Alphas, ancora una volta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"You're welcome," says Hanover, warily.|1499|0
units.english: "You're welcome," says Hanover, warily.
units.italian: "Prego," dice Hanover, con diffidenza.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"You're very camera shy," says the officer. "You didn't stick around long enough to receive our thanks after helping to liberate those worlds in the Dirt Belt back in 2894 AD. Of course, you went by 'Jeremy Hanover' back then." He hands Hanover a photo of some Navy officers talking with a man who looks very much like Hanover himself.|1500|0
units.english: "You're very camera shy," says the officer. "You didn't stick around long enough to receive our thanks after helping to liberate those worlds in the Dirt Belt back in 2894 AD. Of course, you went by 'Jeremy Hanover' back then." He hands Hanover a photo of some Navy officers talking with a man who looks very much like Hanover himself.
units.italian: "Lei è molto schivo davanti alle telecamere," dice l'ufficiale. "Non è rimasto abbastanza a lungo per ricevere i nostri ringraziamenti dopo aver contribuito a liberare quei mondi nella Dirt Belt nel 2894 d.C. Naturalmente, allora si faceva chiamare 'Jeremy Hanover'." Porge a Hanover una foto di alcuni ufficiali della Marina che parlano con un uomo che somiglia molto a Hanover stesso.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"That was my grandfather," says Hanover.|1501|0
units.english: "That was my grandfather," says Hanover.
units.italian: "Era mio nonno," dice Hanover.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	"I see," says the officer. "Of course, what you deserve even more thanks for is your assistance during the Second Alpha War. Here's a photo of you from 2461 AD." He displays another photo, again apparently of Hanover himself, with some men in archaic pre-Republic uniforms. The guards standing behind you raise their weapons and point them at you and Elias.|1502|0
units.english: "I see," says the officer. "Of course, what you deserve even more thanks for is your assistance during the Second Alpha War. Here's a photo of you from 2461 AD." He displays another photo, again apparently of Hanover himself, with some men in archaic pre-Republic uniforms. The guards standing behind you raise their weapons and point them at you and Elias.
units.italian: "Capisco," dice l'ufficiale. "Certo, ciò per cui merita ancor più ringraziamenti è il suo aiuto durante la Seconda Guerra degli Alphas. Ecco una sua foto del 2461 d.C." Mostra un'altra foto, ancora apparentemente di Hanover stesso, con alcuni uomini in uniformi arcaiche, precedenti alla Repubblica. Le guardie alle vostre spalle alzano le armi e le puntano su di te e su Elias.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	(Stay where I am.)|1504|0
units.english: (Stay where I am.)
units.italian: (Resta dove sono.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	(Try to fight.)|1506|0
units.english: (Try to fight.)
units.italian: (Prova a combattere.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	(Try to run away.)|1507|0
units.english: (Try to run away.)
units.italian: (Prova a fuggire.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	You jump up from your seat. The guards fire, and everything goes black.|1508|0
units.english: You jump up from your seat. The guards fire, and everything goes black.
units.italian: Balzi in piedi dal posto. Le guardie sparano, e tutto diventa nero.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance G|	You raise your hands in surrender. The guards fire, and everything goes black.|1511|0
units.english: You raise your hands in surrender. The guards fire, and everything goes black.
units.italian: Alzi le mani in segno di resa. Le guardie sparano, e tutto diventa nero.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|name|1517|0
units.english: Meet up with Danforth
units.italian: Incontra Danforth

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|description|1518|0
units.english: Meet Admiral Danforth in the spaceport on <origin>, and talk about what to do next about the Alphas.
units.italian: Incontra l'ammiraglio Danforth allo spazioporto di <origin> e parla di che cosa fare adesso con gli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|log|1526|0
