units.english: Was taken captive, along with Elias Hanover, by some nameless Republic officers who thought Elias was an Alpha. They discovered that he is not one, although he appears to have some of the same genetically engineered advantages that the Alphas have.
units.italian: Sei stato preso prigioniero, insieme a Elias Hanover, da alcuni ufficiali della Repubblica senza nome che credevano che Elias fosse un Alpha. Hanno scoperto che non lo è, anche se sembra avere alcuni dei vantaggi da ingegneria genetica tipici degli Alphas.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|log|1527|0
units.english: Certain Navy officers believe that Elias may actually be more than five centuries old, and that he may be a genetically modified individual, perhaps specifically designed to have capabilities similar to the Alphas so that he can fight against them.
units.italian: Alcuni ufficiali della Marina credono che Elias possa avere più di cinque secoli, e che sia un individuo geneticamente modificato, forse progettato appositamente per avere capacità simili a quelle degli Alphas, così da poterli combattere.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|You wake up with a pounding headache and the groggy, hung-over feeling of having been shot with a military grade stun gun. You are strapped into a metal chair with at least a dozen electrodes connected to your head and body. Elias is in a similar chair facing you. A technician stands behind a bank of computer displays in one corner, with the nameless officer looking on.|1529|0
units.english: You wake up with a pounding headache and the groggy, hung-over feeling of having been shot with a military grade stun gun. You are strapped into a metal chair with at least a dozen electrodes connected to your head and body. Elias is in a similar chair facing you. A technician stands behind a bank of computer displays in one corner, with the nameless officer looking on.
units.italian: Ti svegli con un mal di testa martellante e la sensazione stordita e intontita di chi è stato colpito con una pistola stordente militare. Sei legato a una sedia di metallo con almeno una dozzina di elettrodi collegati alla testa e al corpo. Elias è in una sedia simile, di fronte a te. Un tecnico sta dietro a una parete di schermi in un angolo, con l'ufficiale senza nome che osserva.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"What's going on?"|1531|0
units.english: "What's going on?"
units.italian: "Che cosa sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"I demand that you let me go!"|1533|0
units.english: "I demand that you let me go!"
units.italian: "Pretendo che mi lasciate andare!"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	(Say nothing.)|1535|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	Seeing that you are both awake, the officer walks over and looks at you for a second with a cool, appraising expression. Then without warning, he punches you in the face.|1536|0
units.english: Seeing that you are both awake, the officer walks over and looks at you for a second with a cool, appraising expression. Then without warning, he punches you in the face.
units.italian: Vedendo che siete entrambi svegli, l'ufficiale si avvicina e ti guarda per un secondo con un'espressione fredda e valutativa. Poi, senza avvertire, ti sferra un pugno in faccia.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"Standard operating procedure," says the officer, walking over to you. Then, without warning, he punches you in the face.|1539|0
units.english: "Standard operating procedure," says the officer, walking over to you. Then, without warning, he punches you in the face.
units.italian: "Procedura operativa standard," dice l'ufficiale, avvicinandosi a te. Poi, senza avvertire, ti sferra un pugno in faccia.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	The officer walks over to you. "Sorry, I can't let you go just yet," he says. Then, without warning, he punches you in the face.|1542|0
units.english: The officer walks over to you. "Sorry, I can't let you go just yet," he says. Then, without warning, he punches you in the face.
units.italian: L'ufficiale si avvicina a te. "Mi dispiace, non posso lasciarvi andare, non ancora," dice. Poi, senza avvertire, ti sferra un pugno in faccia.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	While you are still reeling from the blow, the officer walks over to Elias and punches him, as well. He pauses to adjust one of the electrodes that was loosened by the blow, then walks back to you and punches you again. The technician stares down at the computer screens with an intense frown on his face as the officer hits Elias again and then walks back to you.|1544|0
units.english: While you are still reeling from the blow, the officer walks over to Elias and punches him, as well. He pauses to adjust one of the electrodes that was loosened by the blow, then walks back to you and punches you again. The technician stares down at the computer screens with an intense frown on his face as the officer hits Elias again and then walks back to you.
units.italian: Mentre sei ancora stordito dal colpo, l'ufficiale va da Elias e colpisce anche lui. Si ferma a sistemare uno degli elettrodi che il colpo ha allentato, poi torna da te e ti colpisce di nuovo. Il tecnico fissa gli schermi con un cipiglio intenso mentre l'ufficiale colpisce di nuovo Elias e poi torna da te.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"What the hell are you doing?"|1546|0
units.english: "What the hell are you doing?"
units.italian: "Che diavolo state facendo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"Please just tell me what you want."|1548|0
units.english: "Please just tell me what you want."
units.italian: "Per favore, ditemi solo che cosa volete."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	(Spit in his face.)|1550|0
units.english: (Spit in his face.)
units.italian: (Sputagli in faccia.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	(Do nothing.)|1552|0
units.english: (Do nothing.)
units.italian: (Non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	The officer glances over at the technician, who says, "<last> appears to be well within human parameters, sir."|1553|0
units.english: The officer glances over at the technician, who says, "<last> appears to be well within human parameters, sir."
units.italian: L'ufficiale lancia un'occhiata al tecnico, che dice: "<last> rientra ampiamente nei parametri umani, signore."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	He ignores your question and glances over at the technician, who says, "<last> appears to be well within human parameters, sir."|1556|0
units.english: He ignores your question and glances over at the technician, who says, "<last> appears to be well within human parameters, sir."
units.italian: Ignora la tua domanda e lancia un'occhiata al tecnico, che dice: "<last> rientra ampiamente nei parametri umani, signore."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"Interesting," he says, as he wipes the spittle off his face with his sleeve. Then he glances over at the technician. "Did you get a read on that?"|1559|0
units.english: "Interesting," he says, as he wipes the spittle off his face with his sleeve. Then he glances over at the technician. "Did you get a read on that?"
units.italian: "Interessante," dice, mentre si asciuga lo sputo dal viso con la manica. Poi lancia un'occhiata al tecnico. "Hai rilevato qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"<last> is well within human parameters, sir," says the technician.|1560|0
units.english: "<last> is well within human parameters, sir," says the technician.
units.italian: "<last> rientra ampiamente nei parametri umani, signore," dice il tecnico.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	The officer nods in acknowledgment, then unclips your arm restraints. "It seems I owe you an apology, Captain," he says. "Would you like to hit me back?" He leans in toward you to put his face within striking range.|1562|0
units.english: The officer nods in acknowledgment, then unclips your arm restraints. "It seems I owe you an apology, Captain," he says. "Would you like to hit me back?" He leans in toward you to put his face within striking range.
units.italian: L'ufficiale annuisce in segno di assenso, poi sgancia i tuoi fermagli per le braccia. "Mi dispiace di doverti chiedere scusa, Capitano," dice. "Vuoi restituirmi il colpo?" Si sporge verso di te per metterti la faccia a tiro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"No thanks."|1564|0
units.english: "No thanks."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	(Punch him back.)|1565|0
units.english: (Punch him back.)
units.italian: (Colpiscilo anche tu.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"How kind of you," he says. Then he asks the technician, "What about Hanover?"|1567|0
units.english: "How kind of you," he says. Then he asks the technician, "What about Hanover?"
units.italian: "Che gentile," dice. Poi chiede al tecnico: "E Hanover?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	The technician says, "Hanover isn't human. Or Alpha. I've never seen readings like this before, except maybe from an empath."|1568|0
units.english: The technician says, "Hanover isn't human. Or Alpha. I've never seen readings like this before, except maybe from an empath."
units.italian: Il tecnico dice: "Hanover non è umano. Né Alpha. Non ho mai visto letture così, se non forse in un empatico."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	You punch him. He staggers back, then looks over at the technician, who reports, "Hanover felt that, sir. Empathetic response."|1571|0
units.english: You punch him. He staggers back, then looks over at the technician, who reports, "Hanover felt that, sir. Empathetic response."
units.italian: Lo colpisci. Lui barcolla all'indietro, poi guarda il tecnico, che riferisce: "Hanover l'ha sentito, signore. Risposta empatica."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"What?" says the officer. He walks over and studies the monitors for a minute, then says, "Mister Hanover, you have the skin of a human. You have the physique of an Alpha. But you registered more sympathetic pain from watching someone else get struck in the face than you did when you yourself were punched, which makes your brain the complete opposite of an Alpha's. So, what the hell are you? Who made you, and why?"|1573|0
units.english: "What?" says the officer. He walks over and studies the monitors for a minute, then says, "Mister Hanover, you have the skin of a human. You have the physique of an Alpha. But you registered more sympathetic pain from watching someone else get struck in the face than you did when you yourself were punched, which makes your brain the complete opposite of an Alpha's. So, what the hell are you? Who made you, and why?"
units.italian: "Come?" dice l'ufficiale. Si avvicina e studia i monitor per un minuto, poi dice: "Signor Hanover, lei ha la pelle di un umano. Ha il fisico di un Alpha. Ma ha registrato più dolore simpatico vedendo colpire qualcun altro in faccia di quanto ne abbia registrato quando è stato colpito lei, il che rende il suo cervello l'esatto opposto di quello di un Alpha. Quindi, che diavolo è? Chi l'ha creato, e perché?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	Elias says nothing.|1574|0
units.english: Elias says nothing.
units.italian: Elias non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"Sir," says the technician, "could the stories be true?" The look in his eyes is something approaching awe.|1575|0
units.english: "Sir," says the technician, "could the stories be true?" The look in his eyes is something approaching awe.
units.italian: "Signore," dice il tecnico, "le storie potrebbero essere vere?" Lo sguardo nei suoi occhi è qualcosa che somiglia al timore reverenziale.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"Yes, there are the old legends," says the officer thoughtfully. "A secret weapon against the Alphas. Made in government labs with forbidden technology. Like the Alphas in some ways, but designed to serve, not to master all. Is that what you are? Are you a Beta?" Elias says nothing.|1576|0
units.english: "Yes, there are the old legends," says the officer thoughtfully. "A secret weapon against the Alphas. Made in government labs with forbidden technology. Like the Alphas in some ways, but designed to serve, not to master all. Is that what you are? Are you a Beta?" Elias says nothing.
units.italian: "Sì, esistono le vecchie leggende," dice l'ufficiale, pensieroso. "Un'arma segreta contro gli Alphas. Creata nei laboratori del governo con tecnologia proibita. Simile agli Alphas per certi versi, ma progettata per servire, non per dominare. È questo che sei? Sei un Beta?" Elias non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"If he's not an Alpha, you have no right to imprison us."|1578|0
units.english: "If he's not an Alpha, you have no right to imprison us."
units.italian: "Se non è un Alpha, non avete il diritto di imprigionarci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"If you're convinced that neither of us is an Alpha, will you please let us go?"|1579|0
units.english: "If you're convinced that neither of us is an Alpha, will you please let us go?"
units.italian: "Se siete convinto che nessuno di noi due sia un Alpha, volete lasciarci andare?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	"I suppose so," says the officer. As they release you from the chairs, he says to Elias, "If you are what I believe you are, we can help you to complete your work at last. Gather your siblings. Join us. Together we can put an end to the Alphas." Still, Elias says nothing.|1580|0
units.english: "I suppose so," says the officer. As they release you from the chairs, he says to Elias, "If you are what I believe you are, we can help you to complete your work at last. Gather your siblings. Join us. Together we can put an end to the Alphas." Still, Elias says nothing.
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì," dice l'ufficiale. Mentre vi liberano dalle sedie, dice a Elias: "Se sei quello che credo, possiamo aiutarti a completare finalmente il tuo lavoro. Raduna i tuoi fratelli. Unisciti a noi. Insieme possiamo porre fine agli Alphas." Elias, però, non dice nulla.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	They lead you out into the hallway and you realize you are on board a Navy Cruiser. As you leave the ship, the officer tells Elias, "Think about what I said."|1581|0
units.english: They lead you out into the hallway and you realize you are on board a Navy Cruiser. As you leave the ship, the officer tells Elias, "Think about what I said."
units.italian: Vi portano nel corridoio e ti rendi conto di essere a bordo di un incrociatore della Marina. Mentre lasciate la nave, l'ufficiale dice a Elias: "Pensaci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance H|	Elias remains quiet while you are in earshot of the ship, then says, "Let's meet up with Danforth back in the spaceport and see what he thinks we should do next."|1582|0
units.english: Elias remains quiet while you are in earshot of the ship, then says, "Let's meet up with Danforth back in the spaceport and see what he thinks we should do next."
units.italian: Elias resta in silenzio finché la nave è a portata d'orecchio, poi dice: "Incontriamo Danforth allo spazioporto e vediamo che cosa pensa che dobbiamo fare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|name|1588|0
units.english: Return Elias to <planet>
units.italian: Riporta Elias su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|description|1589|0
units.english: Bring Elias Hanover back to <destination>, where he will hopefully be safe from Alpha retaliation for driving them out of their base on Avalon.
units.italian: Porta Elias Hanover su <destination>, dove si spera sarà al sicuro da ritorsioni degli Alphas per averli scacciati dalla loro base su Avalon.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|blocked|1596|0
units.english: You don't have enough passenger space to take on this mission. Return here when you have a bunk free.
units.italian: Non hai abbastanza spazio per passeggeri per accettare questa missione. Torna qui quando avrai una cuccetta libera.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|Danforth looks relieved to see you both alive. "Damned Republic Intelligence Agency," he says. "They think they're above the law. And after all that they decided you both are clean?" He looks intently at Elias.|1601|0
units.english: Danforth looks relieved to see you both alive. "Damned Republic Intelligence Agency," he says. "They think they're above the law. And after all that they decided you both are clean?" He looks intently at Elias.
units.italian: Danforth sembra sollevato nel vedervi vivi. "Maledetta Agenzia di Intelligence della Repubblica," dice. "Credono di essere al di sopra della legge. E dopo tutto questo hanno deciso che siete puliti entrambi?" Guarda Elias intensamente.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	"Yes, in fact now they're trying to get us to work together with them against the Alphas."|1603|0
units.english: "Yes, in fact now they're trying to get us to work together with them against the Alphas."
units.italian: "Sì, e in effetti ora stanno cercando di farci collaborare con loro contro gli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	"Yes, and they think Elias can help them against the Alphas."|1604|0
units.english: "Yes, and they think Elias can help them against the Alphas."
units.italian: "Sì, e pensano che Elias possa aiutarli contro gli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	"I see," says Danforth. "I wish I could tell you that they can be trusted. I wish I could tell you that there is no safer place for an enemy of the Alphas than here with me."|1605|0
units.english: "I see," says Danforth. "I wish I could tell you that they can be trusted. I wish I could tell you that there is no safer place for an enemy of the Alphas than here with me."
units.italian: "Capisco," dice Danforth. "Vorrei poterti dire che ci si può fidare di loro. Vorrei poterti dire che non esiste posto più sicuro per un nemico degli Alphas che qui con me."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	He pauses to pull out a data pad from his desk and call up a file on it. "Recently," says Danforth, "an officer of mine assisted in taking down an Alpha enclave, like you have done." He's looking specifically at Elias as he says that. "A month later he was somehow assassinated, right here in my Naval base. Here's a photo of him." Danforth slides the data pad across the desk. It's showing a man you do not recognize, but Elias stifles a cry of dismay when he sees who it is. Danforth says, "I can't pretend you would be safe here. I think the safest thing for both of you would be to leave human space for a while."|1608|0
units.english: He pauses to pull out a data pad from his desk and call up a file on it. "Recently," says Danforth, "an officer of mine assisted in taking down an Alpha enclave, like you have done." He's looking specifically at Elias as he says that. "A month later he was somehow assassinated, right here in my Naval base. Here's a photo of him." Danforth slides the data pad across the desk. It's showing a man you do not recognize, but Elias stifles a cry of dismay when he sees who it is. Danforth says, "I can't pretend you would be safe here. I think the safest thing for both of you would be to leave human space for a while."
units.italian: Si ferma a prendere una tavoletta dati dalla scrivania e ad aprirvi un file. "Di recente," dice Danforth, "un mio ufficiale ha contribuito a smantellare un insediamento Alpha, come avete fatto voi." Sta guardando specificamente Elias mentre lo dice. "Un mese dopo è stato assassinato, non si sa come, proprio qui nella mia base navale. Ecco una sua foto." Danforth fa scivolare la tavoletta sulla scrivania. Mostra un uomo che non riconosci, ma Elias soffoca un grido di sgomento quando vede chi è. Danforth dice: "Non posso fingere che qui sareste al sicuro. Credo che la cosa più sicura per entrambi sia lasciare lo spazio umano per un po'."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	He pauses to pull out a data pad from his desk and call up a file on it. "Recently," says Danforth, "an officer of mine assisted in taking down an Alpha enclave, like you have done." He's looking specifically at Elias as he says that. "A month later he was somehow assassinated, right here in my Naval base. Here's a photo of him." Danforth slides the data pad across the desk. It's showing a photo of Commander Nguyen, and to your surprise Elias stifles a cry of dismay when he sees who it is. Danforth says, "I can't pretend you would be safe here. I think the safest thing for both of you would be to leave human space for a while."|1611|0
units.english: He pauses to pull out a data pad from his desk and call up a file on it. "Recently," says Danforth, "an officer of mine assisted in taking down an Alpha enclave, like you have done." He's looking specifically at Elias as he says that. "A month later he was somehow assassinated, right here in my Naval base. Here's a photo of him." Danforth slides the data pad across the desk. It's showing a photo of Commander Nguyen, and to your surprise Elias stifles a cry of dismay when he sees who it is. Danforth says, "I can't pretend you would be safe here. I think the safest thing for both of you would be to leave human space for a while."
units.italian: Si ferma a prendere una tavoletta dati dalla scrivania e ad aprirvi un file. "Di recente," dice Danforth, "un mio ufficiale ha contribuito a smantellare un insediamento Alpha, come avete fatto voi." Sta guardando specificamente Elias mentre lo dice. "Un mese dopo è stato assassinato, non si sa come, proprio qui nella mia base navale. Ecco una sua foto." Danforth fa scivolare la tavoletta sulla scrivania. Mostra una foto del comandante Nguyen, e con tua sorpresa Elias soffoca un grido di sgomento quando vede chi è. Danforth dice: "Non posso fingere che qui sareste al sicuro. Credo che la cosa più sicura per entrambi sia lasciare lo spazio umano per un po'."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|	You agree that you will take Elias back to Alta Hai. Whatever Elias is, whoever might wish him harm, you can only hope that a Quarg ringworld is the safest place for him right now.|1614|0
units.english: You agree that you will take Elias back to Alta Hai. Whatever Elias is, whoever might wish him harm, you can only hope that a Quarg ringworld is the safest place for him right now.
units.italian: Concordi che porterai Elias ad Alta Hai. Qualunque cosa sia Elias, chiunque possa volergli male, puoi solo sperare che un mondo ad anello dei Quarg sia il posto più sicuro per lui in questo momento.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance I|dialog|1617|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you realize that Elias is on one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che Elias è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|name|1622|0
units.english: Return to Iktat Rek on <planet>
units.italian: Torna da Iktat Rek su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|description|1623|0
units.english: Check in with Iktat Rek on <planet> in the <system> system, now that the Alpha base has been eliminated.
units.italian: Presentati a Iktat Rek su <planet>, nel sistema <system>, ora che la base degli Alphas è stata eliminata.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|You drop Elias off on <origin>. "Don't worry about me," he says, "The Quarg have kept me safe here for a long time. Thanks for being willing to risk your life against the Alphas."|1633|0
units.english: You drop Elias off on <origin>. "Don't worry about me," he says, "The Quarg have kept me safe here for a long time. Thanks for being willing to risk your life against the Alphas."
units.italian: Lasci Elias su <origin>. "Non preoccuparti per me," dice. "I Quarg mi tengono al sicuro qui da molto tempo. Grazie per essere stato disposto a rischiare la vita contro gli Alphas."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	"Wait, won't you tell me whether anything that officer said about you was true?"|1635|0
units.english: "Wait, won't you tell me whether anything that officer said about you was true?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, non mi dirai se qualcosa di quello che quell'ufficiale ha detto su di te era vero?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	(Let him go without pressing him for more information.)|1636|0
units.english: (Let him go without pressing him for more information.)
units.italian: (Lascialo andare senza insistere per avere altre informazioni.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	He says, "It is true that I am six centuries old. It is true that I am not strictly human. It is true that I oppose the Alphas. More than that, I will not share, both for my own safety and for yours."|1638|0
units.english: He says, "It is true that I am six centuries old. It is true that I am not strictly human. It is true that I oppose the Alphas. More than that, I will not share, both for my own safety and for yours."
units.italian: Dice: "È vero che ho sei secoli. È vero che non sono strettamente umano. È vero che mi oppongo agli Alphas. Più di questo non dirò, sia per la mia sicurezza sia per la tua."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	You wish Elias the best of luck and tell him that you hope to meet again one day. Now you should probably return to Wanderer space and check in with Iktat Rek.|1640|0
units.english: You wish Elias the best of luck and tell him that you hope to meet again one day. Now you should probably return to Wanderer space and check in with Iktat Rek.
units.italian: Auguri a Elias ogni bene e gli dici che speri di rivederlo un giorno. Ora probabilmente dovresti tornare nello spazio dei Wanderers e presentarti a Iktat Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|log|1647|0
units.english: Reported to the Wanderers that the Alphas who had been selling jump drives to the Unfettered have been weakened and driven into hiding. The Wanderers are ramping up production of military ships to try to face the continuing Unfettered onslaught.
units.italian: Hai riferito ai Wanderers che gli Alphas, che vendevano motori di salto agli Slegati, sono stati indeboliti e costretti a nascondersi. I Wanderers stanno aumentando la produzione di navi militari per cercare di fronteggiare la continua offensiva degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|It's hard to be certain, but the activity around the spaceport seems more hectic than usual, and the Wanderers seem to have put some new ship models into production as well. When you ask Iktat Rek about it, he says, "When the Unfettered first [invaded, occupied] our territory, we had almost no weapons of [war, defense]. Since then we have retrieved old [designs, instructions] and begun preparing for what is to come, [unpleasant, unfortunate] though it may be."|1649|0
units.english: It's hard to be certain, but the activity around the spaceport seems more hectic than usual, and the Wanderers seem to have put some new ship models into production as well. When you ask Iktat Rek about it, he says, "When the Unfettered first [invaded, occupied] our territory, we had almost no weapons of [war, defense]. Since then we have retrieved old [designs, instructions] and begun preparing for what is to come, [unpleasant, unfortunate] though it may be."
units.italian: È difficile esserne certi, ma l'attività intorno allo spazioporto sembra più frenetica del solito, e i Wanderers sembrano aver avviato la produzione di nuovi modelli di nave. Quando chiedi spiegazioni a Iktat Rek, dice: "Quando gli Slegati [hanno invaso, hanno occupato] il nostro territorio per la prima volta, non avevamo quasi nessuna arma di [guerra, difesa]. Da allora abbiamo recuperato vecchi [progetti, istruzioni] e abbiamo cominciato a prepararci a ciò che verrà, per [spiacevole, increscioso] che sia."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	As you describe your mixed success at dealing with the Alphas, he shakes his wings and ruffles out his feathers in what seems to be a nervous, agitated gesture. "These Alpha [beings, creatures] sound more [dangerous, unreasonable, ruthless] than the Unfettered," he says. "Any [social, gregarious] species that evolves naturally develops certain [limits, checks, restraints] that an [artificial, constructed] species may not possess. How can we best [respond to, deal with] them?"|1650|0
units.english: As you describe your mixed success at dealing with the Alphas, he shakes his wings and ruffles out his feathers in what seems to be a nervous, agitated gesture. "These Alpha [beings, creatures] sound more [dangerous, unreasonable, ruthless] than the Unfettered," he says. "Any [social, gregarious] species that evolves naturally develops certain [limits, checks, restraints] that an [artificial, constructed] species may not possess. How can we best [respond to, deal with] them?"
units.italian: Mentre gli descrivi il tuo successo parziale con gli Alphas, scuote le ali e arruffa le piume in quello che sembra un gesto nervoso e agitato. "Questi [esseri, creature] Alpha sembrano più [pericolosi, irragionevoli, spietati] degli Slegati," dice. "Qualsiasi specie [sociale, gregaria] che si evolva naturalmente sviluppa certi [limiti, freni, vincoli] che una specie [artificiale, costruita] potrebbe non avere. Come possiamo [rispondere a, trattare con] loro nel modo migliore?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	"It may be wisest to leave them alone."|1652|0
units.english: "It may be wisest to leave them alone."
units.italian: "Forse è più saggio lasciarli in pace."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	"I think the only answer is to be strong enough that they leave you alone."|1653|0
units.english: "I think the only answer is to be strong enough that they leave you alone."
units.italian: "Credo che l'unica risposta sia essere abbastanza forti perché vi lascino in pace."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	"Sooner or later we will have to hunt them down and destroy them."|1654|0
units.english: "Sooner or later we will have to hunt them down and destroy them."
units.italian: "Prima o poi dovremo dar loro la caccia e distruggerli."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	"You are probably right," he says, uncertainly. He stares absently up into the sky and scratches at his wing with one talon. A few feathers fall out. "If only the Eye would open," he says. "I feel the air is [charged, tense] like the moment before a storm. Like we are [waiting, anticipating] something that ought to be here and is not. Though it may bring [catastrophe, upheaval, transition] I wish the wait would end."|1655|0
units.english: "You are probably right," he says, uncertainly. He stares absently up into the sky and scratches at his wing with one talon. A few feathers fall out. "If only the Eye would open," he says. "I feel the air is [charged, tense] like the moment before a storm. Like we are [waiting, anticipating] something that ought to be here and is not. Though it may bring [catastrophe, upheaval, transition] I wish the wait would end."
units.italian: "Probabilmente hai ragione," dice, incerto. Fissa il cielo con aria assente e si gratta un'ala con un artiglio. Qualche piuma cade. "Se solo l'Occhio si aprisse," dice. "Sento l'aria [carica, tesa] come nel momento prima di una tempesta. Come se [aspettassimo, attendessimo] qualcosa che dovrebbe essere qui e non c'è. Anche se potrebbe portare [catastrofe, sconvolgimento, transizione], vorrei che l'attesa finisse."

units.id: mission:Wanderers: Alpha Surveillance J|	You talk for a while longer, but it seems that for now there is nothing more the Wanderers need from you. Iktat Rek mentions that you should stop by the outfitter before you leave and see "our [grim, regrettable] new devices," then thanks you once more and departs.|1656|0
units.english: You talk for a while longer, but it seems that for now there is nothing more the Wanderers need from you. Iktat Rek mentions that you should stop by the outfitter before you leave and see "our [grim, regrettable] new devices," then thanks you once more and departs.
units.italian: Parlate ancora un po', ma sembra che per ora i Wanderers non abbiano altro bisogno di te. Iktat Rek accenna che dovresti passare dal fornitore prima di andartene, per vedere "i nostri [cupi, incresciosi] nuovi dispositivi", poi ti ringrazia ancora una volta e si allontana.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 0|name|1683|0
units.english: Unfettered Invasion
units.italian: Invasione degli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 0|description|1684|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to ask Iktat Rek if you can assist the Wanderers against the Unfettered invasion.
units.italian: Recati su <destination> per chiedere a Iktat Rek se puoi aiutare i Wanderers contro l'invasione degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 0|The Wanderers on <origin> are in a panic. Apparently the Unfettered have finally succeeded in capturing one of the Wanderer planets, and are now amassing a war fleet there. You should probably check with Iktat Rek and see if he needs your help to drive the Unfettered back.|1694|0
units.english: The Wanderers on <origin> are in a panic. Apparently the Unfettered have finally succeeded in capturing one of the Wanderer planets, and are now amassing a war fleet there. You should probably check with Iktat Rek and see if he needs your help to drive the Unfettered back.
units.italian: I Wanderers su <origin> sono nel panico. A quanto pare gli Slegati sono finalmente riusciti a conquistare uno dei pianeti dei Wanderers, e ora stanno radunando lì una flotta da guerra. Probabilmente dovresti parlare con Iktat Rek e vedere se gli serve il tuo aiuto per respingere gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|name|1701|0
units.english: Evacuate <planet>
units.italian: Evacua <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|description|1702|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying refugees, to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta una flotta di mercantili, riadattati al trasporto di profughi, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|log|1709|0
units.english: The Unfettered have established a beachhead on one of the Wanderer worlds and are now apparently using what few jump drives they possess to shuttle more and more warships into Wanderer space. War has begun in earnest.
units.italian: Gli Slegati hanno stabilito una testa di ponte su uno dei mondi dei Wanderers e ora usano apparentemente i pochi motori di salto che possiedono per far arrivare nello spazio dei Wanderers sempre più navi da guerra. La guerra è cominciata sul serio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|Iktat Rek looks more harried and anxious than you have ever seen him: his feathers, normally perfectly preened, stick out at odd angles in patches on his face and shoulders, and he paces back and forth restlessly as you converse. "We have begun building warships," he says, "but do not yet have the [strength, numbers] to resist the invaders. We must retreat to a more [narrow? defensible?] position. Will you assist us in the evacuation?"|1711|0
units.english: Iktat Rek looks more harried and anxious than you have ever seen him: his feathers, normally perfectly preened, stick out at odd angles in patches on his face and shoulders, and he paces back and forth restlessly as you converse. "We have begun building warships," he says, "but do not yet have the [strength, numbers] to resist the invaders. We must retreat to a more [narrow? defensible?] position. Will you assist us in the evacuation?"
units.italian: Iktat Rek sembra più affannato e ansioso di quanto tu lo abbia mai visto: le piume, normalmente curatissime, gli spuntano ad angoli strani a chiazze sul viso e sulle spalle, e cammina avanti e indietro irrequieto mentre parlate. "Abbiamo cominciato a costruire navi da guerra," dice, "ma non abbiamo ancora la [forza, consistenza numerica] per resistere agli invasori. Dobbiamo ritirarci in una posizione più [stretta? difendibile?]. Ci aiuterai nell'evacuazione?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|	"I would be glad to."|1713|0
units.english: "I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Sarò lieto di aiutarvi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|	"Why not strike back at the Unfettered and drive them out, before they can gain a stronger foothold?"|1715|0
units.english: "Why not strike back at the Unfettered and drive them out, before they can gain a stronger foothold?"
units.italian: "Perché non contrattaccare gli Slegati e scacciarli, prima che possano consolidare la loro posizione?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|	"That is not who we are," he says. "You are not Wanderer. You cannot [understand, empathize]. Our work is not complete until the worlds we have [tended, cared for] are [gifted, bequeathed] to another. [Art, creation] is lifeless until it is [enjoyed, experienced] by others. If the Unfettered are the ones [destined, chosen] to enjoy what we have [created, accomplished], then we will gladly give our [territory, worlds] to them."|1716|0
units.english: "That is not who we are," he says. "You are not Wanderer. You cannot [understand, empathize]. Our work is not complete until the worlds we have [tended, cared for] are [gifted, bequeathed] to another. [Art, creation] is lifeless until it is [enjoyed, experienced] by others. If the Unfettered are the ones [destined, chosen] to enjoy what we have [created, accomplished], then we will gladly give our [territory, worlds] to them."
units.italian: "Non è questo che siamo," dice. "Tu non sei un Wanderer. Non puoi [capire, comprendere]. Il nostro lavoro non è completo finché i mondi che abbiamo [curato, accudito] non sono [donati, lasciati in eredità] ad altri. [L'arte, La creazione] è senza vita finché altri non ne [godono, fanno esperienza]. Se gli Slegati sono quelli [destinati, scelti] a godere di ciò che abbiamo [creato, realizzato], allora daremo volentieri a loro il nostro [territorio, mondi]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|	"Okay, I'll help you to evacuate."|1718|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll help you to evacuate."
units.italian: "Va bene, vi aiuterò a evacuare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|	"Thank you," he says. "We have assembled a fleet of freighters, refitted to carry [refugees, evacuees]. These ships are not ideal, but they will suffice for now until we can produce dedicated [transportation, evacuation] ships. Please escort the fleet to <planet>. You will receive further [orders, directions] when you land."|1720|0
units.english: "Thank you," he says. "We have assembled a fleet of freighters, refitted to carry [refugees, evacuees]. These ships are not ideal, but they will suffice for now until we can produce dedicated [transportation, evacuation] ships. Please escort the fleet to <planet>. You will receive further [orders, directions] when you land."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Abbiamo messo insieme una flotta di mercantili, riadattati a trasportare [profughi, sfollati]. Non sono navi ideali, ma per ora basteranno, finché non potremo produrre navi [da trasporto, per l'evacuazione] dedicate. Per favore scorta la flotta fino a <planet>. Riceverai altre [istruzioni, indicazioni] quando atterri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1|You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|1731|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i trasporti dei Wanderers non sono ancora arrivati tutti. Dovresti decollare e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|name|1737|0
units.english: Evacuate <origin>
units.italian: Evacua <origin>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|description|1738|0
units.english: Escort a fleet of freighters, refitted for carrying refugees, to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta una flotta di mercantili, riadattati al trasporto di profughi, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|A female Wanderer named Emeka'a Isai meets you when you land with the freighter fleet. From the way others are obeying her orders, you would guess she is a local governor or someone of similar status. "Iktat Rek told me to expect you," she says. "We will evacuate civilians first, then the [defenders, warriors], then our [goods, possessions] if time is given. A [cohort, group] of civilians is prepared to depart already. Please escort them to <planet>." She turns away to speak to someone else. Apparently she is too busy to give you more details.|1746|0
units.english: A female Wanderer named Emeka'a Isai meets you when you land with the freighter fleet. From the way others are obeying her orders, you would guess she is a local governor or someone of similar status. "Iktat Rek told me to expect you," she says. "We will evacuate civilians first, then the [defenders, warriors], then our [goods, possessions] if time is given. A [cohort, group] of civilians is prepared to depart already. Please escort them to <planet>." She turns away to speak to someone else. Apparently she is too busy to give you more details.
units.italian: Una Wanderer di nome Emeka'a Isai ti incontra quando atterri con la flotta di mercantili. Da come gli altri eseguono i suoi ordini, diresti che è un governatore locale o qualcosa del genere. "Iktat Rek mi ha detto di aspettarti," dice. "Evacueremo prima i civili, poi i [difensori, guerrieri], poi i nostri [beni, averi] se ce ne sarà il tempo. Un [gruppo, drappello] di civili è già pronto a partire. Per favore scortali fino a <planet>." Si volta per parlare con qualcun altro. A quanto pare è troppo occupata per darti altri dettagli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|	(Leave her to her work, and prepare to escort the freighters.)|1748|0
units.english: (Leave her to her work, and prepare to escort the freighters.)
units.italian: (Lasciala al suo lavoro e preparati a scortare i mercantili.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|	"Could I assist you with the fighting, instead?"|1750|0
units.english: "Could I assist you with the fighting, instead?"
units.italian: "Potrei aiutarvi a combattere, invece?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|	Surprised, she halts her other conversation and turns back to you. "It is not yet the [proper, strategic] time to fight," she says. "They come like a tide; we must fall back to higher ground where their waves will be [stretched, spent] in striving to reach us."|1751|0
units.english: Surprised, she halts her other conversation and turns back to you. "It is not yet the [proper, strategic] time to fight," she says. "They come like a tide; we must fall back to higher ground where their waves will be [stretched, spent] in striving to reach us."
units.italian: Sorpresa, interrompe l'altra conversazione e si volta verso di te. "Non è ancora il momento [adatto, strategico] per combattere," dice. "Arrivano come una marea; dobbiamo arretrare su un terreno più alto, dove le loro ondate si [allungheranno, esauriranno] nel tentativo di raggiungerci."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|	You apologize for the interruption and agree to help escort the refugees to safety.|1752|0
units.english: You apologize for the interruption and agree to help escort the refugees to safety.
units.italian: Ti scusi per l'interruzione e accetti di aiutare a scortare i profughi in salvo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|1777|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i trasporti dei Wanderers non sono ancora arrivati tutti. Dovresti decollare e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|log|1779|0
units.english: Helped to evacuate some Wanderers from one of their worlds that is closest to Unfettered space.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a evacuare alcuni Wanderers da uno dei loro mondi più vicini allo spazio degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 1B|You drop off the Wanderer refugees. One of the Wanderer officials who is here to meet them tells you, "We are grateful for your [assistance, friendship]. If you are [available, willing] to help us further, go talk with Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander." The Wanderer official points toward one section of the spaceport where many Wanderers are busy loading supplies into some Wanderer ships unlike any you have seen before.|1781|0
units.english: You drop off the Wanderer refugees. One of the Wanderer officials who is here to meet them tells you, "We are grateful for your [assistance, friendship]. If you are [available, willing] to help us further, go talk with Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander." The Wanderer official points toward one section of the spaceport where many Wanderers are busy loading supplies into some Wanderer ships unlike any you have seen before.
units.italian: Lasci i profughi Wanderer. Uno dei funzionari Wanderer venuti a riceverli ti dice: "Ti siamo grati per il tuo [aiuto, la tua amicizia]. Se sei [disponibile, disposto] ad aiutarci ancora, vai a parlare con Sobari Tele'ek, il comandante militare." Il funzionario Wanderer indica una sezione dello spazioporto dove molti Wanderers sono impegnati a caricare provviste su alcune navi Wanderer diverse da tutte quelle che hai visto finora.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|name|1790|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|description|1791|0
units.english: Drive off the Unfettered fleet attacking <system> to buy the Wanderers more time, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Respingi la flotta degli Slegati che attacca <system> per dare ai Wanderers più tempo, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|log|1798|0
units.english: Tele'ek is a Wanderer military commander. It is not clear what his rank is or whether or not the Wanderer military is even organized enough for individuals to have ranks, but he has been placed in charge of holding back the Hai while the remaining Wanderer worlds near the front are evacuated.
units.italian: Tele'ek è un comandante militare dei Wanderers. Non è chiaro quale sia il suo grado né se l'esercito dei Wanderers sia organizzato abbastanza perché gli individui abbiano gradi, ma gli è stato affidato il compito di trattenere gli Hai mentre vengono evacuati i restanti mondi Wanderer vicini al fronte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|The ships in this corner of the spaceport are indeed a new design, stockier and less streamlined than most Wanderer ships. Sobari Tele'ek, who turns out to be a military commander, greets you and says, "For the first time in ten thousand years, we have made ships [designed, intended] for war. How do you [view, judge] them?"|1801|0
units.english: The ships in this corner of the spaceport are indeed a new design, stockier and less streamlined than most Wanderer ships. Sobari Tele'ek, who turns out to be a military commander, greets you and says, "For the first time in ten thousand years, we have made ships [designed, intended] for war. How do you [view, judge] them?"
units.italian: Le navi in questo angolo dello spazioporto sono davvero di un nuovo modello, più tozze e meno affusolate della maggior parte delle navi dei Wanderers. Sobari Tele'ek, che si rivela essere un comandante militare, ti saluta e dice: "Per la prima volta in diecimila anni abbiamo costruito navi [progettate, pensate] per la guerra. Come le [giudichi, valuti]?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	"That's a beautiful design."|1803|0
units.english: "That's a beautiful design."
units.italian: "È un progetto bellissimo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	"They look like very powerful ships."|1804|0
units.english: "They look like very powerful ships."
units.italian: "Sembrano navi molto potenti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	His pupils dilate and contract with some inscrutable Wanderer emotion. "They are ugly ships," he says, "[ungraceful, inelegant, crude], like all things of war. An [unfortunate, regrettable] necessity."|1805|0
units.english: His pupils dilate and contract with some inscrutable Wanderer emotion. "They are ugly ships," he says, "[ungraceful, inelegant, crude], like all things of war. An [unfortunate, regrettable] necessity."
units.italian: Le sue pupille si dilatano e si contraggono per qualche inscrutabile emozione Wanderer. "Sono navi brutte," dice, "[senza grazia, ineleganti, grezze], come tutte le cose di guerra. Una necessità [spiacevole, incresciosa]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	As you are talking, his communication device beeps, and an urgent voice speaks to him in the Wanderer tongue. Tele'ek turns to you and says, "<planet> is under attack. We must [drive off, push back] the Hai for long enough to prepare more of our people to evacuate. Will you help us [fight, resist] them?"|1806|0
units.english: As you are talking, his communication device beeps, and an urgent voice speaks to him in the Wanderer tongue. Tele'ek turns to you and says, "<planet> is under attack. We must [drive off, push back] the Hai for long enough to prepare more of our people to evacuate. Will you help us [fight, resist] them?"
units.italian: Mentre parlate, il suo dispositivo di comunicazione emette un bip, e una voce urgente gli parla nella lingua dei Wanderers. Tele'ek si volta verso di te e dice: "<planet> è sotto attacco. Dobbiamo [respingere, far arretrare] gli Hai abbastanza a lungo da preparare altri nostri simili all'evacuazione. Ci aiuterai a [combatterli, resistere]?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	"Gladly."|1808|0
units.english: "Gladly."
units.italian: "Volentieri."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	"Sorry, I don't want to assist the Wanderers anymore."|1809|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to assist the Wanderers anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non voglio più aiutare i Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|	"I am glad of your [help, company]," he says, "though not of our circumstances. My ships will follow you to the <system> system. There we must fight off the Hai until the next [convoy, fleet] is ready."|1811|0
units.english: "I am glad of your [help, company]," he says, "though not of our circumstances. My ships will follow you to the <system> system. There we must fight off the Hai until the next [convoy, fleet] is ready."
units.italian: "Sono contento del tuo [aiuto, della tua compagnia]," dice, "anche se non delle nostre circostanze. Le mie navi ti seguiranno nel sistema <system>. Lì dovremo respingere gli Hai finché il prossimo [convoglio, gruppo] non sarà pronto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 2|dialog|1816|0
units.english: There are still Unfettered warships overhead. You should take off again and assist in the fight.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi da guerra degli Slegati là sopra. Dovresti decollare di nuovo e dare una mano nello scontro.

units.id: event:capture of ik'kara'ka|description|1869|0
units.english: This Wanderer factory world was recently captured by the Unfettered Hai, who are now busy trying to repurpose the Wanderer factories and equipment that were left behind, to build more ships for their war fleets. The Wanderers did not have time to demolish any of their equipment or to carry it off-world before the planet was lost. As a result, they have given the Unfettered a significant technological advantage here.
units.italian: Questo mondo-fabbrica dei Wanderers è stato conquistato di recente dagli Hai Slegati, che ora sono impegnati a cercare di riadattare le fabbriche e le attrezzature lasciate indietro dai Wanderers per costruire altre navi per le loro flotte da guerra. I Wanderers non hanno avuto il tempo di demolire le loro attrezzature né di portarle fuori dal pianeta prima che il mondo fosse perduto. Di conseguenza hanno lasciato agli Slegati un vantaggio tecnologico notevole.

units.id: event:capture of ik'kara'ka|spaceport|1870|0
units.english: The Unfettered seem to be quite at home in the tree house dwellings that the Wanderers left behind, and the Unfettered youth living here scramble up trunks and leap from tree to tree with reckless abandon, exulting in this new world they have captured and trying to outdo each other with their daredevil escapades.
units.italian: Gli Slegati sembrano trovarsi molto a proprio agio nelle case sugli alberi lasciate dai Wanderers, e i giovani Slegati che vivono qui si arrampicano sui tronchi e saltano da un albero all'altro con abbandono imprudente, esultando per questo nuovo mondo che hanno conquistato e cercando di superarsi a vicenda in imprese spericolate.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|name|1876|0
units.english: Evacuate <origin>
units.italian: Evacua <origin>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|description|1877|0
units.english: Escort another fleet of Wanderer refugee transports to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta un'altra flotta di trasporti di profughi Wanderer fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|blocked|1882|0
units.english: You receive a message from Isai indicating that she would like to join you for the next mission, but you don't have space right now. Return when you have a bunk free.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Isai che indica che vorrebbe unirsi a te per la prossima missione, ma in questo momento non hai spazio. Torna quando avrai una cuccetta libera.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|log|1886|0
units.english: Helped to defend a Wanderer planet from an Unfettered attack. But, the Wanderers now plan to abandon that planet. The Wanderers seem very hesitant to actually stand their ground and fight back.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a difendere un pianeta dei Wanderers da un attacco degli Slegati. Ma ora i Wanderers intendono abbandonare quel pianeta. Sembrano molto restii a tenere davvero la posizione e a contrattaccare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|It appears that the very last of the civilians are ready for transport to <planet>; a large crowd is gathered in the spaceport, but nearly all the buildings are vacant. Incongruously, a few Wanderers are busy sweeping the sidewalks, watering plants, and making other efforts to tidy up the port, as if to make it as presentable as possible for the Unfettered when they land.|1889|0
units.english: It appears that the very last of the civilians are ready for transport to <planet>; a large crowd is gathered in the spaceport, but nearly all the buildings are vacant. Incongruously, a few Wanderers are busy sweeping the sidewalks, watering plants, and making other efforts to tidy up the port, as if to make it as presentable as possible for the Unfettered when they land.
units.italian: Sembra che gli ultimi civili siano pronti al trasporto verso <planet>: una grande folla si è radunata nello spazioporto, ma quasi tutti gli edifici sono vuoti. In modo incongruo, alcuni Wanderers sono impegnati a spazzare i marciapiedi, annaffiare le piante e fare altri sforzi per rassettare lo scalo, come per renderlo il più presentabile possibile agli Slegati quando atterreranno.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	Isai greets you and asks if she can ride along with you. "These are the last of the civilians," she says. "The [warriors, defenders] will remain behind until everyone is [safe, away], then they will join us on <planet>. But most important is that the transports reach <planet> unharmed. Will you escort them?"|1890|0
units.english: Isai greets you and asks if she can ride along with you. "These are the last of the civilians," she says. "The [warriors, defenders] will remain behind until everyone is [safe, away], then they will join us on <planet>. But most important is that the transports reach <planet> unharmed. Will you escort them?"
units.italian: Isai ti saluta e chiede se può viaggiare con te. "Questi sono gli ultimi civili," dice. "I [guerrieri, difensori] resteranno indietro finché tutti non saranno [al sicuro, via], poi ci raggiungeranno su <planet>. Ma la cosa più importante è che i trasporti arrivino a <planet> incolumi. Li scorterai?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"I will. I'm sorry you have to abandon your home."|1892|0
units.english: "I will. I'm sorry you have to abandon your home."
units.italian: "Lo farò. Mi dispiace che dobbiate abbandonare la vostra casa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"I would be glad to stay and fight, if you want."|1894|0
units.english: "I would be glad to stay and fight, if you want."
units.italian: "Sarei contento di restare a combattere, se volete."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"You are strange," she says. "You are not the one who suffers [loss, indignity] here. You have no [right, reason] to desire to strike back. Is fighting a greater [delight, enjoyment] to you than the saving of lives?"|1895|0
units.english: "You are strange," she says. "You are not the one who suffers [loss, indignity] here. You have no [right, reason] to desire to strike back. Is fighting a greater [delight, enjoyment] to you than the saving of lives?"
units.italian: "Sei strano," dice. "Non sei tu quello che qui subisce [una perdita, un'umiliazione]. Non hai alcun [diritto, motivo] di desiderare di rispondere ai colpi. Combattere è forse per te un [piacere, divertimento] maggiore del salvare delle vite?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"Okay, I'll help protect the transports."|1897|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll help protect the transports."
units.italian: "Va bene, aiuterò a proteggere i trasporti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"Sorry, I just thought I could be of more use to you in helping to fight than in helping to retreat."|1899|0
units.english: "Sorry, I just thought I could be of more use to you in helping to fight than in helping to retreat."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, pensavo solo di potervi essere più utile combattendo che ritirandomi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"I [predict, foresee] you will have plenty of opportunity to help with the [fighting, violence] before this situation is resolved," she says, "but for now our goal is to [avoid, minimize] conflict until we can understand the Hai better."|1900|0
units.english: "I [predict, foresee] you will have plenty of opportunity to help with the [fighting, violence] before this situation is resolved," she says, "but for now our goal is to [avoid, minimize] conflict until we can understand the Hai better."
units.italian: "[Prevedo, Vedo] che avrai molte occasioni di aiutare con [i combattimenti, la violenza] prima che questa situazione si risolva," dice, "ma per ora il nostro obiettivo è [evitare, ridurre al minimo] il conflitto finché non capiremo meglio gli Hai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"Okay," you say, "I'll help protect the transports."|1901|0
units.english: "Okay," you say, "I'll help protect the transports."
units.italian: "Va bene," dici, "aiuterò a proteggere i trasporti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|	"Thank you," she says. "As before, do not [wait, tarry] or join in the fighting. Just bring our people safely to <planet>."|1903|0
units.english: "Thank you," she says. "As before, do not [wait, tarry] or join in the fighting. Just bring our people safely to <planet>."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Come prima, non [aspettare, indugiare] e non unirti ai combattimenti. Porta solo la nostra gente sana e salva su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3|You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports, or your ship carrying Isai, have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.|1917|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but the Wanderer transports, or your ship carrying Isai, have not all arrived yet. You should take off and wait for them to catch up with you.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i trasporti dei Wanderers, o la tua nave che porta Isai, non sono ancora arrivati tutti. Dovresti decollare e aspettare che ti raggiungano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|name|1933|0
units.english: Wanderer Meeting
units.italian: Riunione dei Wanderers

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|description|1934|0
units.english: Join the Wanderer leaders on <planet> for a meeting to discuss strategy against the Unfettered.
units.italian: Unisciti ai capi dei Wanderers su <planet> per una riunione sulla strategia contro gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|As the transports come in for a landing, Isai receives a message, which she passes on to you: "A council of leaders is meeting soon in our capital, and they have agreed to [permit, invite] you to join us because you are a [stakeholder, interested party] in this conflict. Can you transport me to <planet>?"|1943|0
units.english: As the transports come in for a landing, Isai receives a message, which she passes on to you: "A council of leaders is meeting soon in our capital, and they have agreed to [permit, invite] you to join us because you are a [stakeholder, interested party] in this conflict. Can you transport me to <planet>?"
units.italian: Mentre i trasporti si avvicinano per atterrare, Isai riceve un messaggio che ti gira: "Un consiglio di capi si riunisce presto nella nostra capitale, e hanno accettato di [permetterti, invitarti] di unirti a noi perché sei una [parte interessata, parte in causa] in questo conflitto. Puoi trasportarmi su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|	"Sure."|1945|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|	"Sorry, I don't want to help the Wanderers anymore."|1946|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to help the Wanderers anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non intendo più aiutare i Wanderers."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|	"Thank you," she says. "We should go there quickly, so that we can decide our next [gambit, strategy] before the Hai attack us again."|1948|0
units.english: "Thank you," she says. "We should go there quickly, so that we can decide our next [gambit, strategy] before the Hai attack us again."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Dovremmo andarci in fretta, così potremo decidere la prossima [mossa, strategia] prima che gli Hai ci attacchino di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3B|dialog|1951|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Isai hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Isai non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|name|1957|0
units.english: Waiting for the Eye
units.italian: In attesa dell'Occhio

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|description|1958|0
units.english: Figure out what controls the wormhole that the Wanderers call the "Eye," and try to find information on when it will open and where.
units.italian: Scopri che cosa controlla il cunicolo che i Wanderers chiamano "l'Occhio", e cerca informazioni su quando si aprirà e dove.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|You land on <origin>, and Emeka'a Isai leads you to the building where the council of war is taking place. Sayari, the Hai diplomat, has also been invited, along with Iktat Rek and various other leaders. Rek looks even more bedraggled than before: his wings are drooping, and more of his feathers are out of place.|1967|0
units.english: You land on <origin>, and Emeka'a Isai leads you to the building where the council of war is taking place. Sayari, the Hai diplomat, has also been invited, along with Iktat Rek and various other leaders. Rek looks even more bedraggled than before: his wings are drooping, and more of his feathers are out of place.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin>, e Emeka'a Isai ti conduce nell'edificio dove si svolge il consiglio di guerra. Anche Sayari, la diplomatica Hai, è stata invitata, insieme a Iktat Rek e a vari altri capi. Rek sembra ancora più malconcio di prima: le ali gli pendono e molte più piume sono fuori posto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	It is not entirely clear to you who outranks whom in the meeting, or even what roles the different participants have. To make matters worse, you are uncomfortably reminded that your translator only understands the Hai language. Rek and Isai speak mostly in Hai so that you and Sayari can be included, but when the conversation gets heated they all switch into their native tongue, a cacophony of clicks and whistles.|1968|0
units.english: It is not entirely clear to you who outranks whom in the meeting, or even what roles the different participants have. To make matters worse, you are uncomfortably reminded that your translator only understands the Hai language. Rek and Isai speak mostly in Hai so that you and Sayari can be included, but when the conversation gets heated they all switch into their native tongue, a cacophony of clicks and whistles.
units.italian: Non ti è del tutto chiaro chi abbia più autorità di chi nella riunione, né che ruolo abbiano i diversi partecipanti. A peggiorare le cose, ti viene ricordato in modo sgradevole che il tuo traduttore capisce solo la lingua Hai. Rek e Isai parlano per lo più in Hai perché tu e Sayari possiate essere inclusi, ma quando la conversazione si accende passano tutti alla lingua natia, una cacofonia di schiocchi e fischi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	They are looking at a map of Wanderer space, and it's clear from their gestures that the discussion is about how far they can afford to retreat in order to form a more defensive position. Rek explains to you, "When the Eye opens, we must leave this [territory, space] anyway, so a retreat now will just position us better to [embark, journey on] when the time comes."|1969|0
units.english: They are looking at a map of Wanderer space, and it's clear from their gestures that the discussion is about how far they can afford to retreat in order to form a more defensive position. Rek explains to you, "When the Eye opens, we must leave this [territory, space] anyway, so a retreat now will just position us better to [embark, journey on] when the time comes."
units.italian: Stanno guardando una mappa dello spazio dei Wanderers, ed è chiaro dai loro gesti che la discussione riguarda fin dove possano permettersi di ritirarsi per formare una posizione più difendibile. Rek ti spiega: "Quando l'Occhio si aprirà, dovremo comunque lasciare questo [territorio, spazio], quindi un ritiro adesso ci metterà semplicemente in una posizione migliore per [imbarcarci, metterci in viaggio] quando verrà il momento."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	"But what if the Eye does not open and you are trapped here?"|1971|0
units.english: "But what if the Eye does not open and you are trapped here?"
units.italian: "Ma se l'Occhio non si apre e restate intrappolati qui?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	"Do you know when the Eye is going to open?"|1973|0
units.english: "Do you know when the Eye is going to open?"
units.italian: "Sapete quando si aprirà l'Occhio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	"No," says Isai, "we do not. It may not open for another hundred [years]. The Eye is a thing of [myth, mystery] and it may not answer to our need. Which is why I say that where we choose to [take a stand, draw a line], we must [hold, defend] that place firmly."|1974|0
units.english: "No," says Isai, "we do not. It may not open for another hundred [years]. The Eye is a thing of [myth, mystery] and it may not answer to our need. Which is why I say that where we choose to [take a stand, draw a line], we must [hold, defend] that place firmly."
units.italian: "No," dice Isai, "non lo sappiamo. Potrebbe non aprirsi per altri cento [anni]. L'Occhio è una cosa da [mito, mistero] e potrebbe non rispondere al nostro bisogno. Ecco perché dico che dove scegliamo di [tener duro, tracciare una linea], dobbiamo [tenere, difendere] quel punto con fermezza."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	"That is my concern too," says Isai. "The Eye is a thing of [myth, mystery] and it may not answer to our need. We cannot afford to make plans [assuming, expecting] that it will open this year, or even in the next hundred years. So we must choose what we can afford to [lose, cede, give up] now, and [hold, defend] the rest of our territory firmly."|1977|0
units.english: "That is my concern too," says Isai. "The Eye is a thing of [myth, mystery] and it may not answer to our need. We cannot afford to make plans [assuming, expecting] that it will open this year, or even in the next hundred years. So we must choose what we can afford to [lose, cede, give up] now, and [hold, defend] the rest of our territory firmly."
units.italian: "È la mia stessa preoccupazione," dice Isai. "L'Occhio è una cosa da [mito, mistero] e potrebbe non rispondere al nostro bisogno. Non possiamo permetterci di fare piani [dando per scontato, aspettandoci] che si apra quest'anno, né fra cento anni. Quindi dobbiamo scegliere che cosa possiamo permetterci di [perdere, cedere, lasciare] adesso, e [tenere, difendere] con fermezza il resto del nostro territorio."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	The Wanderer leaders decide to begin evacuating four more of their worlds closest to the Unfettered, hoping that they will not be attacked until the evacuation is complete. If necessary, they will fall back to the Ap'arak system, immediately east of this one, and take their final stand there.|1979|0
units.english: The Wanderer leaders decide to begin evacuating four more of their worlds closest to the Unfettered, hoping that they will not be attacked until the evacuation is complete. If necessary, they will fall back to the Ap'arak system, immediately east of this one, and take their final stand there.
units.italian: I capi dei Wanderers decidono di cominciare a evacuare altri quattro dei loro mondi più vicini agli Slegati, sperando che non vengano attaccati prima che l'evacuazione sia completa. Se necessario, arretreranno fino al sistema Ap'arak, immediatamente a est di questo, e lì terranno la loro ultima posizione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|	In the meantime, the entire Wanderer strategy depends on where and when the mythical Eye will open, the portal that will carry them to their next home. As the only Wanderer ally with access to a jump drive, perhaps you will be able to answer that question.|1980|0
units.english: In the meantime, the entire Wanderer strategy depends on where and when the mythical Eye will open, the portal that will carry them to their next home. As the only Wanderer ally with access to a jump drive, perhaps you will be able to answer that question.
units.italian: Nel frattempo l'intera strategia dei Wanderers dipende da dove e quando si aprirà il mitico Occhio, il portale che li condurrà alla loro prossima casa. Essendo l'unico alleato dei Wanderers con accesso a un motore di salto, forse sarai tu in grado di rispondere a quella domanda.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|dialog|1985|0
units.english: You return to <planet> without any more information on who or what controls the Eye. Perhaps the answer is closer than you think.
units.italian: Torni su <planet> senza altre informazioni su chi o che cosa controlli l'Occhio. Forse la risposta è più vicina di quanto pensi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C|You have collected some useful information on the nature of the "Eye." You should probably head to the spaceport and meet up with Iktat Rek.|1988|0
units.english: You have collected some useful information on the nature of the "Eye." You should probably head to the spaceport and meet up with Iktat Rek.
units.italian: Hai raccolto alcune informazioni utili sulla natura dell'"Occhio". Probabilmente dovresti andare allo spazioporto e incontrare Iktat Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|log|1998|0
units.english: Visited the Pug planet adjacent to Wanderer space to see if they are willing to step in and help the Wanderers now that the Unfettered Hai pose such a threat and have captured several Wanderer worlds. But for whatever reason, the Pug insist on the Wanderers fighting for themselves.
units.italian: Hai visitato il pianeta dei Pug adiacente allo spazio dei Wanderers per vedere se sono disposti a intervenire e aiutare i Wanderers, ora che gli Hai Slegati rappresentano una minaccia così grave e hanno conquistato diversi mondi Wanderer. Per qualche motivo, però, i Pug insistono che i Wanderers combattano da soli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|This world is populated by the Pug, the same enigmatic species that recently invaded human space - and left without giving you any clear answers about why they did so. You already know that the Pug have the ability to control wormholes, so it's quite likely that they have something to do with the "Eye" wormhole that the Wanderers hope will open soon.|2002|0
units.english: This world is populated by the Pug, the same enigmatic species that recently invaded human space - and left without giving you any clear answers about why they did so. You already know that the Pug have the ability to control wormholes, so it's quite likely that they have something to do with the "Eye" wormhole that the Wanderers hope will open soon.
units.italian: Questo mondo è popolato dai Pug, la stessa enigmatica specie che di recente ha invaso lo spazio umano, per poi andarsene senza dare alcuna risposta chiara sul perché. Sai già che i Pug sono in grado di controllare i cunicoli spaziali, quindi è molto probabile che abbiano a che fare con il cunicolo che i Wanderers chiamano "l'Occhio" e che sperano si apra presto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|You return to this Pug world hoping to get a few more answers than they offered to you last time. As before, they seem peaceful enough, but most of them are acting as if you do not exist.|2005|0
units.english: You return to this Pug world hoping to get a few more answers than they offered to you last time. As before, they seem peaceful enough, but most of them are acting as if you do not exist.
units.italian: Torni su questo mondo dei Pug sperando di ottenere qualche risposta in più di quelle che ti hanno offerto l'ultima volta. Come prima, sembrano abbastanza pacifici, ma quasi tutti si comportano come se tu non esistessi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	After you've stood around for at least 20 minutes, one of the Pug walks over to you and says, "It appears to this one that the human is not intending to just politely return to its vessel and leave. Can this one help hurry the human on its way?"|2007|0
units.english: After you've stood around for at least 20 minutes, one of the Pug walks over to you and says, "It appears to this one that the human is not intending to just politely return to its vessel and leave. Can this one help hurry the human on its way?"
units.italian: Dopo che sei rimasto lì in piedi per almeno 20 minuti, uno dei Pug si avvicina e dice: "A questo sembra che l'umano non abbia intenzione di tornare educatamente sulla sua nave e andarsene. Questo può aiutare l'umano ad affrettarsi per la sua strada?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"I need to know: do you control the wormhole that the Wanderers call the Eye?"|2009|0
units.english: "I need to know: do you control the wormhole that the Wanderers call the Eye?"
units.italian: "Devo sapere: siete voi a controllare il cunicolo che i Wanderers chiamano l'Occhio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"The Wanderers are being attacked. They are dying. Do you care about them?"|2010|0
units.english: "The Wanderers are being attacked. They are dying. Do you care about them?"
units.italian: "I Wanderers sono attaccati. Stanno morendo. Voi vi importa di loro?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"We do," it says.|2012|0
units.english: "We do," it says.
units.italian: "Sì, ci importa," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"We care deeply," it says. "They are irreplaceable, and most useful to us."|2015|0
units.english: "We care deeply," it says. "They are irreplaceable, and most useful to us."
units.italian: "Ci importa molto," dice. "Sono insostituibili, e molto utili per noi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"You must open the Eye so that the Wanderers can escape from the Unfettered."|2018|0
units.english: "You must open the Eye so that the Wanderers can escape from the Unfettered."
units.italian: "Dovete aprire l'Occhio, così che i Wanderers possano sfuggire agli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"Can you tell me when you plan to open the portal?"|2019|0
units.english: "Can you tell me when you plan to open the portal?"
units.italian: "Potete dirmi quando avete intenzione di aprire il portale?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"Must we, human? Must we?"|2021|0
units.english: "Must we, human? Must we?"
units.italian: "Dobbiamo, umano? Dobbiamo proprio?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	You are beginning to draw a crowd. Two more Pug walk over. One is armed with a staff. The other says to you, "Tell the world-shapers, it is not yet time for the portal to open. They must prepare to fight. Now, go."|2023|0
units.english: You are beginning to draw a crowd. Two more Pug walk over. One is armed with a staff. The other says to you, "Tell the world-shapers, it is not yet time for the portal to open. They must prepare to fight. Now, go."
units.italian: Cominci a richiamare una folla. Altri due Pug si avvicinano. Uno è armato con un bastone. L'altro ti dice: "Di' ai modellatori di mondi che non è ancora tempo che il portale si apra. Devono prepararsi a combattere. Ora, vai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	(Return to my ship.)|2025|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"They aren't strong enough. They will be killed."|2027|0
units.english: "They aren't strong enough. They will be killed."
units.italian: "Non sono abbastanza forti. Verranno uccisi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"They must become strong enough," says the Pug with the staff. "They must remember how to fight."|2028|0
units.english: "They must become strong enough," says the Pug with the staff. "They must remember how to fight."
units.italian: "Devono diventare abbastanza forti," dice il Pug con il bastone. "Devono ricordare come si combatte."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	(Return to my ship.)|2030|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)
