units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"No. They are peaceful people. Don't force them to make war. Don't force them to kill."|2032|0
units.english: "No. They are peaceful people. Don't force them to make war. Don't force them to kill."
units.italian: "No. Sono un popolo pacifico. Non costringeteli a fare la guerra. Non costringeteli a uccidere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	The Pug do not reply. Instead, they start to walk away.|2033|0
units.english: The Pug do not reply. Instead, they start to walk away.
units.italian: I Pug non rispondono. Si limitano ad allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	(Return to my ship.)|2035|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	"I demand that you listen to me."|2037|0
units.english: "I demand that you listen to me."
units.italian: "Esigo che mi ascoltiate."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	As you try to follow the group of Pug, the first one says to the others, "The human must like getting hit with the happy stick." The one with the staff waves it menacingly in your direction.|2038|0
units.english: As you try to follow the group of Pug, the first one says to the others, "The human must like getting hit with the happy stick." The one with the staff waves it menacingly in your direction.
units.italian: Mentre cerchi di seguire il gruppo di Pug, il primo dice agli altri: "All'umano deve piacere essere colpito con il bastone della felicità." Quello con il bastone lo agita in modo minaccioso verso di te.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	(Return to my ship.)|2040|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	(Keep insisting that they listen.)|2042|0
units.english: (Keep insisting that they listen.)
units.italian: (Continua a insistere perché ti ascoltino.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	With a somewhat contemptuous gesture, the Pug points the staff toward your face and a wave of wonderful rainbow light washes over you and bathes the whole world in iridescent sparkles that leap nimbly from the whiskers of things and nuzzle into your contented consciousness like flashing minnows of pure joy. You caper off to chase a trail of floating soapy baubles that burst with the sound of wind chimes and distant trumpets as you touch each one and the smell of ripe peaches fills the air until you stagger through your airlock and throw up in a corner.|2043|0
units.english: With a somewhat contemptuous gesture, the Pug points the staff toward your face and a wave of wonderful rainbow light washes over you and bathes the whole world in iridescent sparkles that leap nimbly from the whiskers of things and nuzzle into your contented consciousness like flashing minnows of pure joy. You caper off to chase a trail of floating soapy baubles that burst with the sound of wind chimes and distant trumpets as you touch each one and the smell of ripe peaches fills the air until you stagger through your airlock and throw up in a corner.
units.italian: Con un gesto alquanto sprezzante il Pug punta il bastone verso il tuo viso, e un'onda di meravigliosa luce iridescente ti travolge e bagna il mondo intero di scintille opalescenti che saltano agili dai peli delle cose e si accoccolano nella tua coscienza soddisfatta come minuscoli pesciolini di pura gioia. Ti metti a saltellare inseguendo una scia di bolle fluttuanti che scoppiano con il suono di campanelli al vento e trombe lontane quando le tocchi, e l'odore di pesche mature riempie l'aria finché non barcolli attraverso il tuo portello e vomiti in un angolo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Invaded 3C (Pug)|	It may be time to leave this planet.|2044|0
units.english: It may be time to leave this planet.
units.italian: Forse è il momento di lasciare questo pianeta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|name|2050|0
units.english: Hai Assistance
units.italian: Assistenza agli Hai

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|description|2051|0
units.english: Travel to <planet> with Ambassador Sayari and see if she can convince the Hai to help restrain the Unfettered from attacking the Wanderers.
units.italian: Recati su <planet> con l'ambasciatrice Sayari e vedi se riesce a convincere gli Hai ad aiutare a trattenere gli Slegati dall'attaccare i Wanderers.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|blocked|2057|0
units.english: To continue helping the Wanderers, you will need a bunk free for a passenger. Return here when you have space available.
units.italian: Per continuare ad aiutare i Wanderers ti serve una cuccetta libera per un passeggero. Torna qui quando avrai spazio disponibile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|You meet up with Ambassador Sayari and Iktat Rek and tell them what the Pug said. "The Keepers of the Eye speak [subtly, carefully]," Rek says, "and hide truths in the [shades, distinctions] of their words. What precisely did they say?"|2062|0
units.english: You meet up with Ambassador Sayari and Iktat Rek and tell them what the Pug said. "The Keepers of the Eye speak [subtly, carefully]," Rek says, "and hide truths in the [shades, distinctions] of their words. What precisely did they say?"
units.italian: Incontri l'ambasciatrice Sayari e Iktat Rek e racconti loro che cosa hanno detto i Pug. "I Custodi dell'Occhio parlano [in modo sottile, con cautela]," dice Rek, "e nascondono la verità nelle [sfumature, distinzioni] delle loro parole. Che cosa hanno detto esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|	"It is not yet time for the portal to open. You must prepare to fight."|2064|0
units.english: "It is not yet time for the portal to open. You must prepare to fight."
units.italian: "Non è ancora tempo che il portale si apra. Dovete prepararvi a combattere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|	"We must [make preparations, become ready] to fight," repeats Iktat Rek, slowly. He runs a claw through the ruffled feathers of his scalp, in something akin to the human gesture of scratching your head in confusion. Quite a few feathers fall out. "I see," he says, and his wings droop even lower than before. "I will tell the [war-chiefs, strategists] to tell the [builders, designers] that we must make more and bigger warships."|2065|0
units.english: "We must [make preparations, become ready] to fight," repeats Iktat Rek, slowly. He runs a claw through the ruffled feathers of his scalp, in something akin to the human gesture of scratching your head in confusion. Quite a few feathers fall out. "I see," he says, and his wings droop even lower than before. "I will tell the [war-chiefs, strategists] to tell the [builders, designers] that we must make more and bigger warships."
units.italian: "Dobbiamo [fare preparativi, essere pronti] a combattere," ripete Iktat Rek, lentamente. Si passa un artiglio fra le piume arruffate del capo, in qualcosa di simile al gesto umano di grattarsi la testa per la confusione. Parecchie piume cadono. "Capisco," dice, e le ali gli si abbassano ancora più di prima. "Dirò ai [capi di guerra, strateghi] di dire ai [costruttori, progettisti] che dobbiamo costruire più navi da guerra, e più grandi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|	"How can I help in the meantime?"|2067|0
units.english: "How can I help in the meantime?"
units.italian: "Come posso aiutare nel frattempo?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|	Sayari says, "I have offered to speak to the Hai governors, to see if they can do anything to restrain the Unfettered from making further incursions into Wanderer space. Would you be willing to transport me to <planet>?"|2068|0
units.english: Sayari says, "I have offered to speak to the Hai governors, to see if they can do anything to restrain the Unfettered from making further incursions into Wanderer space. Would you be willing to transport me to <planet>?"
units.italian: Sayari dice: "Mi sono offerta di parlare con i governatori degli Hai, per vedere se possono fare qualcosa per trattenere gli Slegati dall'intraprendere altre incursioni nello spazio dei Wanderers. Saresti disposto a trasportarmi su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|	"Of course," you say. She leaves to gather some traveling gear and to meet you at your ship.|2069|0
units.english: "Of course," you say. She leaves to gather some traveling gear and to meet you at your ship.
units.italian: "Certo," dici. Lei va a prendere il necessario per il viaggio e a incontrarti alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 1|dialog|2072|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sayari hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Sayari non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|name|2078|0
units.english: Unfettered Negotiations
units.italian: Negoziato con gli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|description|2079|0
units.english: Travel to the Unfettered military planet <destination>, and see if they will agree to give the Wanderers time to evacuate their worlds near the front.
units.italian: Recati sul pianeta militare degli Slegati <destination>, e vedi se accettano di dare ai Wanderers il tempo di evacuare i loro mondi vicini al fronte.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|log|2088|0
units.english: Traveled to the Hai homeworld with Ambassador Sayari to see if she can convince the Hai to take action to restrain the Unfettered from attacking the Wanderers. The most that the Hai were willing to do was to mass a large war fleet near Unfettered space so that the Unfettered have to divert warships there to defend their home worlds.
units.italian: Sei andato sul mondo d'origine degli Hai con l'ambasciatrice Sayari per vedere se riesce a convincere gli Hai ad agire per trattenere gli Slegati dall'attaccare i Wanderers. Il massimo che gli Hai erano disposti a fare era radunare una grande flotta da guerra vicino allo spazio degli Slegati, così che gli Slegati debbano dirottare lì delle navi da guerra per difendere i loro mondi d'origine.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|The Hai are ruled by an elected "council of elders" who agree to meet with you and Sayari. After you describe the situation with the Wanderers, one of the elders says, "We had heard rumors of this. The Unfettered have recruited thousands of new warriors by telling stories of planets for us to explore and colonize, and a cowardly and foolish enemy to defeat."|2090|0
units.english: The Hai are ruled by an elected "council of elders" who agree to meet with you and Sayari. After you describe the situation with the Wanderers, one of the elders says, "We had heard rumors of this. The Unfettered have recruited thousands of new warriors by telling stories of planets for us to explore and colonize, and a cowardly and foolish enemy to defeat."
units.italian: Gli Hai sono governati da un "consiglio degli anziani" eletto, che accetta di incontrarti insieme a Sayari. Dopo che hai descritto la situazione dei Wanderers, uno degli anziani dice: "Ne avevamo sentito delle voci. Gli Slegati hanno reclutato migliaia di nuovi guerrieri raccontando storie di pianeti da esplorare e colonizzare, e di un nemico codardo e sciocco da sconfiggere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	Sayari says, "We must not allow the Unfettered to commit genocide in the name of the Hai people."|2091|0
units.english: Sayari says, "We must not allow the Unfettered to commit genocide in the name of the Hai people."
units.italian: Sayari dice: "Non possiamo permettere che gli Slegati commettano un genocidio in nome del popolo Hai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	Another elder responds, "But, we promised in the Frostmark Accords that we would not interfere in Unfettered space."|2092|0
units.english: Another elder responds, "But, we promised in the Frostmark Accords that we would not interfere in Unfettered space."
units.italian: Un altro anziano risponde: "Ma negli Accordi di Frostmark abbiamo promesso che non saremmo intervenuti nello spazio degli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"They have never kept their side of the treaty," says yet another of the elders, "and surely the prevention of genocide is enough reason to break ours."|2093|0
units.english: "They have never kept their side of the treaty," says yet another of the elders, "and surely the prevention of genocide is enough reason to break ours."
units.italian: "Non hanno mai rispettato la loro parte del trattato," dice ancora un altro degli anziani, "e di certo impedire un genocidio è ragione sufficiente per infrangere la nostra."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"Could you threaten to cut off aid to the Unfettered if they continue their aggression?"|2095|0
units.english: "Could you threaten to cut off aid to the Unfettered if they continue their aggression?"
units.italian: "Potreste minacciare di tagliare gli aiuti agli Slegati se continuano la loro aggressione?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"Could you launch an attack on the Unfettered, force them to fight a war on two fronts?"|2096|0
units.english: "Could you launch an attack on the Unfettered, force them to fight a war on two fronts?"
units.italian: "Potreste sferrare un attacco agli Slegati, costringendoli a combattere una guerra su due fronti?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"I fear that would only drive them to further acts of desperation," says Sayari.|2098|0
units.english: "I fear that would only drive them to further acts of desperation," says Sayari.
units.italian: "Temo che questo li spingerebbe solo ad altri atti di disperazione," dice Sayari.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"I will not authorize preemptive violence against our own flesh and blood," says one of the elders. "We only defend ourselves against them, never willingly initiate an attack."|2101|0
units.english: "I will not authorize preemptive violence against our own flesh and blood," says one of the elders. "We only defend ourselves against them, never willingly initiate an attack."
units.italian: "Non autorizzerò violenze preventive contro il nostro stesso sangue," dice uno degli anziani. "Noi ci difendiamo soltanto da loro, non iniziamo mai volontariamente un attacco."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	"Perhaps it would be enough merely to threaten them," says another of the elders. "We could gather a massive war fleet above Cloudfire. The Unfettered would need to muster a matching fleet above Darkcloak. It would draw many of their warships away from the alien territory."|2103|0
units.english: "Perhaps it would be enough merely to threaten them," says another of the elders. "We could gather a massive war fleet above Cloudfire. The Unfettered would need to muster a matching fleet above Darkcloak. It would draw many of their warships away from the alien territory."
units.italian: "Forse basterebbe minacciarli," dice un altro degli anziani. "Potremmo radunare una flotta da guerra enorme sopra Cloudfire. Gli Slegati dovrebbero radunare una flotta equivalente sopra Darkcloak. Questo allontanerebbe molte delle loro navi da guerra dal territorio alieno."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|	After well over an hour of further discussion, they reach consensus that that is their best option. As you leave the meeting, Sayari says, "And now, I would like to visit the Unfettered themselves. Perhaps we can talk sense into them."|2104|0
units.english: After well over an hour of further discussion, they reach consensus that that is their best option. As you leave the meeting, Sayari says, "And now, I would like to visit the Unfettered themselves. Perhaps we can talk sense into them."
units.italian: Dopo oltre un'ora di discussione raggiungono il consenso che quella è la loro opzione migliore. Mentre lasciate la riunione, Sayari dice: "E ora vorrei far visita agli Slegati stessi. Forse riusciremo a far ragionare loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 2|dialog|2107|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sayari hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Sayari non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|name|2149|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|description|2150|0
units.english: Return with Sayari to <destination>, and tell Iktat Rek that you had some success in convincing the Hai to interfere with the Unfettered.
units.italian: Torna con Sayari su <destination>, e di' a Iktat Rek che hai avuto un po' di successo nel convincere gli Hai a interferire con gli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|log|2158|0
units.english: The Unfettered are unwilling to agree to even a temporary ceasefire with the Wanderers. They seem to think that they will win this war easily.
units.italian: Gli Slegati non sono disposti ad accettare nemmeno un cessate il fuoco temporaneo con i Wanderers. Sembrano convinti che vinceranno questa guerra senza difficoltà.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|The Unfettered war chiefs listen to Sayari's plea with condescending smiles on their faces. When she is done speaking, one of them says, "This is a war, not a polite dinner party. We will take what we want, when we want it. We are through with waiting on the charity of others."|2161|0
units.english: The Unfettered war chiefs listen to Sayari's plea with condescending smiles on their faces. When she is done speaking, one of them says, "This is a war, not a polite dinner party. We will take what we want, when we want it. We are through with waiting on the charity of others."
units.italian: I capi di guerra degli Slegati ascoltano la supplica di Sayari con sorrisi di sufficienza. Quando lei ha finito di parlare, uno di loro dice: "Questa è una guerra, non una cena di gala. Prenderemo ciò che vogliamo, quando vogliamo. Abbiamo finito di aspettare la carità altrui."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|	"But people will die, on your side as well as the Wanderers," says Sayari. "They are willing to give you these worlds if you only give them time, perhaps no more than a few months or a year. Why lose your lives to claim what will be yours soon enough?"|2162|0
units.english: "But people will die, on your side as well as the Wanderers," says Sayari. "They are willing to give you these worlds if you only give them time, perhaps no more than a few months or a year. Why lose your lives to claim what will be yours soon enough?"
units.italian: "Ma morirà della gente, dalla vostra parte come dai Wanderers," dice Sayari. "Sono disposti a darvi questi mondi se solo concedete loro tempo, forse non più di qualche mese o un anno. Perché perdere la vita per rivendicare ciò che sarà vostro presto abbastanza?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|	"Better to die asserting our strength than to live with our hands outstretched to beg," says another of the chiefs.|2163|0
units.english: "Better to die asserting our strength than to live with our hands outstretched to beg," says another of the chiefs.
units.italian: "Meglio morire affermando la nostra forza che vivere con le mani tese a mendicare," dice un altro dei capi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|	You are unable to convince them to change their plans, and as soon as the conversation ends they insist that you leave their planet. "Our warriors in orbit are eager to test this human's strength," says one of the chiefs, laughing.|2164|0
units.english: You are unable to convince them to change their plans, and as soon as the conversation ends they insist that you leave their planet. "Our warriors in orbit are eager to test this human's strength," says one of the chiefs, laughing.
units.italian: Non riesci a convincerli a cambiare i loro piani, e appena la conversazione finisce insistono perché tu lasci il loro pianeta. "I nostri guerrieri in orbita non vedono l'ora di mettere alla prova la forza di questo umano," dice uno dei capi, ridendo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Hai Assistance 3|dialog|2167|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sayari hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Sayari non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|name|2173|0
units.english: Report to <planet>
units.italian: Presentati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|description|2174|0
units.english: Report to the Wanderer military base on <destination>, and see if there is anything you can help them with.
units.italian: Presentati alla base militare dei Wanderers su <destination>, e vedi se c'è qualcosa in cui puoi aiutarli.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|log|2183|0
units.english: Returned to Wanderer space, and discovered that Iktat Rek has begun the "Molt." He is afraid that because the Eye has not yet opened, the Molt will not be viable and it will end up killing him.
units.italian: Sei tornato nello spazio dei Wanderers e hai scoperto che Iktat Rek ha iniziato la "Muta". Temo che, poiché l'Occhio non si è ancora aperto, la Muta non sarà vitale e finirà per ucciderlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|You have been gone for several weeks, and Iktat Rek's appearance has changed drastically in that time. Nearly half his head is bald, showing scaly gray skin and scattered white under-feathers in place of his usual plumage. Patches on other parts of his body have lost their feathers as well. His appearance is shocking. In a terrestrial animal you would attribute it to a mange... or to a molt.|2185|0
units.english: You have been gone for several weeks, and Iktat Rek's appearance has changed drastically in that time. Nearly half his head is bald, showing scaly gray skin and scattered white under-feathers in place of his usual plumage. Patches on other parts of his body have lost their feathers as well. His appearance is shocking. In a terrestrial animal you would attribute it to a mange... or to a molt.
units.italian: Sei stato via per diverse settimane, e in quel tempo l'aspetto di Iktat Rek è cambiato drasticamente. Quasi metà della sua testa è calva, e mostra pelle grigia squamosa e rade piume bianche sotto, al posto del solito piumaggio. Anche su altre parti del corpo ha perso le piume. Il suo aspetto è scioccante. In un animale terrestre lo attribuiresti alla rogna... o a una muta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"What is happening to you? Are you ill?"|2187|0
units.english: "What is happening to you? Are you ill?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ti sta succedendo? Sei malato?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"Are you molting?"|2188|0
units.english: "Are you molting?"
units.italian: "Stai facendo la muta?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	Rek says wearily, "The doctors believe it is what you would call a cancer, what my people would call a [premature, non-viable] molt. If so it will kill me. But I hope it may be the true Molt, come earlier than the [stories, myths] claim is possible - for the Eye is not yet open."|2189|0
units.english: Rek says wearily, "The doctors believe it is what you would call a cancer, what my people would call a [premature, non-viable] molt. If so it will kill me. But I hope it may be the true Molt, come earlier than the [stories, myths] claim is possible - for the Eye is not yet open."
units.italian: Rek dice, stanco: "I medici credono che sia quello che voi chiamereste un cancro, e che la mia gente chiamerebbe una muta [prematura, non vitale]. Se è così, mi ucciderà. Ma spero che possa essere la vera Muta, arrivata prima di quanto le [storie, leggende] dicano sia possibile, perché l'Occhio non è ancora aperto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"You can't tell the difference between a cancer and the Molt?"|2191|0
units.english: "You can't tell the difference between a cancer and the Molt?"
units.italian: "Non riesci a distinguere un cancro dalla Muta?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"They are the same thing," he says. "Only the [outcome, result] is different. The Molt is a cancer so [successful, virulent] that it [consumes? displaces?] every cell in one's body. But since the first Unfettered attacks a [decade] ago, hundreds of Wanderers have undergone a false Molt. All of them have died. I may be a fool to hope that I might survive."|2192|0
units.english: "They are the same thing," he says. "Only the [outcome, result] is different. The Molt is a cancer so [successful, virulent] that it [consumes? displaces?] every cell in one's body. But since the first Unfettered attacks a [decade] ago, hundreds of Wanderers have undergone a false Molt. All of them have died. I may be a fool to hope that I might survive."
units.italian: "Sono la stessa cosa," dice. "Solo il [risultato, esito] è diverso. La Muta è un cancro così [riuscito, virulento] che [consuma? sostituisce?] ogni cellula del corpo. Ma dal primo attacco degli Slegati, un [decennio] fa, centinaia di Wanderers hanno subito una falsa Muta. Sono morti tutti. Potrei essere uno sciocco a sperare di sopravvivere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"Well, I hope that your doctors are wrong to be so pessimistic."|2194|0
units.english: "Well, I hope that your doctors are wrong to be so pessimistic."
units.italian: "Beh, spero che i tuoi medici si sbaglino a essere così pessimisti."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"Isn't there anything your doctors can do?"|2196|0
units.english: "Isn't there anything your doctors can do?"
units.italian: "Non c'è proprio niente che i tuoi medici possano fare?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"They could try to kill the [mutant, cancerous] cells," he says, "but if it is the true Molt, killing it would kill my future, my [true form? destiny?]. And in any case, the treatment would weaken me and leave me no [strength, attention] to help my people in this time of necessity. So for now I choose neither to hasten nor to halt the [process, progression]."|2197|0
units.english: "They could try to kill the [mutant, cancerous] cells," he says, "but if it is the true Molt, killing it would kill my future, my [true form? destiny?]. And in any case, the treatment would weaken me and leave me no [strength, attention] to help my people in this time of necessity. So for now I choose neither to hasten nor to halt the [process, progression]."
units.italian: "Potrebbero provare a uccidere le cellule [mutanti, cancerose]," dice, "ma se è la vera Muta, ucciderla ucciderebbe il mio futuro, il mio [vero me? destino?]. E in ogni caso la cura mi indebolirebbe e non mi lascerebbe alcuna [forza, attenzione] per aiutare la mia gente in questo momento di necessità. Quindi per ora scelgo di non affrettare né di fermare il [processo, decorso]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"Well," you say, "I hope for your sake that it is a true Molt."|2198|0
units.english: "Well," you say, "I hope for your sake that it is a true Molt."
units.italian: "Beh," dici, "spero per te che sia una vera Muta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	"Thank you," he says. "And now, if you are willing to help my people further, they have asked for your [assistance, expertise] on <planet>. Do not worry about me; I will [face, deal with] whatever future comes, when it comes."|2200|0
units.english: "Thank you," he says. "And now, if you are willing to help my people further, they have asked for your [assistance, expertise] on <planet>. Do not worry about me; I will [face, deal with] whatever future comes, when it comes."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "E ora, se sei disposto ad aiutare ancora la mia gente, hanno chiesto il tuo [aiuto, contributo] su <planet>. Non preoccuparti per me; [affronterò, farò fronte a] qualunque futuro arrivi, quando arriverà."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|	As you return to your ship, Sayari approaches you, seemingly having listened in on your conversation with Rek. "I too have been told that my presence has been requested on <planet>." She pauses for a moment before continuing. "And while this 'Molt' is a mystery to me, I hope that it may go well for your friend." You thank Sayari for the well wishes and get ready to leave for <planet>.|2201|0
units.english: As you return to your ship, Sayari approaches you, seemingly having listened in on your conversation with Rek. "I too have been told that my presence has been requested on <planet>." She pauses for a moment before continuing. "And while this 'Molt' is a mystery to me, I hope that it may go well for your friend." You thank Sayari for the well wishes and get ready to leave for <planet>.
units.italian: Mentre torni alla tua nave, Sayari ti si avvicina, avendo apparentemente ascoltato la tua conversazione con Rek. "Anche a me è stato detto che la mia presenza è richiesta su <planet>." Si ferma un momento prima di continuare. "E anche se questa 'Muta' per me è un mistero, spero che possa andare bene per il tuo amico." Ringrazi Sayari per gli auguri e ti prepari a partire per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 1|dialog|2204|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sayari hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Sayari non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|name|2210|0
units.english: New Unfettered ships
units.italian: Nuove navi degli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|description|2211|0
units.english: Unfettered ships of an unknown design have been spotted in the Prakacha'a system. Destroy them, then return to <destination>.
units.italian: Nel sistema Prakacha'a sono state avvistate navi degli Slegati di un modello sconosciuto. Distruggile, poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|log|2221|0
units.english: Received permission to purchase warships from the Wanderers, including a new one called the Tempest.
units.italian: Hai ottenuto il permesso di acquistare navi da guerra dai Wanderers, inclusa una nuova chiamata Tempest.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander whom you met earlier, greets you and Sayari when you land. "The human who enjoys taking part in fights!" he says. "And the Hai ambassador. I am glad you have come. We have two [pieces, items] of good news for you, human. The first is that we have decided it is [permissible? prudent?] to allow you to purchase our warships. That will include the new [ugly, brutish] one, the Tempest."|2224|0
units.english: Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander whom you met earlier, greets you and Sayari when you land. "The human who enjoys taking part in fights!" he says. "And the Hai ambassador. I am glad you have come. We have two [pieces, items] of good news for you, human. The first is that we have decided it is [permissible? prudent?] to allow you to purchase our warships. That will include the new [ugly, brutish] one, the Tempest."
units.italian: Sobari Tele'ek, il comandante militare che hai incontrato prima, accoglie te e Sayari all'atterraggio. "L'umano a cui piace prendere parte agli scontri!" dice. "E l'ambasciatrice Hai. Sono contento che siate venuti. Abbiamo due [notizie, cose] buone per te, umano. La prima è che abbiamo deciso che è [ammissibile? prudente?] permetterti di acquistare le nostre navi da guerra. Fra queste ci sarà quella nuova e [brutta, bestiale], la Tempest."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|	"Thank you," you say.|2225|0
units.english: "Thank you," you say.
units.italian: "Grazie," dici.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|	"The other news is even better!" he says. "We have [saved, set aside] a fight for you. Unfettered ships of unknown design have been [spotted, discovered] in the Prakacha'a system. I ask you to destroy all these ships, then report to me what their [capabilities, strengths] are. I will discuss the [situation? troubles?] of the Unfettered with Sayari while you are gone."|2226|0
units.english: "The other news is even better!" he says. "We have [saved, set aside] a fight for you. Unfettered ships of unknown design have been [spotted, discovered] in the Prakacha'a system. I ask you to destroy all these ships, then report to me what their [capabilities, strengths] are. I will discuss the [situation? troubles?] of the Unfettered with Sayari while you are gone."
units.italian: "L'altra notizia è ancora migliore!" dice. "Ti abbiamo [serbato, messo da parte] uno scontro. Navi degli Slegati di modello sconosciuto sono state [avvistate, scoperte] nel sistema Prakacha'a. Ti chiedo di distruggere tutte queste navi, poi di riferirmi quali siano le loro [capacità, punti di forza]. Io discuterò delle [situazione? difficoltà?] degli Slegati con Sayari mentre sei via."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|	You tell him that you will do your best. Now that you are able to purchase Wanderer warships, you should be able to match anything the Unfettered throw at you.|2227|0
units.english: You tell him that you will do your best. Now that you are able to purchase Wanderer warships, you should be able to match anything the Unfettered throw at you.
units.italian: Gli dici che farai del tuo meglio. Ora che puoi acquistare navi da guerra dei Wanderers, dovresti essere in grado di tener testa a qualunque cosa gli Slegati ti lancino contro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|dialog|2242|0
units.english: That was the last of the new Unfettered ships. You can now report back to Tele'ek on <planet>.
units.italian: Quelle erano le ultime delle nuove navi degli Slegati. Ora puoi riferire a Tele'ek su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 2|dialog|2244|0
units.english: Tele'ek approaches you when you land. "I have [reports, word] that the Unfettered ships are still [present, alive] within Prakacha'a. Please destroy them all before returning."
units.italian: Tele'ek ti viene incontro all'atterraggio. "Ho [notizie, voce] che le navi degli Slegati sono ancora [presenti, attive] dentro Prakacha'a. Distruggile tutte prima di tornare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3|name|2250|0
units.english: New Unfettered ships
units.italian: Nuove navi degli Slegati

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3|description|2251|0
units.english: Ambassador Sayari is concerned that the development of the Solifuge could become a problem for the Hai and has asked that you deliver a message to the council of elders on <destination>.
units.italian: L'ambasciatrice Sayari teme che lo sviluppo del Solifuge possa diventare un problema per gli Hai, e ti ha chiesto di consegnare un messaggio al consiglio degli anziani su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3|Tele'ek and Sayari listen carefully as you outline the strengths and weaknesses of the new Unfettered carriers. "I am not greatly [concerned, frightened] by tiny fighters," Tele'ek says. "The weapon that has done us most harm is their Ion Cannons, which no ship so small can [wield, carry]. But thank you for your assistance."|2262|0
units.english: Tele'ek and Sayari listen carefully as you outline the strengths and weaknesses of the new Unfettered carriers. "I am not greatly [concerned, frightened] by tiny fighters," Tele'ek says. "The weapon that has done us most harm is their Ion Cannons, which no ship so small can [wield, carry]. But thank you for your assistance."
units.italian: Tele'ek e Sayari ascoltano con attenzione mentre descrivi i punti di forza e di debolezza delle nuove portaerei degli Slegati. "Non sono molto [preoccupato, spaventato] da caccia minuscoli," dice Tele'ek. "L'arma che ci ha fatto più male sono i loro cannoni ionici, che nessuna nave così piccola può [impugnare, portare]. Ma grazie per il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3|	Sayari looks more concerned about this information. "These carriers may not be an issue for the Wanderers, but this development could cause trouble for the Hai. I have written a message describing the situation." She hands you a data chip. "Please deliver it to the council of elders on <planet>."|2263|0
units.english: Sayari looks more concerned about this information. "These carriers may not be an issue for the Wanderers, but this development could cause trouble for the Hai. I have written a message describing the situation." She hands you a data chip. "Please deliver it to the council of elders on <planet>."
units.italian: Sayari sembra più preoccupata da questa informazione. "Queste portaerei potrebbero non essere un problema per i Wanderers, ma questo sviluppo potrebbe causare guai agli Hai. Ho scritto un messaggio che descrive la situazione." Ti porge un chip dati. "Per favore consegnalo al consiglio degli anziani su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 3|	"Please be quick if you are to deliver this message now," Tele'ek says. "We have no other [fights, brawls] for you to take part in right now, but once you return here, you will find another evacuation fleet that needs an [escort, protector]."|2264|0
units.english: "Please be quick if you are to deliver this message now," Tele'ek says. "We have no other [fights, brawls] for you to take part in right now, but once you return here, you will find another evacuation fleet that needs an [escort, protector]."
units.italian: "Ti prego di fare in fretta se devi consegnare questo messaggio adesso," dice Tele'ek. "Non abbiamo altri [scontri, combattimenti] a cui farti partecipare in questo momento, ma una volta tornato qui troverai un'altra flotta di evacuazione che ha bisogno di una [scorta, protezione]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 4|name|2271|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Solifuge Recon 4|description|2272|0
units.english: Return to <destination>, where an evacuation fleet is waiting to be escorted.
units.italian: Torna su <destination>, dove una flotta di evacuazione attende di essere scortata.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|You give the message from Sayari to the spaceport authorities so that they can deliver it to the council of elders. After the message has been delivered, the council requests that you meet with them.|2283|0
units.english: You give the message from Sayari to the spaceport authorities so that they can deliver it to the council of elders. After the message has been delivered, the council requests that you meet with them.
units.italian: Consegni il messaggio di Sayari alle autorità dello spazioporto, perché possano recapitarlo al consiglio degli anziani. Dopo che il messaggio è stato consegnato, il consiglio chiede di incontrarti.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|label|2285|0
units.english: alt start
units.italian: alt start

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	When you arrive on <planet>, you are quickly escorted from the spaceport to the council chambers.|2286|0
units.english: When you arrive on <planet>, you are quickly escorted from the spaceport to the council chambers.
units.italian: Quando arrivi su <planet>, vieni rapidamente scortato dallo spazioporto alle camere del consiglio.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"Greetings again, <first> <last>," one of the elders says to you. "It is our understanding that our Unfettered brothers and sisters have created a carrier ship. How difficult was it for you to combat it?"|2288|0
units.english: "Greetings again, <first> <last>," one of the elders says to you. "It is our understanding that our Unfettered brothers and sisters have created a carrier ship. How difficult was it for you to combat it?"
units.italian: "Di nuovo salve, <first> <last>," ti dice uno degli anziani. "Ci risulta che i nostri fratelli e le nostre sorelle Slegati abbiano creato una nave portaerei. Quanto è stato difficile per te combatterla?"

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"The carrier is strong, but not strong enough, and can be easily taken down."|2290|0
units.english: "The carrier is strong, but not strong enough, and can be easily taken down."
units.italian: "La portaerei è forte, ma non abbastanza, e può essere abbattuta facilmente."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"It was easy for me, but I can't say it will be the same for your ships to combat."|2291|0
units.english: "It was easy for me, but I can't say it will be the same for your ships to combat."
units.italian: "Per me è stato facile, ma non posso dire che sarà lo stesso per le vostre navi."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"It was a difficult fight, as the carrier is very powerful."|2292|0
units.english: "It was a difficult fight, as the carrier is very powerful."
units.italian: "È stato uno scontro difficile, perché la portaerei è molto potente."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	The elders mumble among themselves about this information, periodically glancing down at what must be the message from Sayari detailing the Solifuge.|2293|0
units.english: The elders mumble among themselves about this information, periodically glancing down at what must be the message from Sayari detailing the Solifuge.
units.italian: Gli anziani mormorano fra loro su questa informazione, lanciando ogni tanto un'occhiata a quello che deve essere il messaggio di Sayari che descrive il Solifuge.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"We gather a large fleet above Cloudfire," one of the elders says, "and shortly afterward the Unfettered unveil this new ship. Perhaps it is only right that we respond in kind with a ship of our own."|2294|0
units.english: "We gather a large fleet above Cloudfire," one of the elders says, "and shortly afterward the Unfettered unveil this new ship. Perhaps it is only right that we respond in kind with a ship of our own."
units.italian: "Raduniamo una grande flotta sopra Cloudfire," dice uno degli anziani, "e poco dopo gli Slegati svelano questa nuova nave. Forse è giusto che rispondiamo con una nave nostra."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"My son is an engineer," another elder says. "He helped create our Centipede and Geocoris ships, both as a result of the humans living among us. Perhaps he would be of assistance in creating a ship to respond to the Unfettered." The elder presses a button and leans over to a microphone. "Please bring Osen into the council chamber."|2295|0
units.english: "My son is an engineer," another elder says. "He helped create our Centipede and Geocoris ships, both as a result of the humans living among us. Perhaps he would be of assistance in creating a ship to respond to the Unfettered." The elder presses a button and leans over to a microphone. "Please bring Osen into the council chamber."
units.italian: "Mio figlio è un ingegnere," dice un altro anziano. "Ha contribuito a creare le nostre navi Centipede e Geocoris, entrambe frutto degli umani che vivono fra noi. Forse potrebbe essere d'aiuto nel creare una nave per rispondere agli Slegati." L'anziano preme un pulsante e si sporge verso un microfono. "Per favore, fate entrare Osen nella camera del consiglio."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	A short while later, the elder's son enters the chamber and introduces himself to the council. They tell him about the Unfettered having created a carrier and the need for a new ship to be created as a response, and Osen's eyes go wide.|2296|0
units.english: A short while later, the elder's son enters the chamber and introduces himself to the council. They tell him about the Unfettered having created a carrier and the need for a new ship to be created as a response, and Osen's eyes go wide.
units.italian: Poco dopo, il figlio dell'anziano entra nella camera e si presenta al consiglio. Gli raccontano che gli Slegati hanno creato una portaerei e che serve una nuova nave in risposta, e gli occhi di Osen si spalancano.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	Osen begins speaking very quickly in the Hai language, so fast that your translation device seems to barely be able to keep up.|2297|0
units.english: Osen begins speaking very quickly in the Hai language, so fast that your translation device seems to barely be able to keep up.
units.italian: Osen comincia a parlare molto in fretta in lingua Hai, così in fretta che il tuo dispositivo di traduzione sembra a malapena riuscire a stargli dietro.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"I have [exactly, precisely] the ship! My team has been [developing, producing] a ship for many [years, cycles] that carries a [fleet, squadron] of drones. We have [working, functional] [prototypes, models], but they are not yet [finished, complete]. We are still [developing, producing] technology to repair the [hull, armor] of a ship in flight, which would make this ship and its drones much more [effective, powerful]."|2298|0
units.english: "I have [exactly, precisely] the ship! My team has been [developing, producing] a ship for many [years, cycles] that carries a [fleet, squadron] of drones. We have [working, functional] [prototypes, models], but they are not yet [finished, complete]. We are still [developing, producing] technology to repair the [hull, armor] of a ship in flight, which would make this ship and its drones much more [effective, powerful]."
units.italian: "Ho [esattamente, precisamente] la nave! Il mio gruppo [sviluppa, produce] da molti [anni, cicli] una nave che trasporta una [flotta, squadriglia] di droni. Abbiamo [prototipi, modelli] [funzionanti, operativi], ma non sono ancora [finiti, completi]. Stiamo ancora [sviluppando, producendo] la tecnologia per riparare lo [scafo, corazza] di una nave in volo, che renderebbe questa nave e i suoi droni molto più [efficaci, potenti]."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	The device continues speaking to you for nearly a minute after Osen stops talking (which is a little awkward as everyone stares at you). "Sorry, I wasn't aware that you had a translation device," Osen says, no longer speaking in Hai.|2299|0
units.english: The device continues speaking to you for nearly a minute after Osen stops talking (which is a little awkward as everyone stares at you). "Sorry, I wasn't aware that you had a translation device," Osen says, no longer speaking in Hai.
units.italian: Il dispositivo continua a parlarti per quasi un minuto dopo che Osen ha smesso di parlare (cosa un po' imbarazzante, dato che tutti ti fissano). "Scusa, non sapevo che avessi un dispositivo di traduzione," dice Osen, non parlando più in Hai.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"It's alright."|2301|0
units.english: "It's alright."
units.italian: "Non importa."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"You talk really fast."|2303|0
units.english: "You talk really fast."
units.italian: "Parli davvero in fretta."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	Osen shrugs and smiles at you. "I speak fast when I'm excited."|2304|0
units.english: Osen shrugs and smiles at you. "I speak fast when I'm excited."
units.italian: Osen alza le spalle e ti sorride. "Parlo in fretta quando sono emozionato."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"When is the earliest that you could provide these ships to us?" Osen's father asks.|2306|0
units.english: "When is the earliest that you could provide these ships to us?" Osen's father asks.
units.italian: "Quando è il prima possibile in cui potreste fornirci queste navi?" chiede il padre di Osen.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"It would only be a few weeks for us to have a number of prototype ships ready, but I highly suggest that we wait until we have created hull repair technology. If these Unfettered Solifuges do not have such technology, then having it will give our ship an advantage by being able to redeploy damaged drones, but we believe that we are still many years away from developing technology strong enough to be of any real use."|2307|0
units.english: "It would only be a few weeks for us to have a number of prototype ships ready, but I highly suggest that we wait until we have created hull repair technology. If these Unfettered Solifuges do not have such technology, then having it will give our ship an advantage by being able to redeploy damaged drones, but we believe that we are still many years away from developing technology strong enough to be of any real use."
units.italian: "Ci vorrebbero solo poche settimane per avere pronti alcuni prototipi di nave, ma consiglio vivamente di aspettare di aver creato la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo. Se questi Solifuge degli Slegati non hanno tale tecnologia, averla darà alla nostra nave un vantaggio, potendo ridistribuire droni danneggiati, ma crediamo che ci manchino ancora molti anni per sviluppare una tecnologia abbastanza valida da essere davvero utile."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	The elders once again mumble among themselves. They continue to ask Osen a number of questions about this new carrier. How difficult is one to produce? How much does it cost? What are the capabilities of the drones? How useful would it be without being able to repair the hull of its drones?|2308|0
units.english: The elders once again mumble among themselves. They continue to ask Osen a number of questions about this new carrier. How difficult is one to produce? How much does it cost? What are the capabilities of the drones? How useful would it be without being able to repair the hull of its drones?
units.italian: Gli anziani mormorano di nuovo fra loro. Continuano a fare a Osen diverse domande su questa nuova portaerei. Quanto è difficile produrne una? Quanto costa? Quali sono le capacità dei droni? Quanto sarebbe utile senza poter riparare lo scafo dei suoi droni?

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	After having all their questions answered, the elders seem to be interested in the idea of Osen's new ship. "This hull repair technology indeed sounds necessary," an elder says. "We will provide what funding we can to help fast track its development."|2309|0
units.english: After having all their questions answered, the elders seem to be interested in the idea of Osen's new ship. "This hull repair technology indeed sounds necessary," an elder says. "We will provide what funding we can to help fast track its development."
units.italian: Dopo che hanno avuto risposta a tutte le domande, gli anziani sembrano interessati all'idea della nuova nave di Osen. "Questa tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo sembra davvero necessaria," dice un anziano. "Forniremo i fondi che possiamo per aiutarne lo sviluppo rapido."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	Osen's father turns to you. "You have traveled many systems, <first> <last>. Perhaps you might be able to help. If you know of any peoples who have such technology from elsewhere in the galaxy, should it exist, then perhaps we could meet with them."|2310|0
units.english: Osen's father turns to you. "You have traveled many systems, <first> <last>. Perhaps you might be able to help. If you know of any peoples who have such technology from elsewhere in the galaxy, should it exist, then perhaps we could meet with them."
units.italian: Il padre di Osen si volta verso di te. "Hai viaggiato in molti sistemi, <first> <last>. Forse potresti essere d'aiuto. Se sai di qualche popolo che abbia questa tecnologia altrove nella galassia, se esiste, allora forse potremmo incontrarlo."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"I'm sorry, but I can't help right now. I need to return to the Wanderers."|2314|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I can't help right now. I need to return to the Wanderers."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso aiutare adesso. Devo tornare dai Wanderers."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"I'd be glad to help. I'm sure I could find someone with hull repair technology that could help."|2316|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. I'm sure I could find someone with hull repair technology that could help."
units.italian: "Sarò lieto di aiutare. Sono sicuro che potrei trovare qualcuno con la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo che potrebbe essere d'aiuto."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"Sayari's message mentions that you are still needed by the Wanderers," Osen's father responds. "Perhaps you should return to where you are needed the most, but when you are able to help us, we will gladly accept it." The elders all thank you for bringing Sayari's message and bid you safe travels back to <planet>.|2318|0
units.english: "Sayari's message mentions that you are still needed by the Wanderers," Osen's father responds. "Perhaps you should return to where you are needed the most, but when you are able to help us, we will gladly accept it." The elders all thank you for bringing Sayari's message and bid you safe travels back to <planet>.
units.italian: "Il messaggio di Sayari dice che i Wanderers hanno ancora bisogno di te," risponde il padre di Osen. "Forse dovresti tornare dove sei più necessario, ma quando potrai aiutarci, accetteremo volentieri." Gli anziani ti ringraziano tutti per aver portato il messaggio di Sayari e ti augurano buon viaggio per <planet>.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"This is understandable," Osen's father responds. "Return to where you are needed, but when you are able to help, we will gladly accept it." The elders all thank you for bringing Sayari's message and bid you safe travels back to <planet>.|2322|0
units.english: "This is understandable," Osen's father responds. "Return to where you are needed, but when you are able to help, we will gladly accept it." The elders all thank you for bringing Sayari's message and bid you safe travels back to <planet>.
units.italian: "È comprensibile," risponde il padre di Osen. "Torna dove sei necessario, ma quando potrai aiutarci, accetteremo volentieri." Gli anziani ti ringraziano tutti per aver portato il messaggio di Sayari e ti augurano buon viaggio per <planet>.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|label|2325|0
units.english: alt end
units.italian: alt end

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"I'd be glad to help. I'm sure I could find someone with hull repair technology that could help."|2327|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help. I'm sure I could find someone with hull repair technology that could help."
units.italian: "Sarò lieto di aiutare. Sono sicuro che potrei trovare qualcuno con la tecnologia di riparazione dello scafo che potrebbe essere d'aiuto."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now."|2329|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma in questo momento sono occupato."

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"This is understandable," Osen's father responds. "But we can be patient. Should you find time to help in the future, simply return to <origin> and inform the port authorities that you have what we seek, and we will meet with you again." The elders all thank you for giving them more information on the Unfettered Solifuge and bid you safe travels.|2330|0
units.english: "This is understandable," Osen's father responds. "But we can be patient. Should you find time to help in the future, simply return to <origin> and inform the port authorities that you have what we seek, and we will meet with you again." The elders all thank you for giving them more information on the Unfettered Solifuge and bid you safe travels.
units.italian: "È comprensibile," risponde il padre di Osen. "Ma possiamo aspettare. Se in futuro troverai il tempo di aiutarci, torna semplicemente su <origin> e informa le autorità portuali che hai ciò che cerchiamo, e ti incontreremo di nuovo." Gli anziani ti ringraziano tutti per aver dato loro più informazioni sul Solifuge degli Slegati e ti augurano buon viaggio.

units.id: conversation:solifuge conversation|	"Wonderful," Osen's father responds. "Once you have finished looking, simply return to <planet> and inform the port authorities that you have what we seek, and we will meet with you again." The elders all thank you for giving them more information on the Unfettered Solifuge and bid you safe travels.|2334|0
units.english: "Wonderful," Osen's father responds. "Once you have finished looking, simply return to <planet> and inform the port authorities that you have what we seek, and we will meet with you again." The elders all thank you for giving them more information on the Unfettered Solifuge and bid you safe travels.
units.italian: "Meraviglioso," risponde il padre di Osen. "Una volta finita la ricerca, torna semplicemente su <planet> e informa le autorità portuali che hai ciò che cerchiamo, e ti incontreremo di nuovo." Gli anziani ti ringraziano tutti per aver dato loro più informazioni sul Solifuge degli Slegati e ti augurano buon viaggio.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|name|2365|0
units.english: Evacuate <planet>
units.italian: Evacua <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|description|2366|0
units.english: Escort another fleet of Wanderer refugee transports to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta un'altra flotta di trasporti di profughi Wanderer fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|When you return to Wanderer space, you find four Wanderer ships that you've never seen before are parked near the spaceport. These must be the dedicated transport ships that Iktat Rek mentioned. One of the captains approaches you and says, "We are evacuating the worlds that will be [isolated, trapped] if the Unfettered gain more territory. Will you escort us to <planet>, and from there to the capital?"|2374|0
units.english: When you return to Wanderer space, you find four Wanderer ships that you've never seen before are parked near the spaceport. These must be the dedicated transport ships that Iktat Rek mentioned. One of the captains approaches you and says, "We are evacuating the worlds that will be [isolated, trapped] if the Unfettered gain more territory. Will you escort us to <planet>, and from there to the capital?"
units.italian: Quando torni nello spazio dei Wanderers, trovi quattro navi Wanderer che non hai mai visto parcheggiate vicino allo spazioporto. Devono essere le navi da trasporto dedicate di cui parlava Iktat Rek. Uno dei capitani ti si avvicina e dice: "Stiamo evacuando i mondi che resteranno [isolati, intrappolati] se gli Slegati guadagnano altro territorio. Ci scorterai su <planet>, e da lì alla capitale?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|	"I would be glad to."|2376|0
units.english: "I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Ne sarò felice."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|	"Not now - I will come back when I am ready."|2378|0
units.english: "Not now - I will come back when I am ready."
units.italian: "Non adesso: tornerò quando sarò pronto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1|dialog|2392|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but not all of the Riptide transports carrying the refugees are in the system. Better depart and wait for them all to arrive.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non tutti i trasporti Riptide con i profughi sono nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino tutti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1B|name|2411|0
units.english: Refugees to <planet>
units.italian: Profughi per <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1B|description|2412|0
units.english: Escort these transports carrying Wanderer refugees to their home world of <destination>, where they will hopefully be safe.
units.italian: Scorta questi trasporti con i profughi Wanderer fino al loro mondo d'origine, <destination>, dove si spera saranno al sicuro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1B|The Wanderer transports land in the spaceport and begin loading passengers. The village appears to be almost empty; all but the last few stragglers have already left. As on Varu Mer'ek before it was captured, they seem to have taken pains to leave their village as neat and tidy as possible. In similar circumstances, a human government would probably have chosen to burn everything of value to the ground rather than let it fall into enemy hands.|2421|0
units.english: The Wanderer transports land in the spaceport and begin loading passengers. The village appears to be almost empty; all but the last few stragglers have already left. As on Varu Mer'ek before it was captured, they seem to have taken pains to leave their village as neat and tidy as possible. In similar circumstances, a human government would probably have chosen to burn everything of value to the ground rather than let it fall into enemy hands.
units.italian: I trasporti dei Wanderers atterrano nello spazioporto e cominciano a caricare passeggeri. Il villaggio sembra quasi vuoto: tutti tranne gli ultimi ritardatari se ne sono già andati. Come su Varu Mer'ek prima che fosse conquistato, sembrano essersi dati pena di lasciare il villaggio il più ordinato e pulito possibile. In circostanze simili un governo umano avrebbe probabilmente scelto di dare alle fiamme tutto ciò che aveva valore, piuttosto che lasciarlo cadere in mani nemiche.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1B|dialog|2436|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but not all of the Riptide transports carrying the refugees are in the system. Better depart and wait for them all to arrive.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non tutti i trasporti Riptide con i profughi sono nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino tutti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|name|2448|0
units.english: Escort to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta per <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|description|2449|0
units.english: Escort these transports back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta questi trasporti fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|The transports offload the refugees, and one of the captains tells you that they are wanted back on <planet>. But now that you know that Iktat Rek may be dying, perhaps you should visit him while you are here.|2457|0
units.english: The transports offload the refugees, and one of the captains tells you that they are wanted back on <planet>. But now that you know that Iktat Rek may be dying, perhaps you should visit him while you are here.
units.italian: I trasporti scaricano i profughi, e uno dei capitani ti dice che li vogliono di nuovo su <planet>. Ma ora che sai che Iktat Rek potrebbe essere in fin di vita, forse dovresti andare a trovarlo finché sei qui.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|	(Check in on Iktat Rek.)|2459|0
units.english: (Check in on Iktat Rek.)
units.italian: (Fai visita a Iktat Rek.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|	(No, I can always visit him next time I'm here.)|2460|0
units.english: (No, I can always visit him next time I'm here.)
units.italian: (No, posso sempre andare a trovarlo la prossima volta che sono qui.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|	You contact Rek, and he invites you to come visit him in the house where he is staying - a Wanderer tree house near the outskirts of the city. He looks even more tired than before, and the bare patches of skin are spreading. In a few places a new set of black, oily feathers seem to be growing in, but they are thin and hairlike - not enough even to cover his skin, let alone to allow him to fly.|2462|0
units.english: You contact Rek, and he invites you to come visit him in the house where he is staying - a Wanderer tree house near the outskirts of the city. He looks even more tired than before, and the bare patches of skin are spreading. In a few places a new set of black, oily feathers seem to be growing in, but they are thin and hairlike - not enough even to cover his skin, let alone to allow him to fly.
units.italian: Contatti Rek, che ti invita a fargli visita nella casa dove alloggia, una casa sull'albero dei Wanderers vicino alla periferia della città. Sembra ancora più stanco di prima, e le chiazze di pelle nuda si stanno allargando. In qualche punto sembra crescere un nuovo strato di piume nere e unte, ma sono sottili come capelli, non abbastanza nemmeno a coprirgli la pelle, figurarsi a permettergli di volare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|	You sit and talk with him for a while. He is moving and speaking more slowly, but you are glad to see that his mind is as sharp as ever, and to pass the time he asks you all sorts of questions about human culture and history, which you answer as best you can. Eventually, you say goodbye and return to the spaceport.|2463|0
units.english: You sit and talk with him for a while. He is moving and speaking more slowly, but you are glad to see that his mind is as sharp as ever, and to pass the time he asks you all sorts of questions about human culture and history, which you answer as best you can. Eventually, you say goodbye and return to the spaceport.
units.italian: Ti siedi a parlare con lui per un po'. Si muove e parla più lentamente, ma sei contento di vedere che la sua mente è lucida come sempre, e per passare il tempo ti fa domande di ogni genere sulla cultura e la storia umana, a cui rispondi come meglio puoi. Alla fine vi salutate e torni allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|	The transports finish unloading the last of the passengers, and get ready to follow you back to <planet>.|2465|0
units.english: The transports finish unloading the last of the passengers, and get ready to follow you back to <planet>.
units.italian: I trasporti finiscono di scaricare gli ultimi passeggeri e si preparano a seguirti di nuovo su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Evacuation 1C|dialog|2480|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but not all of the Riptide transports carrying the refugees are in the system. Better depart and wait for them all to arrive.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non tutti i trasporti Riptide con i profughi sono nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino tutti.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|name|2490|0
units.english: Defend <planet>
units.italian: Difendi <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|description|2491|0
units.english: Drive off the Unfettered fleet attacking <system>, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Respingi la flotta degli Slegati che attacca <system>, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|Soon after the transports land, an alarm begins to sound and you see many Wanderers, the warriors in particular, rushing to board their ships. Sobari Tele'ek swoops down and lands next to your ship, and explains quickly, "We have detected a large Unfettered fleet [incoming, approaching]. Will you join in the defense?"|2499|0
units.english: Soon after the transports land, an alarm begins to sound and you see many Wanderers, the warriors in particular, rushing to board their ships. Sobari Tele'ek swoops down and lands next to your ship, and explains quickly, "We have detected a large Unfettered fleet [incoming, approaching]. Will you join in the defense?"
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio dei trasporti inizia a suonare un allarme, e vedi molti Wanderers, soprattutto i guerrieri, precipitarsi a bordo delle loro navi. Sobari Tele'ek scende in picchiata e atterra accanto alla tua nave, e spiega in fretta: "Abbiamo rilevato una grande flotta degli Slegati [in arrivo, in avvicinamento]. Ti unirai alla difesa?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|	You agree to help them, and begin preparing your ship for takeoff...|2500|0
units.english: You agree to help them, and begin preparing your ship for takeoff...
units.italian: Accetti di aiutarli e cominci a preparare la nave al decollo...

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|dialog|2503|0
units.english: There are still Unfettered warships overhead. You should take off again and assist in the fight.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi da guerra degli Slegati là sopra. Dovresti decollare di nuovo e dare una mano nello scontro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|log|2546|0
units.english: Helped to defend a Wanderer world from yet another Unfettered attack. Meanwhile, the Wanderers are trying to move as many civilians as possible back to their home world, where they will be safe. But, their strategy seems to be based on the hope that sometime soon a wormhole will open and allow the Wanderer people to flee to a new territory and leave their old planets behind for the Unfettered to claim.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a difendere un mondo dei Wanderers da ennesimo attacco degli Slegati. Nel frattempo i Wanderers stanno cercando di riportare quanti più civili possibile sul loro mondo d'origine, dove saranno al sicuro. La loro strategia sembra però basata sulla speranza che presto si apra un cunicolo spaziale e permetta al popolo Wanderer di fuggire verso un nuovo territorio, lasciando i vecchi pianeti agli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Defend Sich'ka'ara|The Unfettered fleet has been driven off. Tele'ek thanks you for taking part in defending this world. "Unfortunately," he says, "I just received news that this was only half of the Unfettered [assault, attack]. An equally large fleet attacked the Chirr'ay'akai system, and overwhelmed the defenses there so [quickly, unexpectedly] that some of our people did not have time to [escape, evacuate] and have been forced into hiding. If you're willing to help rescue them, please meet me in the spaceport once I am done [debriefing, informing] the warriors."|2550|0
units.english: The Unfettered fleet has been driven off. Tele'ek thanks you for taking part in defending this world. "Unfortunately," he says, "I just received news that this was only half of the Unfettered [assault, attack]. An equally large fleet attacked the Chirr'ay'akai system, and overwhelmed the defenses there so [quickly, unexpectedly] that some of our people did not have time to [escape, evacuate] and have been forced into hiding. If you're willing to help rescue them, please meet me in the spaceport once I am done [debriefing, informing] the warriors."
units.italian: La flotta degli Slegati è stata respinta. Tele'ek ti ringrazia per aver preso parte alla difesa di questo mondo. "Purtroppo," dice, "ho appena ricevuto notizia che questo era solo metà dell'[assalto, attacco] degli Slegati. Una flotta altrettanto grande ha attaccato il sistema Chirr'ay'akai e ha travolto le difese così [in fretta, inaspettatamente] che alcuni della nostra gente non hanno avuto il tempo di [fuggire, evacuare] e sono stati costretti a nascondersi. Se sei disposto ad aiutare a salvarli, incontrarmi allo spazioporto quando ho finito di [informare, ragguagliare] i guerrieri."

units.id: event:battle for sich'ka'ara ends|spaceport|2582|0
units.english: The Unfettered clearly do not know quite what to make of the Wanderer research station here that they have recently captured. Animals that were once part of various experiments are now wandering loose, and the Unfettered are making only sporadic efforts to keep them well-fed. Every once in a while one of them, driven by sheer hunger, tries to smash its way into one of the crates of military rations that the Unfettered have stacked up in the shade near the main landing pad.
units.italian: Gli Slegati chiaramente non sanno bene che cosa farsi della stazione di ricerca dei Wanderers che hanno appena conquistato. Gli animali che facevano parte di vari esperimenti ora vagano liberi, e gli Slegati fanno solo saltuari tentativi di nutrirli adeguatamente. Ogni tanto uno di loro, spinto dalla fame più cruda, cerca di sfondare una delle casse di razioni militari che gli Slegati hanno ammucchiato all'ombra vicino alla piazzola principale.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|name|2633|0
units.english: Wanderer Rescue
units.italian: Soccorso ai Wanderers

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|description|2634|0
units.english: Some Wanderer warriors were left behind on <planet> when the Unfettered captured the planet. Land on the planet with two Wanderer warships, and rescue them.
units.italian: Alcuni guerrieri Wanderer sono rimasti su <planet> quando gli Slegati hanno conquistato il pianeta. Atterra sul pianeta con due navi da guerra dei Wanderers e salvali.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|Sobari Tele'ek explains the situation to you. "Nearly a hundred warriors were on the ground on <planet> when it was captured," he says. "They [scattered, evaded capture] and flew away from the spaceport, then regrouped in hiding in one of the forests. I'm sending two warships to land on the planet and [retrieve, rescue] them, and I'd like you to [join, accompany] them. Any questions?"|2644|0
units.english: Sobari Tele'ek explains the situation to you. "Nearly a hundred warriors were on the ground on <planet> when it was captured," he says. "They [scattered, evaded capture] and flew away from the spaceport, then regrouped in hiding in one of the forests. I'm sending two warships to land on the planet and [retrieve, rescue] them, and I'd like you to [join, accompany] them. Any questions?"
units.italian: Sobari Tele'ek ti spiega la situazione. "Quasi un centinaio di guerrieri erano a terra su <planet> quando è stato conquistato," dice. "Si sono [sparsi, sottratti alla cattura] e sono volati via dallo spazioporto, poi si sono riuniti nascondendosi in una delle foreste. Mando due navi da guerra ad atterrare sul pianeta per [recuperarli, salvarli], e mi piacerebbe che tu ti [unissi, accompagnassi] a loro. Domande?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|	"No, I'm ready to go."|2646|0
units.english: "No, I'm ready to go."
units.italian: "No, sono pronto a partire."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|	"Why do you need me to take part in this mission?"|2648|0
units.english: "Why do you need me to take part in this mission?"
units.italian: "Perché hai bisogno che prenda parte a questa missione?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|	He says, "It matters deeply to some of our people to know that a member of another species is [assisting, journeying with] us in this conflict. Not merely for [morale? public relations?] but because your [support? acceptance?] gives our [self-defense, struggle] [moral weight? legitimacy?]." Your translator seems to be having trouble with the exact shades of meaning in his explanation.|2649|0
units.english: He says, "It matters deeply to some of our people to know that a member of another species is [assisting, journeying with] us in this conflict. Not merely for [morale? public relations?] but because your [support? acceptance?] gives our [self-defense, struggle] [moral weight? legitimacy?]." Your translator seems to be having trouble with the exact shades of meaning in his explanation.
units.italian: Dice: "Per alcuni della nostra gente conta molto sapere che un membro di un'altra specie ci [assiste, accompagna] in questo conflitto. Non solo per [il morale? i rapporti pubblici?] ma perché la tua [approvazione? accettazione?] dà alla nostra [autodifesa, lotta] [peso morale? legittimità?]." Il tuo traduttore sembra in difficoltà con le sfumature esatte della sua spiegazione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1|	You agree to join the expedition, and he introduces you to the captains of the two ships that will travel with you.|2650|0
units.english: You agree to join the expedition, and he introduces you to the captains of the two ships that will travel with you.
units.italian: Accetti di unirti alla spedizione, e lui ti presenta i capitani delle due navi che viaggeranno con te.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1B|name|2673|0
units.english: Wanderer Rescue
units.italian: Soccorso ai Wanderers

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1B|description|2674|0
units.english: Escort these two Wanderer warships, carrying rescued warriors from <origin>, safely back to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta queste due navi da guerra dei Wanderers, con a bordo i guerrieri salvati da <origin>, sane e salve fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1B|log|2680|0
units.english: Helped to rescue some Wanderers who were stranded and had to go into hiding in the forest when their planet was taken over by the Unfettered.
units.italian: Hai aiutato a salvare alcuni Wanderers che erano rimasti isolati e avevano dovuto nascondersi nella foresta quando il loro pianeta fu conquistato dagli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1B|The Wanderer warships come to a stop hovering above one of the largest forests on the planet. You see the flash of many different colors of wings as the Wanderer warriors who were hiding in the trees fly up to meet the ships, which open their airlocks to receive them. After less than five minutes, the Wanderer captains signal you that everyone is aboard, and you can return to <planet>.|2682|0
units.english: The Wanderer warships come to a stop hovering above one of the largest forests on the planet. You see the flash of many different colors of wings as the Wanderer warriors who were hiding in the trees fly up to meet the ships, which open their airlocks to receive them. After less than five minutes, the Wanderer captains signal you that everyone is aboard, and you can return to <planet>.
units.italian: Le navi da guerra dei Wanderers si fermano sospese sopra una delle foreste più grandi del pianeta. Vedi il lampeggio di ali di molti colori diversi mentre i guerrieri Wanderer nascosti fra gli alberi volano su a incontrare le navi, che aprono i portelli per riceverli. Dopo meno di cinque minuti i capitani Wanderer ti segnalano che sono tutti a bordo, e puoi tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|name|2704|0
units.english: Visit Iktat Rek
units.italian: Visita Iktat Rek

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|description|2705|0
units.english: Return to <destination>, where Iktat Rek's condition has continued to deteriorate.
units.italian: Torna su <destination>, dove le condizioni di Iktat Rek hanno continuato a peggiorare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|The Wanderers on <origin> are overjoyed that the rescue succeeded, and many of them thank you personally even though you feel like your role in the mission was rather minor. As the celebration continues, Tele'ek pulls you aside and says, "We must go somewhere [quiet, private] and speak."|2714|0
units.english: The Wanderers on <origin> are overjoyed that the rescue succeeded, and many of them thank you personally even though you feel like your role in the mission was rather minor. As the celebration continues, Tele'ek pulls you aside and says, "We must go somewhere [quiet, private] and speak."
units.italian: I Wanderers su <origin> sono estasiati per il successo del salvataggio, e molti ti ringraziano personalmente anche se ti sembra che il tuo ruolo nella missione sia stato piuttosto marginale. Mentre la festa continua, Tele'ek ti prende da parte e dice: "Dobbiamo andare in un posto [tranquillo, riservato] e parlare."
