units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|	He leads you into what looks like an officers' lounge, and you sit down at a table. "Rek who was called 'Iktat' was your [designated contact? cultural guide? species companion?], yes?" he asks. You nod, although it's clear your translator doesn't know exactly what the word means. "Rek is very sick and needs [advanced, intensive] medical care," he says. "He desires that you be the one to transport him to the [hospital, medical facility] on Tik Klai. You must return to <planet> and meet him."|2715|0
units.english: He leads you into what looks like an officers' lounge, and you sit down at a table. "Rek who was called 'Iktat' was your [designated contact? cultural guide? species companion?], yes?" he asks. You nod, although it's clear your translator doesn't know exactly what the word means. "Rek is very sick and needs [advanced, intensive] medical care," he says. "He desires that you be the one to transport him to the [hospital, medical facility] on Tik Klai. You must return to <planet> and meet him."
units.italian: Ti conduce in quella che sembra una sala per ufficiali, e ti siedi a un tavolo. "Rek, quello che era chiamato 'Iktat', era il tuo [contatto designato? guida culturale? compagno di specie?], giusto?" chiede. Annuisci, anche se è chiaro che il tuo traduttore non sa bene che cosa significhi quella parola. "Rek è molto malato e ha bisogno di cure mediche [avanzate, intensive]," dice. "Desidera che sia tu a trasportarlo al [centro medico, ospedale] su Tik Klai. Devi tornare su <planet> e incontrarlo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|	"Okay, I'll go there immediately."|2717|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll go there immediately."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci andrò subito."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|	"But, it's just the Molt. He'll be fine."|2719|0
units.english: "But, it's just the Molt. He'll be fine."
units.italian: "Ma è solo la Muta. Starà bene."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|	"It is probably [beneficial, encouraging] for Rek to maintain that hope," he says, "but our [stories, myths] say that never before has a Molt been [viable, successful] if it began when the Eye was not open."|2720|0
units.english: "It is probably [beneficial, encouraging] for Rek to maintain that hope," he says, "but our [stories, myths] say that never before has a Molt been [viable, successful] if it began when the Eye was not open."
units.italian: "Probabilmente è [utile, incoraggiante] per Rek mantenere quella speranza," dice, "ma le nostre [storie, leggende] dicono che mai prima d'ora una Muta è stata [vitale, riuscita] se è cominciata mentre l'Occhio non era aperto."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rescue 1C|	You promise that you will go visit Rek as quickly as possible, and bring him wherever he needs to go.|2721|0
units.english: You promise that you will go visit Rek as quickly as possible, and bring him wherever he needs to go.
units.italian: Prometti che andrai a trovare Rek il prima possibile, e che lo porterai ovunque debba andare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|name|2728|0
units.english: Bring Rek to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Rek su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|description|2729|0
units.english: Bring Iktat Rek to <destination>, where there is an advanced medical facility that can hopefully treat him.
units.italian: Porta Iktat Rek su <destination>, dove c'è una struttura medica avanzata che si spera possa curarlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|blocked|2734|0
units.english: You need a bunk free in order to carry Iktat Rek.
units.italian: Ti serve una cuccetta libera per trasportare Iktat Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|When Rek meets you in the spaceport, he is in the Wanderer equivalent of a motorized wheelchair. He has lost even more of his brown and gray plumage, and nothing but thin, withered, black feathers have grown in their place, like dark hairs growing from diseased skin. You are not sure if he has lost weight, or the loss of feathers simply makes him appear more gaunt. "I am glad you are here, <first> <last>," he says.|2739|0
units.english: When Rek meets you in the spaceport, he is in the Wanderer equivalent of a motorized wheelchair. He has lost even more of his brown and gray plumage, and nothing but thin, withered, black feathers have grown in their place, like dark hairs growing from diseased skin. You are not sure if he has lost weight, or the loss of feathers simply makes him appear more gaunt. "I am glad you are here, <first> <last>," he says.
units.italian: Quando Rek ti incontra allo spazioporto, è sull'equivalente Wanderer di una sedia a rotelle motorizzata. Ha perso ancora più piumaggio bruno e grigio, e al suo posto è cresciuto solo qualcosa di sottile, avvizzito e nero, come peli scuri su una pelle malata. Non sei sicuro che abbia perso peso, o che la perdita di piume lo faccia semplicemente sembrare più emaciato. "Sono contento che tu sia qui, <first> <last>," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"Don't worry, Iktat Rek. You'll make it through this."|2741|0
units.english: "Don't worry, Iktat Rek. You'll make it through this."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, Iktat Rek. Ne uscirai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	He winces when you say his name. "You must not call me that anymore," he says. "'Iktat' was my role-name, and I can serve in that role no longer. I am now known only by my core-name of Rek, or my child-name Rek d' Esta'a i' Veruk. If I survive the Molt, I will become someone new, and will receive a new role-name as well."|2742|0
units.english: He winces when you say his name. "You must not call me that anymore," he says. "'Iktat' was my role-name, and I can serve in that role no longer. I am now known only by my core-name of Rek, or my child-name Rek d' Esta'a i' Veruk. If I survive the Molt, I will become someone new, and will receive a new role-name as well."
units.italian: Sussulta quando dici il suo nome. "Non devi più chiamarmi così," dice. "'Iktat' era il mio nome di ruolo, e quel ruolo non posso più ricoprirlo. Ora sono conosciuto solo con il mio nome essenziale, Rek, o con il mio nome d'infanzia, Rek d' Esta'a i' Veruk. Se sopravvivrò alla Muta diventerò qualcuno di nuovo, e riceverò anche un nuovo nome di ruolo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"You're strong. I'm sure you will survive."|2744|0
units.english: "You're strong. I'm sure you will survive."
units.italian: "Sei forte. Sono sicuro che sopravvivrai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"Do you have any idea what you will become?"|2745|0
units.english: "Do you have any idea what you will become?"
units.italian: "Hai un'idea di che cosa diventerai?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"I hope so," he says, "but I cannot avoid overhearing the whispers of those around me. And the doctors say the Molt is rearranging and shutting down some of my internal organs. My primary hope now is just to live long enough to know that my people will have a future."|2747|0
units.english: "I hope so," he says, "but I cannot avoid overhearing the whispers of those around me. And the doctors say the Molt is rearranging and shutting down some of my internal organs. My primary hope now is just to live long enough to know that my people will have a future."
units.italian: "Lo spero," dice, "ma non posso fare a meno di sentire i sussurri di chi mi sta intorno. E i medici dicono che la Muta sta riorganizzando e spegnendo alcuni dei miei organi interni. La mia speranza principale adesso è solo vivere abbastanza a lungo da sapere che la mia gente avrà un futuro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"It is impossible to know," he says. "The Molt can make us not just a new individual, but almost a new species, with new abilities no Wanderers had before. I have some suspicions of what may be changing inside me, but I do not wish to invite ill fortune by voicing those hopes aloud."|2750|0
units.english: "It is impossible to know," he says. "The Molt can make us not just a new individual, but almost a new species, with new abilities no Wanderers had before. I have some suspicions of what may be changing inside me, but I do not wish to invite ill fortune by voicing those hopes aloud."
units.italian: "È impossibile saperlo," dice. "La Muta può farci diventare non solo un nuovo individuo, ma quasi una nuova specie, con capacità che nessun Wanderer aveva prima. Ho qualche sospetto su ciò che forse sta cambiando dentro di me, ma non voglio attirare la sfortuna dicendo ad alta voce quelle speranze."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	It is not until you have wheeled him halfway up the ramp into your ship that you realize something: throughout the entire conversation, Rek was speaking to you in your native language, without using the translator. You had not realized that Wanderer vocal organs could mimic human speech so perfectly.|2752|0
units.english: It is not until you have wheeled him halfway up the ramp into your ship that you realize something: throughout the entire conversation, Rek was speaking to you in your native language, without using the translator. You had not realized that Wanderer vocal organs could mimic human speech so perfectly.
units.italian: Solo quando l'hai spinto per metà della rampa dentro la tua nave ti rendi conto di una cosa: per tutta la conversazione Rek ti ha parlato nella tua lingua, senza usare il traduttore. Non avevi capito che gli organi vocali dei Wanderers potessero imitare così perfettamente il parlato umano.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	"Rek, when did you learn to speak my language?"|2754|0
units.english: "Rek, when did you learn to speak my language?"
units.italian: "Rek, quando hai imparato a parlare la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	He makes a sound halfway between a laugh and a cough, and says, "Even as my body decays, my mind has grown sharper. The more I listened to your box speaking to you, the more its words began to make sense to me."|2755|0
units.english: He makes a sound halfway between a laugh and a cough, and says, "Even as my body decays, my mind has grown sharper. The more I listened to your box speaking to you, the more its words began to make sense to me."
units.italian: Emette un suono a metà fra una risata e un colpo di tosse, e dice: "Mentre il mio corpo decade, la mia mente si è fatta più acuta. Più ascoltavo la tua scatola che ti parlava, più le sue parole cominciavano ad avere senso per me."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|	He seems too tired to answer any more questions. You make sure Rek is comfortable in one of your bunk rooms, then prepare to travel to <planet>.|2756|0
units.english: He seems too tired to answer any more questions. You make sure Rek is comfortable in one of your bunk rooms, then prepare to travel to <planet>.
units.italian: Sembra troppo stanco per rispondere ad altre domande. Ti assicuri che Rek stia comodo in una delle tue cabine, poi ti prepari a partire per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 0|dialog|2759|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Iktat Rek hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta che porta Iktat Rek non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|name|2765|0
units.english: Visit Sko'karak
units.italian: Visita Sko'karak

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|description|2766|0
units.english: Rek asked you to visit the Sko'karak system, then return to <planet> and tell him what you found there.
units.italian: Rek ti ha chiesto di visitare il sistema Sko'karak, poi di tornare su <planet> e dirgli che cosa ci hai trovato.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|log|2772|0
units.english: Brought Iktat Rek to a Wanderer hospital facility. His illness, or molt, is progressing, and he has grown much weaker. But his mind is still as sharp as ever, and in fact he has somehow managed to pick up human language just by listening to the words of the translation machine.
units.italian: Hai portato Iktat Rek in una struttura ospedaliera dei Wanderers. La sua malattia, o muta, sta avanzando, e si è molto indebolito. Ma la sua mente è lucida come sempre, e anzi è riuscito in qualche modo a imparare la lingua umana semplicemente ascoltando le parole della macchina per tradurre.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|A Wanderer hospital is not too different from a human one. You stand in a corner trying not to get in the way as they transfer Rek to a bed and connect him to various tubes and wires. Without his feathers he looks unbelievably fragile, almost skeletal, but the Wanderer nurses and doctors are handling him as gently as possible.|2774|0
units.english: A Wanderer hospital is not too different from a human one. You stand in a corner trying not to get in the way as they transfer Rek to a bed and connect him to various tubes and wires. Without his feathers he looks unbelievably fragile, almost skeletal, but the Wanderer nurses and doctors are handling him as gently as possible.
units.italian: Un ospedale dei Wanderers non è molto diverso da uno umano. Te ne stai in un angolo cercando di non intralciare mentre trasferiscono Rek su un letto e lo collegano a tubi e fili di vario genere. Senza le piume sembra incredibilmente fragile, quasi scheletrico, ma gli infermieri e i medici Wanderer lo trattano con la massima delicatezza.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|	Eventually you are left alone with him. For a while he seems to just be gazing off into the distance, his eyes unfocused. Then he seems to realize that you are here and his eyes take on a new depth and alertness as he turns to look at you. Again speaking in your own language, he says, "Go visit the Sko'karak system and tell me what you find there." Then he shuts his eyes and falls asleep.|2775|0
units.english: Eventually you are left alone with him. For a while he seems to just be gazing off into the distance, his eyes unfocused. Then he seems to realize that you are here and his eyes take on a new depth and alertness as he turns to look at you. Again speaking in your own language, he says, "Go visit the Sko'karak system and tell me what you find there." Then he shuts his eyes and falls asleep.
units.italian: Alla fine resti solo con lui. Per un po' sembra fissare il vuoto in lontananza, con gli occhi sfocati. Poi sembra accorgersi che sei lì, e i suoi occhi acquistano una nuova profondità e attenzione mentre si volta a guardarti. Parlando di nuovo nella tua lingua, dice: "Va' a visitare il sistema Sko'karak e dimmi che cosa ci trovi." Poi chiude gli occhi e si addormenta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|You enter this system with high hopes that Rek, despite his weakened state, has sensed something significant happening here and sent you to discover it. But, your sensors pick up nothing out of the ordinary.|2779|0
units.english: You enter this system with high hopes that Rek, despite his weakened state, has sensed something significant happening here and sent you to discover it. But, your sensors pick up nothing out of the ordinary.
units.italian: Entri in questo sistema con la forte speranza che Rek, nonostante le condizioni debilitate, abbia percepito che qui sta succedendo qualcosa di importante e ti abbia mandato a scoprirlo. I tuoi sensori, però, non rilevano nulla di straordinario.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 1|dialog|2781|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet entered the Sko'karak system to investigate. Better depart and make sure you visit it before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non sei ancora entrato nel sistema Sko'karak per indagare. Meglio ripartire e assicurarti di visitarlo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|name|2787|0
units.english: Visit Sko'karak again
units.italian: Visita di nuovo Sko'karak

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|description|2788|0
units.english: Rek asked you to visit the Sko'karak system again, and see if anything has changed there. Then, return to <destination>.
units.italian: Rek ti ha chiesto di visitare di nuovo il sistema Sko'karak e di vedere se qualcosa è cambiato. Poi torna su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|When you arrive, you can tell that the locals are agitated about something. Finally one of them switches into the Hai language and explains to you what is going on. "We have just heard that the Unfettered have [stolen, captured] three more of our worlds," he says, "but do not tell Rek the news."|2796|0
units.english: When you arrive, you can tell that the locals are agitated about something. Finally one of them switches into the Hai language and explains to you what is going on. "We have just heard that the Unfettered have [stolen, captured] three more of our worlds," he says, "but do not tell Rek the news."
units.italian: Quando arrivi, capisci che la gente del posto è agitata per qualcosa. Alla fine uno di loro passa alla lingua Hai e ti spiega che cosa succede. "Abbiamo appena saputo che gli Slegati ci hanno [rubato, conquistato] altri tre mondi," dice, "ma non dare la notizia a Rek."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|	You visit Iktat Rek and tell him that you found nothing out of the ordinary in the Sko'karak system. He barely even opens his eyes as you speak to him. "Go back and look again," he says.|2797|0
units.english: You visit Iktat Rek and tell him that you found nothing out of the ordinary in the Sko'karak system. He barely even opens his eyes as you speak to him. "Go back and look again," he says.
units.italian: Vai a trovare Iktat Rek e gli dici che nel sistema Sko'karak non hai trovato nulla di straordinario. A malapena apre gli occhi mentre gli parli. "Torna e guarda di nuovo," dice.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|	"Okay, I'll go and look again."|2799|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll go and look again."
units.italian: "Va bene, andrò a guardare di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|	"You should know, another three systems were lost to the Unfettered."|2801|0
units.english: "You should know, another three systems were lost to the Unfettered."
units.italian: "Dovresti saperlo: altri tre sistemi sono stati perduti a favore degli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|	He sighs. "If the Eye would only open, it would not matter. I do not understand why the keepers of the portal will not open it and let us flee from this war into a place of safety. Go again to Sko'karak, and look."|2802|0
units.english: He sighs. "If the Eye would only open, it would not matter. I do not understand why the keepers of the portal will not open it and let us flee from this war into a place of safety. Go again to Sko'karak, and look."
units.italian: Sospira. "Se solo l'Occhio si aprisse, non importerebbe. Non capisco perché i custodi del portale non lo aprano e ci lascino fuggire da questa guerra in un luogo sicuro. Torna a Sko'karak, e guarda."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|You enter the system again, and do an even more detailed sensor sweep in case you missed something the first time. You find nothing.|2806|0
units.english: You enter the system again, and do an even more detailed sensor sweep in case you missed something the first time. You find nothing.
units.italian: Entri di nuovo nel sistema e fai una scansione dei sensori ancora più dettagliata, nel caso ti sia sfuggito qualcosa la prima volta. Non trovi nulla.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 2|dialog|2808|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet entered the Sko'karak system to investigate. Better depart and make sure you visit it before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non sei ancora entrato nel sistema Sko'karak per indagare. Meglio ripartire e assicurarti di visitarlo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|name|2814|0
units.english: Visit Sko'karak
units.italian: Visita Sko'karak

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|description|2815|0
units.english: Visit the Sko'karak system for a third time, and see if anything has changed there. Then, return to <planet> to report to Rek.
units.italian: Visita il sistema Sko'karak per la terza volta e vedi se qualcosa è cambiato. Poi torna su <planet> per riferire a Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|When you enter the spaceport, a white-plumed Wanderer who looks eerily similar to Rek comes out of the hospital to meet you. For a brief confused moment you wonder if Rek has indeed completed the Molt and is now standing before you healed, then she introduces herself as Melaka Esta'a, Rek's mother. "Rek is asleep," she says. "Do you bring good news?"|2823|0
units.english: When you enter the spaceport, a white-plumed Wanderer who looks eerily similar to Rek comes out of the hospital to meet you. For a brief confused moment you wonder if Rek has indeed completed the Molt and is now standing before you healed, then she introduces herself as Melaka Esta'a, Rek's mother. "Rek is asleep," she says. "Do you bring good news?"
units.italian: Quando entri nello spazioporto, una Wanderer dal piumaggio bianco che somiglia in modo inquietante a Rek esce dall'ospedale per incontrarti. Per un breve momento di confusione ti chiedi se Rek abbia davvero completato la Muta e sia ora davanti a te, guarito; poi lei si presenta come Melaka Esta'a, la madre di Rek. "Rek dorme," dice. "Porti buone notizie?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|	"No, I found nothing."|2825|0
units.english: "No, I found nothing."
units.italian: "No, non ho trovato nulla."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|	She says, "Rek's body is destroying itself [fighting, resisting] the Molt. Soon we must give him the drugs that will [disable, eliminate] his immune system and allow the new cells to finish their [conquest, invasion] of his body. For that treatment he must enter [seclusion, isolation] to protect him from infection. But he will not go until you bring him the [word, news] he awaits."|2826|0
units.english: She says, "Rek's body is destroying itself [fighting, resisting] the Molt. Soon we must give him the drugs that will [disable, eliminate] his immune system and allow the new cells to finish their [conquest, invasion] of his body. For that treatment he must enter [seclusion, isolation] to protect him from infection. But he will not go until you bring him the [word, news] he awaits."
units.italian: Dice: "Il corpo di Rek si sta distruggendo [combattendo, resistendo] alla Muta. Presto dovremo dargli i farmaci che [disattiveranno, elimineranno] il suo sistema immunitario e permetteranno alle nuove cellule di completare la loro [conquista, invasione] del suo corpo. Per quella cura deve entrare in [isolamento, clausura] per proteggerlo dalle infezioni. Ma non ci andrà prima che tu gli porti la [parola, notizia] che aspetta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|	"I will go back one more time and see if anything has changed."|2828|0
units.english: "I will go back one more time and see if anything has changed."
units.italian: "Tornerò ancora una volta e vedrò se qualcosa è cambiato."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|	"Should I lie to him and say the Eye is open?"|2830|0
units.english: "Should I lie to him and say the Eye is open?"
units.italian: "Dovrei mentirgli e dire che l'Occhio è aperto?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|	"No," she says, "go back one more time and look. If there is still nothing, we will [decide, consider] what to do next."|2831|0
units.english: "No," she says, "go back one more time and look. If there is still nothing, we will [decide, consider] what to do next."
units.italian: "No," dice, "torna ancora una volta e guarda. Se ancora non c'è nulla, [decideremo, valuteremo] che cosa fare."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|This time when you enter the system, your sensors pick up some strange astronomical phenomenon out beyond the orbit of the farthest planet, a wisp of light like a gathering raincloud. It's not a wormhole, but it is a change. Perhaps it will be enough to give Rek hope.|2835|0
units.english: This time when you enter the system, your sensors pick up some strange astronomical phenomenon out beyond the orbit of the farthest planet, a wisp of light like a gathering raincloud. It's not a wormhole, but it is a change. Perhaps it will be enough to give Rek hope.
units.italian: Questa volta, quando entri nel sistema, i tuoi sensori rilevano uno strano fenomeno astronomico oltre l'orbita del pianeta più lontano, un filo di luce come una nube temporalesca che si raccoglie. Non è un cunicolo spaziale, ma è un cambiamento. Forse basterà a dare speranza a Rek.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Rek 3|dialog|2837|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you haven't yet entered the Sko'karak system to investigate. Better depart and make sure you visit it before returning.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non sei ancora entrato nel sistema Sko'karak per indagare. Meglio ripartire e assicurarti di visitarlo prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|name|2843|0
units.english: Help defend <planet>
units.italian: Aiuta a difendere <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|description|2844|0
units.english: Return to <destination>, where the Wanderers have chosen to take their stand against the Unfettered incursion.
units.italian: Torna su <destination>, dove i Wanderers hanno scelto di tenere la loro posizione contro l'incursione degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|log|2851|0
units.english: Iktat Rek has been placed in protective quarantine in a germ-free room, where he will receive drugs that will suppress his immune system and allow the genetic change that is taking place in his body to be completed. Even if he survives the process, it may change him beyond recognition.
units.italian: Iktat Rek è stato messo in quarantena protettiva in una stanza sterile, dove riceverà farmaci che sopprimeranno il suo sistema immunitario e permetteranno di completare il cambiamento genetico in corso nel suo corpo. Anche se sopravviverà al processo, potrebbe cambiarlo fino a renderlo irriconoscibile.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|You hurry into the hospital room. Rek's skin is now almost entirely bare aside from the withered, stringy black feathers that have grown in place of the once rich plumage. Rek's eyes spring open when you enter the room. "You have news," Rek says. "I can see it in your expression. What did you see?" Given how hard it is to read alien facial expressions, it would be quite remarkable if Rek could actually tell anything from looking at your face, but it would not be polite to say so.|2853|0
units.english: You hurry into the hospital room. Rek's skin is now almost entirely bare aside from the withered, stringy black feathers that have grown in place of the once rich plumage. Rek's eyes spring open when you enter the room. "You have news," Rek says. "I can see it in your expression. What did you see?" Given how hard it is to read alien facial expressions, it would be quite remarkable if Rek could actually tell anything from looking at your face, but it would not be polite to say so.
units.italian: Ti precipiti nella stanza d'ospedale. La pelle di Rek ora è quasi del tutto nuda, a parte le piume nere avvizzite e filiformi cresciute al posto del piumaggio un tempo rigoglioso. Gli occhi di Rek si spalancano quando entri. "Hai notizie," dice Rek. "Si vede dalla tua espressione. Che cosa hai visto?" Considerato quanto è difficile leggere le espressioni facciali aliene, sarebbe davvero notevole se Rek riuscisse a capire qualcosa guardandoti in faccia, ma non sarebbe educato dirlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Something has begun in the Sko'karak system, a cosmological phenomenon my ship's sensors did not recognize. It may be the Eye, beginning to open."|2855|0
units.english: "Something has begun in the Sko'karak system, a cosmological phenomenon my ship's sensors did not recognize. It may be the Eye, beginning to open."
units.italian: "Qualcosa è cominciato nel sistema Sko'karak, un fenomeno cosmologico che i sensori della mia nave non hanno riconosciuto. Potrebbe essere l'Occhio, che comincia ad aprirsi."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"There is some sort of cosmological phenomenon, but it is not a wormhole. I do not want to offer you false hope."|2856|0
units.english: "There is some sort of cosmological phenomenon, but it is not a wormhole. I do not want to offer you false hope."
units.italian: "C'è una specie di fenomeno cosmologico, ma non è un cunicolo spaziale. Non voglio darti false speranze."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"It is the Eye," says Rek. "I am sure of it. It comes too late to save us from the great losses we have suffered, but perhaps not too late to preserve our species from destruction. So, my waiting is at an end."|2857|0
units.english: "It is the Eye," says Rek. "I am sure of it. It comes too late to save us from the great losses we have suffered, but perhaps not too late to preserve our species from destruction. So, my waiting is at an end."
units.italian: "È l'Occhio," dice Rek. "Ne sono certo. Arriva troppo tardi per salvarci dalle grandi perdite che abbiamo subito, ma forse non troppo tardi per preservare la nostra specie dalla distruzione. Quindi la mia attesa è finita."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	Rek calls to one of the nurses. The hospital bed is on wheels, and they quickly detach it from the various machines on the walls. Esta'a, Rek's mother, comes into the room and explains to you, "The room of [seclusion, isolation] is deeper underground. They will [wash, sterilize] Rek's body, then wait a week to check for any [residual, hidden] contamination, then begin to administer the drugs that will stop Rek's body from [fighting, resisting] the transformation. Even if all goes well, we will not see Rek again for a long time, and never again in this [body, form]."|2858|0
units.english: Rek calls to one of the nurses. The hospital bed is on wheels, and they quickly detach it from the various machines on the walls. Esta'a, Rek's mother, comes into the room and explains to you, "The room of [seclusion, isolation] is deeper underground. They will [wash, sterilize] Rek's body, then wait a week to check for any [residual, hidden] contamination, then begin to administer the drugs that will stop Rek's body from [fighting, resisting] the transformation. Even if all goes well, we will not see Rek again for a long time, and never again in this [body, form]."
units.italian: Rek chiama una delle infermiere. Il letto d'ospedale è su ruote, e lo staccano rapidamente dalle varie macchine attaccate alle pareti. Esta'a, la madre di Rek, entra nella stanza e ti spiega: "La stanza dell'[isolamento, clausura] è più in profondità, sottoterra. [Laveranno, sterilizzeranno] il corpo di Rek, poi aspetteranno una settimana per verificare eventuali contaminazioni [residue, nascoste], poi cominceranno a somministrare i farmaci che impediranno al corpo di Rek di [combattere, resistere] alla trasformazione. Anche se tutto andrà bene, non rivedremo Rek per molto tempo, e mai più in questo [corpo, forma]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Don't worry. Rek is strong enough to survive this."|2860|0
units.english: "Don't worry. Rek is strong enough to survive this."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti. Rek è abbastanza forte da sopravvivere."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Will you let me know what happens, regardless of the outcome?"|2862|0
units.english: "Will you let me know what happens, regardless of the outcome?"
units.italian: "Mi farai sapere come va, qualunque sia l'esito?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"I will," she says. "Unless, of course, some great [calamity? upheaval?] befalls us and we are too caught up in other [matters, necessities]."|2863|0
units.english: "I will," she says. "Unless, of course, some great [calamity? upheaval?] befalls us and we are too caught up in other [matters, necessities]."
units.italian: "Lo farò," dice. "A meno che, naturalmente, qualche grande [calamità? sconvolgimento?] ci piombi addosso e siamo troppo presi da altre [faccende, necessità]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	Three Wanderer nurses come and wheel Rek's bed out the door and into an elevator. At Rek's request, you join them. The elevator opens up to a wide and vaulted hallway lined on either side by Wanderers dressed in black, come to pay their last respects to Rek. It is like something out of a dream: the subterranean passage dense with the stately forms of Wanderer officials, the black-cloaked wings and shadows contrasting with the bright linen of the hospital bed and the white plumage of Rek's mother as she follows the cart to the threshold of the isolation chamber.|2865|0
units.english: Three Wanderer nurses come and wheel Rek's bed out the door and into an elevator. At Rek's request, you join them. The elevator opens up to a wide and vaulted hallway lined on either side by Wanderers dressed in black, come to pay their last respects to Rek. It is like something out of a dream: the subterranean passage dense with the stately forms of Wanderer officials, the black-cloaked wings and shadows contrasting with the bright linen of the hospital bed and the white plumage of Rek's mother as she follows the cart to the threshold of the isolation chamber.
units.italian: Tre infermiere Wanderer arrivano e portano il letto di Rek fuori dalla porta e in un ascensore. Su richiesta di Rek ti unisci a loro. L'ascensore si apre su un corridoio ampio e a volta, fiancheggiato da Wanderers vestiti di nero, venuti a rendere l'ultimo omaggio a Rek. È come qualcosa uscito da un sogno: il passaggio sotterraneo denso delle forme solenni dei funzionari Wanderer, le ali ammantate di nero e le ombre in contrasto con il lino chiaro del letto d'ospedale e il piumaggio bianco della madre di Rek, che segue il carrello fino alla soglia della camera di isolamento.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	The door of the chamber snaps shut with a pneumatic hiss, and you make your way back up to the spaceport with the other visitors. One of the visitors is Emeka'a Isai, the former governor of Varu Mer'ek. She pulls you aside and says, "You should not [remain, dawdle] here, human. They will have need of you at the [front, battle line]. And the sight of you may be unwelcome to some of the [mourners? associates?] of Rek who are here."|2866|0
units.english: The door of the chamber snaps shut with a pneumatic hiss, and you make your way back up to the spaceport with the other visitors. One of the visitors is Emeka'a Isai, the former governor of Varu Mer'ek. She pulls you aside and says, "You should not [remain, dawdle] here, human. They will have need of you at the [front, battle line]. And the sight of you may be unwelcome to some of the [mourners? associates?] of Rek who are here."
units.italian: La porta della camera si chiude di scatto con un sibilo pneumatico, e risali verso lo spazioporto insieme agli altri visitatori. Una dei visitatori è Emeka'a Isai, l'ex governatrice di Varu Mer'ek. Ti prende da parte e dice: "Non dovresti [restare, indugiare] qui, umano. Avranno bisogno di te al [fronte, fronte di battaglia]. E la tua vista potrebbe essere sgradita ad alcuni dei [parenti? conoscenti?] di Rek che sono qui."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Okay, I'll go to <planet> and aid in the defense."|2868|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll go to <planet> and aid in the defense."
units.italian: "Va bene, andrò su <planet> e aiuterò nella difesa."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Wait, why would people be angry at me after all I've done to help?"|2870|0
units.english: "Wait, why would people be angry at me after all I've done to help?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, perché dovrebbe qualcuno essere arrabbiato con me dopo tutto l'aiuto che ho dato?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 1|	"Not angry at you," she says, "but some say the Molt is [triggered, provoked] by exposure to [alien, foreign] things: that your coming is what made Rek's body begin its [change, metamorphosis] too soon." She is silent for a moment, then says, "Please, do not be [concerned, grieved]. Rek may yet live, and rise to great renown as the first of a new [generation, race]. In any event, that is the past. Go, now, and help us to [secure, obtain] a future."|2871|0
units.english: "Not angry at you," she says, "but some say the Molt is [triggered, provoked] by exposure to [alien, foreign] things: that your coming is what made Rek's body begin its [change, metamorphosis] too soon." She is silent for a moment, then says, "Please, do not be [concerned, grieved]. Rek may yet live, and rise to great renown as the first of a new [generation, race]. In any event, that is the past. Go, now, and help us to [secure, obtain] a future."
units.italian: "Non arrabbiati con te," dice, "ma alcuni dicono che la Muta è [provocata, innescata] dall'esposizione a cose [aliene, estranee]: che è stata la tua venuta a far cominciare troppo presto il [cambiamento, la metamorfosi] del corpo di Rek." Resta in silenzio per un momento, poi dice: "Ti prego, non essere [preoccupato, addolorato]. Rek può ancora vivere, e diventare celebre come primo di una nuova [generazione, stirpe]. In ogni caso, quello è il passato. Va' ora, e aiutaci a [assicurarci, ottenere] un futuro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 2|name|2910|0
units.english: Help defend <planet>
units.italian: Aiuta a difendere <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 2|description|2911|0
units.english: Defend <planet> from an Unfettered invasion fleet, then land back on the planet.
units.italian: Difendi <planet> da una flotta d'invasione degli Slegati, poi atterra di nuovo sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 2|As you are coming in for a landing here you think you see a few Wanderer ships of yet another unfamiliar design, even larger than the Tempest. Their level of military technology has risen at an incredible rate since the Unfettered invasion began, even if it is true that they are just putting ancient ship and weapon designs back into production rather than inventing them anew.|2917|0
units.english: As you are coming in for a landing here you think you see a few Wanderer ships of yet another unfamiliar design, even larger than the Tempest. Their level of military technology has risen at an incredible rate since the Unfettered invasion began, even if it is true that they are just putting ancient ship and weapon designs back into production rather than inventing them anew.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, ti sembra di vedere alcune navi Wanderer di un altro modello ancora sconosciuto, più grandi anche della Tempest. Il loro livello di tecnologia militare è cresciuto a un ritmo incredibile da quando è iniziata l'invasione degli Slegati, anche se è vero che stanno solo rimettendo in produzione antichi progetti di navi e armi invece di inventarne di nuovi.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 2|	But the new technology cannot completely offset the fact that no living Wanderer has any real military experience. So, several of their leaders here are eager to talk with you, and you spend hours telling them stories from your recent experience in the war in human space. Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander, is among them. Your conversation is interrupted when sirens begin to sound in the spaceport. "The Hai are approaching!" says Tele'ek. "Please join us in battle, one more time."|2918|0
units.english: But the new technology cannot completely offset the fact that no living Wanderer has any real military experience. So, several of their leaders here are eager to talk with you, and you spend hours telling them stories from your recent experience in the war in human space. Sobari Tele'ek, the military commander, is among them. Your conversation is interrupted when sirens begin to sound in the spaceport. "The Hai are approaching!" says Tele'ek. "Please join us in battle, one more time."
units.italian: Ma la nuova tecnologia non può compensare del tutto il fatto che nessun Wanderer vivente abbia una vera esperienza militare. Così diversi dei loro capi qui sono ansiosi di parlare con te, e passi ore a raccontare loro episodi della tua recente esperienza nella guerra nello spazio umano. Fra loro c'è Sobari Tele'ek, il comandante militare. La conversazione viene interrotta quando le sirene cominciano a suonare nello spazioporto. "Gli Hai si avvicinano!" dice Tele'ek. "Unisciti a noi in battaglia, ancora una volta."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 2|dialog|2925|0
units.english: There are still Unfettered warships overhead. You should take off again and assist in the fight.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi da guerra degli Slegati là sopra. Dovresti decollare di nuovo e dare una mano nello scontro.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Pug Hostile|You receive a message from Sobari Tele'ek: "We are [aware? incredulous?] of reports that you have [exterminated, eradicated] our Keepers in the Ap'arak system. This is unacceptable! From now on, you are no longer welcome in our [territory, space]."|3043|0
units.english: You receive a message from Sobari Tele'ek: "We are [aware? incredulous?] of reports that you have [exterminated, eradicated] our Keepers in the Ap'arak system. This is unacceptable! From now on, you are no longer welcome in our [territory, space]."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Sobari Tele'ek: "Siamo [a conoscenza? increduli?] di rapporti secondo cui avresti [sterminato, eliminato] i nostri Custodi nel sistema Ap'arak. Questo è inaccettabile! Da questo momento non sei più il benvenuto nel nostro [territorio, spazio]."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|name|3048|0
units.english: Report to <planet>
units.italian: Presentati su <planet>

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|description|3049|0
units.english: Return to the Wanderer capital on <destination>.
units.italian: Torna nella capitale dei Wanderers su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|log|3056|0
units.english: The Wanderers have begun producing even larger warships, and have succeeded in driving off yet another Unfettered assault. Afterwards the Pug, whom the Wanderers refer to as the "Keepers," finally sent assistance... in the form of two ships, which they claim are powerful enough to keep the entire Unfettered fleet at bay.
units.italian: I Wanderers hanno cominciato a produrre navi da guerra ancora più grandi, e sono riusciti a respingere l'ennesimo assalto degli Slegati. In seguito i Pug, che i Wanderers chiamano i "Custodi", hanno finalmente inviato aiuto... sotto forma di due navi, che sostengono essere abbastanza potenti da tenere a bada l'intera flotta degli Slegati.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|log|3057|0
units.english: After obtaining a sufficient number of jump drives, the Unfettered expanded into Wanderer space and managed to conquer six worlds from the Wanderers before their advance was stopped due to Pug interference.
units.italian: Dopo aver ottenuto un numero sufficiente di motori di salto, gli Slegati si sono espansi nello spazio dei Wanderers e sono riusciti a conquistare sei mondi prima che la loro avanzata venisse fermata dall'interferenza dei Pug.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|The Wanderers here seem incredulous that they managed to drive off such a powerful Unfettered attack force. As you walk through the spaceport, many of them stop to thank you for your assistance in defending their home.|3059|0
units.english: The Wanderers here seem incredulous that they managed to drive off such a powerful Unfettered attack force. As you walk through the spaceport, many of them stop to thank you for your assistance in defending their home.
units.italian: I Wanderers qui sembrano increduli di essere riusciti a respingere una forza d'attacco così potente degli Slegati. Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, molti si fermano a ringraziarti per l'aiuto nella difesa della loro casa.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	Just as you reach the pavilion where the military leaders are gathering, a shadow falls over you, and you look up to see two ships approaching with the unmistakable horned silhouettes of Pug warships. Throughout the spaceport you hear Wanderer voices raised in excitement, and hundreds of them leap into the air to accompany the Pug ships to the landing pad. Sobari Tele'ek says to you, "It is a [visitation, appearance] of the Keepers! In our hour of [need, desperation] they make themselves known at last." A small delegation of Pug disembarks from the ships and approaches the pavilion on foot.|3060|0
units.english: Just as you reach the pavilion where the military leaders are gathering, a shadow falls over you, and you look up to see two ships approaching with the unmistakable horned silhouettes of Pug warships. Throughout the spaceport you hear Wanderer voices raised in excitement, and hundreds of them leap into the air to accompany the Pug ships to the landing pad. Sobari Tele'ek says to you, "It is a [visitation, appearance] of the Keepers! In our hour of [need, desperation] they make themselves known at last." A small delegation of Pug disembarks from the ships and approaches the pavilion on foot.
units.italian: Proprio quando raggiungi il padiglione dove si radunano i capi militari, un'ombra ti cade addosso e alzi lo sguardo per vedere due navi avvicinarsi con le inconfondibili sagome cornute delle navi da guerra dei Pug. In tutto lo spazioporto senti voci Wanderer levarsi eccitate, e centinaia di loro saltano in aria per accompagnare le navi dei Pug alla piazzola di atterraggio. Sobari Tele'ek ti dice: "È una [visita, apparizione] dei Custodi! Nella nostra ora del [bisogno, della disperazione] si fanno conoscere finalmente." Una piccola delegazione di Pug scende dalle navi e si avvicina a piedi al padiglione.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"Let's hope that they offer you more help than they did last time I talked with them."|3062|0
units.english: "Let's hope that they offer you more help than they did last time I talked with them."
units.italian: "Speriamo che vi offrano più aiuto di quanto ne abbiano offerto l'ultima volta che ho parlato con loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"The Pug are dangerous and unpredictable. You should not trust them."|3063|0
units.english: "The Pug are dangerous and unpredictable. You should not trust them."
units.italian: "I Pug sono pericolosi e imprevedibili. Non dovreste fidarvi di loro."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"If they really cared about you, they would have intervened before so many of you died fighting the Unfettered."|3064|0
units.english: "If they really cared about you, they would have intervened before so many of you died fighting the Unfettered."
units.italian: "Se ci tenessero davvero a voi, sarebbero intervenuti prima che tanti di voi morissero combattendo contro gli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	(Hear what the Pug have to say.)|3065|0
units.english: (Hear what the Pug have to say.)
units.italian: (Ascolta quello che i Pug hanno da dire.)

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"The Keepers are [subtle, mysterious]," says Tele'ek, "but always their [intervention, action] has been for our [benefit, good]. Now be silent, and allow them to speak."|3067|0
units.english: "The Keepers are [subtle, mysterious]," says Tele'ek, "but always their [intervention, action] has been for our [benefit, good]. Now be silent, and allow them to speak."
units.italian: "I Custodi sono [sottili, misteriosi]," dice Tele'ek, "ma il loro [intervento, agire] è sempre stato a nostro [vantaggio, bene]. Ora taci, e lascia che parlino."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	The Pug delegation reaches the pavilion, and one of them begins speaking in the Wanderer language. You have no idea what they are saying, and they all seem to be ignoring your presence. A few of the Wanderer leaders respond. There's an awful lot of fanning of wings, flipping of tails, and preening of feathers going on. That might be the Wanderer way of trying to make a good impression, or else they're just feeling pleased with themselves. Or maybe they're nervous; it's hard to tell.|3069|0
units.english: The Pug delegation reaches the pavilion, and one of them begins speaking in the Wanderer language. You have no idea what they are saying, and they all seem to be ignoring your presence. A few of the Wanderer leaders respond. There's an awful lot of fanning of wings, flipping of tails, and preening of feathers going on. That might be the Wanderer way of trying to make a good impression, or else they're just feeling pleased with themselves. Or maybe they're nervous; it's hard to tell.
units.italian: La delegazione dei Pug raggiunge il padiglione, e uno di loro comincia a parlare nella lingua dei Wanderers. Non hai idea di che cosa dicano, e sembrano tutti ignorare la tua presenza. Alcuni dei capi Wanderer rispondono. C'è un gran sbattere di ali, un agitare di code e un lisciarsi di piume. Potrebbe essere il modo dei Wanderers di fare buona impressione, oppure si stanno semplicemente compiacendo. O forse sono nervosi; è difficile dirlo.

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	The Pug finish their conversation with the Wanderers and return to their ships, and only then does Sobari Tele'ek turn to you and say, "Great news! They say that their two ships will [patrol, remain in] this system and [hold off, hold at bay] the Hai fleets. Also," he adds, preening himself, "they are very pleased with us for [growing, becoming] so strong. And, they say we need not [fight? worry about?] the Hai anymore."|3070|0
units.english: The Pug finish their conversation with the Wanderers and return to their ships, and only then does Sobari Tele'ek turn to you and say, "Great news! They say that their two ships will [patrol, remain in] this system and [hold off, hold at bay] the Hai fleets. Also," he adds, preening himself, "they are very pleased with us for [growing, becoming] so strong. And, they say we need not [fight? worry about?] the Hai anymore."
units.italian: I Pug finiscono la conversazione con i Wanderers e tornano alle loro navi, e solo allora Sobari Tele'ek si volta verso di te e dice: "Ottime notizie! Dicono che le loro due navi [pattuglieranno, resteranno in] questo sistema e [tratterranno, terranno a bada] le flotte degli Hai. Inoltre," aggiunge, lisciandosi le piume, "sono molto soddisfatti di noi per essere [diventati, cresciuti] così forti. E dicono che non dobbiamo più [combattere contro? preoccuparci di?] gli Hai."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"I've fought Pug ships. There's no way two of them can stand against the entire Unfettered war fleet."|3072|0
units.english: "I've fought Pug ships. There's no way two of them can stand against the entire Unfettered war fleet."
units.italian: "Ho combattuto contro navi dei Pug. Due non possono reggere l'intera flotta da guerra degli Slegati."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"Does this mean they're finally willing to open the wormhole for you?"|3073|0
units.english: "Does this mean they're finally willing to open the wormhole for you?"
units.italian: "Vuol dire che sono finalmente disposti ad aprire il cunicolo per voi?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"Maybe they have grown stronger, too," says Tele'ek. "In any case, we are [safe, secure] here now, so we do not need your [help, protection]. Perhaps you should return to our capital and see if they need you there."|3075|0
units.english: "Maybe they have grown stronger, too," says Tele'ek. "In any case, we are [safe, secure] here now, so we do not need your [help, protection]. Perhaps you should return to our capital and see if they need you there."
units.italian: "Forse sono diventati più forti anche loro," dice Tele'ek. "In ogni caso, ora qui siamo [al sicuro, tranquilli], quindi non abbiamo bisogno del tuo [aiuto, sostegno]. Forse dovresti tornare nella nostra capitale e vedere se hanno bisogno di te là."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	Tele'ek's crest droops a little bit. "I suppose they did not make any [promises, predictions] about that," he says. "But in any case, we are [safe, secure] here now, so we do not need your [help, protection]. Perhaps you should return to our capital and see if they need you there."|3078|0
units.english: Tele'ek's crest droops a little bit. "I suppose they did not make any [promises, predictions] about that," he says. "But in any case, we are [safe, secure] here now, so we do not need your [help, protection]. Perhaps you should return to our capital and see if they need you there."
units.italian: La cresta di Tele'ek si abbassa un po'. "Suppongo che non abbiano fatto alcuna [promessa, previsione] al riguardo," dice. "Ma in ogni caso, ora qui siamo [al sicuro, tranquilli], quindi non abbiamo bisogno del tuo [aiuto, sostegno]. Forse dovresti tornare nella nostra capitale e vedere se hanno bisogno di te là."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"Very well, I'll go check if they need me on <planet>."|3081|0
units.english: "Very well, I'll go check if they need me on <planet>."
units.italian: "Molto bene, andrò a vedere se hanno bisogno di me su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	"You really think that nothing can go wrong here, just because the Pug have arrived?"|3083|0
units.english: "You really think that nothing can go wrong here, just because the Pug have arrived?"
units.italian: "Pensi davvero che qui non possa andare niente storto, solo perché sono arrivati i Pug?"

units.id: mission:Wanderers Ap'arak 3|	You try to convince Tele'ek that the Pug may not be completely trustworthy, but it's clear you cannot change his mind. To the Wanderers, the Pug must have the status of gods; speaking against them is fruitless. Eventually you give up and agree to go visit <planet>.|3084|0
units.english: You try to convince Tele'ek that the Pug may not be completely trustworthy, but it's clear you cannot change his mind. To the Wanderers, the Pug must have the status of gods; speaking against them is fruitless. Eventually you give up and agree to go visit <planet>.
units.italian: Cerchi di convincere Tele'ek che i Pug potrebbero non essere del tutto affidabili, ma è chiaro che non puoi fargli cambiare idea. Per i Wanderers i Pug devono avere lo status di dèi; parlare contro di loro è inutile. Alla fine rinunci e accetti di andare su <planet>.

units.english: A few minutes after you land on <planet>, a sudden uproar passes through the Wanderers in the spaceport. It's hard to be sure, but you think they sound excited, not frightened. Ships start taking off, more and more of them until the spaceport is almost deserted, and no one who is left seems at all interested in talking with you or explaining what is going on. You're probably going to have to return to your ship and see for yourself what all the fuss is about.
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo che atterri su <planet>, un improvviso trambusto attraversa i Wanderers nello spazioporto. È difficile esserne certo, ma ti sembra che suonino eccitati, non spaventati. Le navi cominciano a decollare, sempre più numerose, finché lo spazioporto resta quasi deserto, e nessuno di quelli che rimangono sembra minimamente interessato a parlare con te o a spiegarti che cosa sta succedendo. Probabilmente dovrai tornare alla tua nave e vedere di persona di che cosa si tratta.
